Er is een uitgebreid netwerk aan paden waardoor verschillende afstanden mogelijk zijn. De frisse zeelucht en het geluid van de golven zorgen voor een unieke loopervaring. Parkeren is mogelijk op diverse betaalde parkeerterreinen en het evenement is goed bereikbaar met trein en bus. Het evenement biedt verschillende routes, waaronder het circuit, de duinen en het strand, en wordt gehouden op 22 november 2026.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series connected with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running club, which also runs the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a welcoming, family atmosphere, various distance options, and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers aim to preserve the event’s well-established challenge and familiar character.
course_highlights: Part of the long-standing Rund um Wellen event, with four distances
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere, organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather: average 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) with frequent rain (45 mm of precipitation). Start location: Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed. Registration: not specified. Further notes: Part of the Rund um Wellen event, with local support and volunteers involved.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partially paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are recorded electronically, and there is a cup classification for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Route around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partially paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The Winter Running Series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To qualify for the cup classification, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official orders. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying others on sports equipment is not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted; start times between November 2025 and February 2026.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
location: Hermann-Löns-Park, Hannover-Wülferode, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hermann-Löns-Park Run in Hannover-Kirchrode is a traditional road and fun run held annually in early November. The event offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, volunteer support, and professional timekeeping. Runners can enjoy a raffle and refreshments in the finish area, making it a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in accordance with German Athletics Association standards
Run through Hermann-Löns-Park in Hannover-Kirchrode
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on site on Saturday from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday from 9:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Race numbers can be collected on both days. Electronic timekeeping is used, with results recorded via race number. Spikes are not allowed and may lead to disqualification. The event takes place in all weather conditions. A €2 deposit for the race number is payable at registration. Courses from 1.5 km to 10 km, marathon relay, registration and results online

name: Bibersfelder Herbstlauf
description: The Bibersfeld Autumn Run is part of the "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series and offers suitable routes for runners of all ages. The event features varied courses, with the classic 10-kilometer run at its heart. Participants can look forward to a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, and both individual runners and teams are welcome. All finishers receive certificates and gifts, while younger runners also receive medals. Registration is online only, and late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Classic 10-kilometer run
Family-friendly event with routes for all ages
Part of the regional "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series
additional: Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Certificates are provided digitally and can be printed at the venue or conveniently at home. The Cup Quartet awards ceremony takes place after the fourth race in Bibersfeld, from approximately 14:00. Various running and walking distances, online-only registration, certificates can be printed at the venue or at home, including a 10-kilometer run and a half marathon.

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: Braunschweiger Speed5 is the fastest fun run in the city of Braunschweig, organised by Polizeisportverein Braunschweig and Braunschweiger Laufclub. The running event on November 8, 2026, offers exciting races for recreational and competitive runners of all ages, including an 800 m children’s race, a 1-mile schoolchildren’s race and a measured 5 km race. The event features professional chip timing, a clear cutoff time for the fast 5 km race, and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish and music. Awards ceremonies recognise the top female and male runners in various age groups and main races.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course with a 22-minute cutoff in the fast race
800 m children’s race and 1-mile schoolchildren’s race
Professional chip timing and awards for top finishers
additional: Race bib collection starts at 09:15 on the grounds of Polizeisportverein. Refreshments are available for runners at the finish, with musical entertainment by DJ Carlito. Paramedics will be on site for safety. A pacemaker will be available in the slower 5 km race to help runners achieve times under 20 minutes. Certificates can be accessed online or on site after the race. Course: measured 5 km, children’s and schoolchildren’s races. Registration via RaceResults. Parking is available along Georg-Westermann-Allee and Ebertallee. The event takes place in Prinzenpark.

name: Friesenheimer Eulenlauf
description: The Friesenheim Owl Run returns on November 8, 2026, after a six-year break. It is organised by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. Events include the classic 10 km race, a schoolchildren’s race, a 400 m toddlers’ race, and a new 3 km course for beginners and those trying running, which is also used for the schoolchildren’s race. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and takes place on the club grounds in Ludwigshafen-Friesenheim. The organisers look forward to welcoming many participants and to the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km course
Schoolchildren’s race and 400 m toddlers’ race
New 3 km course for beginners and those trying running
additional: The schoolchildren’s race takes place on the 3 km course. Registration is via br-timing. The event is held by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. on the club grounds at Teichgasse 31, 67063 Ludwigshafen am Rhein. Registration is open until November 6, 2026; late entries are available for a fee. Courses are measured. Rainy weather is possible in November.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross-country running in Germany. The run attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers distances for all age groups, from a children’s run to longer distances. The event brings generations together and is supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixture on the regional sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country run with a history dating back to 1900
Participants spanning generations, from age 3 to over 90
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The run includes various distances, including a 400-metre children’s run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including the Roter Adler Reservists from Lehnitz. The Autumn Run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from various regions. It takes place at the Rudolf Harbig sports ground and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross-country running in Germany and promotes a sense of community through sport.

name: int. Hohenzollern Berglauf
description: The International Hohenzollern Hill Run is a long-established hill race organised by Ski-Club Hechingen e.V. The challenging course leads from Hechingen’s Weiherstadion up to Hohenzollern Castle and puts runners to the test. The race attracts both beginners and experienced hill-running specialists, and delights participants with a special atmosphere featuring music and cheering along the course. With more than 70 volunteers and a large field of participants, the race is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Start at Hechingen’s Weiherstadion
Challenging climb from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle
Music and atmosphere along the course (Runner’s Dixxies at km 3, Schnorchelhuaschter at km 5.5)
additional: The race is organised by Ski-Club Hechingen with more than 70 volunteers. The course starts out flatter and becomes increasingly steep from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle. The event offers a special atmosphere, with live rock music at the start and music and cheering along the course. Participants range from beginners to experienced hill runners; some have been taking part for more than 30 years. Registration until 5 November 2025, shuttle service to the castle, and a supporting programme with an awards ceremony.

name: Int. Martinslauf
description: The International Martinslauf in Losheim am See is a popular fun run held annually in the village center and at the Losheim Reservoir. The event attracts up to 1,500 runners and offers 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km courses that take runners through scenic surroundings around the reservoir. Runners can register late until shortly before the start, making the race appealing to last-minute entrants. The Martinslauf is a fixture in Saarland and is organized by TV 1929 Losheim e.V.
course_highlights: Courses around the Losheim Reservoir
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish in the center of Losheim
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before each start. Parking is available at several locations in the center of Losheim. With up to 1,500 participants, the event is one of the largest fun runs in Saarland. Courses around the reservoir, relay and individual races, online registration, parking in Losheim, running events in June, April, September 2024, 2025, 2026

name: Karlsbader Volkslauf
description: The Karlsbad Volkslauf is a long-standing running event that has been a fixture on many runners’ calendars for more than three decades. It offers several races, including the 10 km main race, a 2 km Sparkasse school run, and a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants. Despite changeable weather, the event attracts many participants and is known for its excellent organization and family-friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Karlsbad-Langensteinbach and offers an appealing running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a challenging course
2 km Sparkasse school run for young runners
400 m Bambini run, introduced for the first time the previous year
additional: Alongside the main race, the Volkslauf includes races for children and teenagers. The event is known for its excellent organization and regularly attracts more than 200 finishers. The mayor and local representatives praise the event, which draws many participants even in the rain. It features races for children and teenagers as well as various distances for all age groups. The event takes place in all weather and is very popular with participants.

name: Lauf am Lech - 2. Lauf der Jedermannserie
description: The Lauf am Lech is the second race in the Jedermann series by LG Donau-Ries, an autumn running series in the Donau-Ries region of Bavaria. The race takes place at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain and offers 3 km and 10 km courses. The series caters to both recreational and experienced runners and moves from town to town, with each race held at a different venue. Race numbers are equipped with transponders and must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Online pre-registration is recommended to avoid waiting on race day.
course_highlights: Start at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain
3 km and 10 km course distances
Part of a multi-race series through different towns in Donau-Ries
additional: Race numbers with transponders; collection at least 20 minutes before the start; online pre-registration recommended to avoid queues on race day. Participants can pre-register online; the series visits several towns in the region; November weather is usually rainy.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie 2026 Cochem-Zell in Kaisersesch
description: The 3rd race of the 39th 2026 Cross-Country Series in Kaisersesch takes place at the Waldsportplatz in the Eifel and offers distances for Bambini, schoolchildren, recreational runners and adults. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km in the main race for U20 and older participants. The course runs around Kaisersesch, with children and young people running a slightly modified loop. The race is part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, where participants earn points toward the overall standings and can compete for the district championship title. The event is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with refreshments and event organisation.
course_highlights: Course runs around Kaisersesch
Modified loops for children and young people
Part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, with overall standings
additional: The race is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with cake donations, sales and the start-finish area. At one of the most recent editions, 145 participants took part across all distances. Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C and rainy days, is to be expected. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km for the main race; the event is rooted in the Cochem-Zell region and takes place in typical November weather.

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country run held in early November on the beautiful fitness trail in Wildenloh, west of Oldenburg. The name means “Run across Wildenloh” and reflects the event’s rustic character: it takes place in the forest, without showers. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which creates a friendly, nature-oriented running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the local fitness trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The run takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. Several distances are offered (short course: 1600m, middle course: 3200m), and results from previous years are available. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. The run is held annually in November. There are no showers on site, results are published, and categories include children and adults.

name: Martinslauf
location: Unterbacher See, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: SFD '75 e. V., pulsschlag, SC Grün Weiß Paderborn, Friedrich-Rister-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Martinslauf is being organized for the 48th time by SFD '75 e. V. around Unterbacher See in Düsseldorf. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, including Bambini and youth races, an inclusion run, and Nordic walking. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied course, offering both sporting challenges and fun for the whole family. Award ceremonies for various age groups take place after the races, and participants can purchase a personalized finisher medal.
course_highlights: Loop course around Unterbacher See
A range of distances from 150 m to 10 km
Start and finish at Strandbad Süd on Unterbacher See
additional: Race packets can be mailed (for an additional fee of 4 EUR) or collected on site. Late registration is possible for a 3 EUR fee. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the race bib; there is no rental fee. Showers are available at the neighboring campsite. Free parking is available at Strandbad Süd and Strandbad Nord. A finisher medal engraved with the participant’s name and time can be ordered for 13 EUR and will be handed out on race day. The 10 km race cutoff is 13:15; the event ends at approximately 14:00. The Martinslauf combines fun runs, family events, and evening light runs, with a focus on running for fun, community, and a special atmosphere. Participation is at the participant’s own risk, with various race distances and activities for children and adults.

name: Mausebergecrosslauf
description: The Mauseberge Cross-Country Run is an autumn cross-country race held in the Mauseberge Forest near Husum in northern Germany. The course follows natural forest trails over uneven terrain, with mud and several climbs. The event is organized by the athletics department of Husumer Sportverein and is a long-standing fixture on the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails in the Mauseberge Forest
Uneven, muddy terrain
Several climbs
additional: The start is in Husum, and the venue can be reached by car. Typical November weather averages 7 °C (minimum 2 °C), with frequent rain (about 45 mm of precipitation). The race takes place in November in typical autumn weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C and rain. Registration with the organizer is recommended. Places are available for various distances, including 1 km, 3.35 km, 5 km, 6.67 km, and 8.33 km.

name: Obersulmer Volkslauf
description: The Obersulm Fun Run takes place on November 8, 2026, around Lake Breitenau and offers runners of all ages an appealing running experience. The event includes various distances, such as the 10 km main race, the 5 km fun run, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The course is scenically attractive, with moderate elevation changes, and is accompanied by enthusiastic spectators. Its friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the fun run a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Breitenau
5 km course with a starting elevation of 227 m and an elevation of 233 m
Attractive course with gravel and crushed-stone surfaces
additional: Professional timing using a transponder in the race bib. Bib must be worn on the front. Medals for Bambinis and schoolchildren at the finish. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the races at the Bauhof grounds. The top three finishers in the fun run, main race, and walking/Nordic walking events receive a wine gift. Free parking directly at Lake Breitenau. The course follows an attractive loop over gravel and crushed-stone surfaces. Course profile: 5 km and 10 km laps; refreshments along the course; food and drink provided by the lakeside kiosk; medical services provided by the German Red Cross; free parking at the lake; event takes place in all weather; personal data will be used in accordance with data protection regulations.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: The Quickborn Run is organized by TuS Holstein Quickborn and will be held for the 47th time in 2026. There are two race distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting in Quickborn on November 8. Childcare is available for families with young children, allowing parents to take part as well. The event offers changing facilities, free parking and a free timing chip on loan. The races are open to young people aged 12 and 14 and up, respectively, and follow the rules of the German Athletics Regulations.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race routes
Start and finish at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
Free timing chip on loan
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. for the 5 km race, 11:00 a.m. for the 10 km race. Race pack collection from 8:00 to 10:30 a.m. at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium. Changing facilities in the sports hall. Free parking at the sports hall and in the AKN station parking garage. Participation from age 12 for the 5 km and age 14 for the 10 km. Registration opens on 1.7.2026 via the Race Result portal. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, but participant numbers are limited, particularly for the 5 km race. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; minimum ages: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km; limited places; parking at the sports hall and AKN station parking garage.

name: Refrather Herbstlauf
location: Königsforst, Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Refrath Autumn Run is a long-standing running classic in the Königsforst near Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, held annually since 1986. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings. The courses run through the autumn forest and feature out-and-back routes with challenging yet scenic sections. The race attracts both competitive runners and those running for enjoyment, and concludes with prompt award ceremonies for all age groups.
course_highlights: Out-and-back routes through the autumnal Königsforst
DLV-measured courses over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon
Scenic forest trails with challenging sections
additional: Start times: 5 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00, half marathon at 12:30. Award ceremonies take place promptly after runners finish. Parking is available on Rather Weg, approximately 1.2 km from the Bensberg exit of the A4. Public transport: take KVB line 1 to “Refrath”. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings. Participants can register online. The courses are gently undulating, with an elevation difference of about 6 m in the 5 km race and 20 m in the 10 km race. The event has been a fixture on the region’s running calendar for many years.

name: Rursee-Marathon
description: The Rursee Marathon takes place on 8 November 2026 in Simmerath-Einruhr and offers runners a unique nature experience in the Eifel National Park. The marathon course follows a hilly loop along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes, with beautiful autumn scenery and varied landscapes. In addition to the marathon, other events include a 52 km ultra run, a 16.5 km run, a 5 km run and children’s races. The event is known for its challenging course and picturesque surroundings, making every run a special experience.
course_highlights: Hilly loop along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes
Route through wooded areas with beautiful autumn scenery
Full circuit of the Rursee, including challenging sections and 370 metres of elevation gain
additional: The marathon starts at 10:30 on 08.11.2026. The course is 70% unpaved field and forest paths and 30% asphalt. There are 7 refreshment points plus refreshments at the finish. Other weekend events: 5 km run on 07.11.2026 at 15:30, 52 km ultra run on 08.11.2026 at 09:00 (cut-off time 16:30), children’s races and Nordic walking. The event offers clear wayfinding on race day and is part of the Eifel Cup. Multiple running events, online registration, event photography, early-bird discounts until the end of August, and late-entry fees of up to 5 euros.

name: RWW-Herbstwaldlauf
description: The RWW Herbstwaldlauf in Bottrop is a traditional race taking place on November 8, 2026. It is part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup and offers various distances for beginners and experienced runners. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the Herbstwaldlauf tradition dates back to 1973. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge amid picturesque woodland scenery, bringing together community and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Run through Bottrop’s picturesque woodland scenery
Start and finish at the historic Jahnstadion
Part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup
additional: The time limit for all races is 15:30. A human broom wagon is available to support participants. T-shirts can be ordered in advance. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, which is also used by the Adler-Langlauf Bottrop training groups. Held in November, the race includes routes through forests and natural surroundings and offers a welcoming club atmosphere for runners of all levels.

name: Steinheimer Geologenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

description: The Steinheim Geologenlauf is a long-standing running event that has been held in the beautiful Steinheim Basin for over 35 years. The main course is 10 km long, mostly paved, with two small climbs, and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive runners and beginners. The program also includes a 5 km fitness run, a team run, walking, and children’s races, suitable for all age and ability groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, dedicated team of volunteers, and good refreshments at the club center.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mostly paved, with two small climbs at 3.2 km and 6.4 km
5 km fitness run, extremely flat and well suited to beginner runners
Start and finish at the club center in Steinheim am Albuch
additional: Late registration is available online after advance registration closes and in person on the event day until 60 minutes before the respective start, but without a personalized race bib. Changing facilities and showers are available at the club center. Refreshments include cake and grilled sausages in the outdoor area. The three fastest women and men in each age group will be honored. Various running disciplines, online registration, results, and photo galleries available; event held in November.

name: Süderelbe Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
price_range: 20 Euro Halbmarathon, 18 Euro 10 km, 5 Euro Kinderlauf
description: The 50th Süderelbe Half Marathon through the Altes Land takes place on November 8, 2026. The course starts at the CU Arena at Neugraben S-Bahn station, runs through the Altes Land to Neuenfelde, and returns to the start. In addition to the half marathon, there are 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The event is organized by Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V. and offers a varied program for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the CU Arena, Neugraben S-Bahn station
Course through the scenic Altes Land to Neuenfelde
Return to the starting point along the same route
additional: The program includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The organizer is Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V., with office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–11:00 and Mon–Thu 16:00–18:00. The event features a course through the Altes Land, various race distances, a children’s race, a walking event, a course closing time of 12:30, parking at the P+R car park at Neugraben S-Bahn station, race-number pickup on the day of the event, refreshments along the course, and medals and certificates for participants.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf is a challenging trail race in November that starts and finishes at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The route takes runners to the Kaiserturm and offers a varied challenge, with narrow forest paths, muddy sections and steep climbs. In addition to the main races over 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children’s races over 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and, with around 160 participants, is a popular local tradition that also includes a pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: Trail race on narrow forest paths
Steep climbs to the Kaiserturm
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event has four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, and 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. A pasta party on the evening before the race is a small local tradition. Trail character with challenging climbs; registration by email; pasta party on Saturday evening at Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: Westfalenparklauf
location: Westfalenpark Dortmund, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Lauftreff Bittermark Dortmund, LT Bittermark Dortmund, Dortmunder Volksbank

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Onlineanmeldung bis 27.10.2026, 23:59 Uhr zum regulären Beitrag

description: The Dortmunder Volksbank Westfalenparklauf on 8 November 2026 is a sporting competition in Westfalenpark Dortmund, welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and main races over 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with electronic timing. The course is measured by the DLV and runs through the beautiful Westfalenpark. All finishers receive medals, and the fastest runners are honored. The event prioritizes safe and fair race operations, with medical support and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Course in Westfalenpark Dortmund, with start and finish at the Ruhrallee entrance
DLV-measured courses over 2.5 km (1 lap), 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Electronic timing and lead bicycle for the main races
additional: Race number distribution is available on race day until 45 minutes before each start. There are no changing facilities, but baggage storage is available without liability. Headphones, dogs and strollers are not allowed. The Bambini race is untimed; participants receive a certificate only. Awards go to places 1–3 in the men’s and women’s categories for the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as to age-group winners. Medical support is available on the course and in the start/finish area. A lead bicycle accompanies the 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races. This is a local event with a traditional character, including medals for finishers, online registration and medical support on the course. Certain participation rules apply, including a ban on dogs and umbrellas.

name: Winter Crosslaufserie 2026/27 / 1.Termin
description: The 2026/27 Winter Cross-Country Series in Goldbach, Lower Franconia, offers runners a challenging winter race series with several dates. The races take place on varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape and are suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The established series promotes the enjoyment of winter running in the region and offers a great opportunity for competition and community.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape
Challenging course layout with natural obstacles
Running enjoyment for competitive and recreational runners
additional: Dates and details of the series are available on the website; terrain details are not specified.

name: 3TuermeWEG TRAILRUN
location: Hagen Stadtwald, Hagen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3TürmeWEG Trailrun is a timed trail race organized by TV Hasperbach 1898 e.V. in cooperation with Hagen.Wirtschaftsentwicklung. The route runs through Hagen City Forest and follows the well-known 3TürmeWEG premium hiking trail. Along the way, runners pass three historic towers and a fallow deer enclosure and enjoy numerous views. The route has been evaluated by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA) and is part of the National League 2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place every year in August.
course_highlights: The route passes three historic towers counterclockwise: Kaiser-Friedrich-Turm, Bismarckturm, Eugen-Richter-Turm
Runs through Hagen City Forest, with a fallow deer enclosure and numerous viewpoints
Evaluated by ITRA and part of the National League 2026
additional: Limited-edition 3TT short-sleeved and long-sleeved technical shirts, as well as padded 3TT Skyrunner running socks, can optionally be ordered by 30.09.2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place on the third Thursday of every August. The route is available as a GPX file for running independently. The event offers a varied route with cultural sights, optional merchandise available to pre-order, and starts on 8 November 2026. Registration opens on 1 July 2026.

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Köln-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with enthusiasm for the Cologne Carnival. The event takes place on 11.11.2026 and is a unique event marking the start of the “fifth season.” The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and follows a flat, paved loop around Pescher See, which runners complete multiple times. The field is limited to 50 participants, and costumes are expressly encouraged to add to the fun.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km plus a 1.215 km out-and-back section at the start for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pescher See in a protected landscape area
Refreshment station in the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:30 to 10:30 at the playground at Pescher See. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is manual, with lap numbers clipped off the race bib. After the race, there will be Kölsch and a unique Carnival finisher’s medal. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds will be donated to Cologne Carnival associations. The course is a paved 2.7 km loop; there is no lighting or medical station. The number of race numbers is limited to 50. No refunds are given for non-participation or force majeure. Participation is open to runners aged U20 and older.

name: Amersfoort Night Run
description: De Amersfoort Night Run is een nieuw hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op vrijdagavond 13 november 2026. Tijdens deze unieke nachtloop ren je door een sfeervol verlichte stad, langs lichtinstallaties, livemuziek en verrassend entertainment. De route voert langs de Eem en door de binnenstad van Amersfoort, met zicht op historische bezienswaardigheden zoals de middeleeuwse stadsmuur, Monnikendam, Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren en de Koppelpoort. Het evenement combineert sport met beleving en wordt officieel getimed, zodat het ook een echte wedstrijd is. Na afloop is er een gezellige afterparty op het Eemplein bij het KAdE Café om je prestatie te vieren.
course_highlights: Sfeervol verlicht parcours door de binnenstad van Amersfoort
Langs historische bezienswaardigheden zoals de middeleeuwse stadsmuur, Monnikendam, Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren en Koppelpoort
Entertainment onderweg met livemuziek, bandjes en lichtinstallaties
additional: Start en finish zijn op het Eemplein bij het KAdE Café. Er is tijdsregistratie, dus het is een officiële wedstrijd. Na afloop is er een afterparty om samen met andere deelnemers te vieren. Meerdere afstanden inclusief een kinderrun, verlichte route door de stad, live muziek, entertainment, en een afterparty. De opbrengst ondersteunt ALS.

name: Jigler - Run by Night Barneveld

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het bedrijvenarrangement kost 350 euro en bestaat uit: 5 startbewijzen, inclusief gratis huur chip Hardloopshirts met eigen bedrijfslogo voor jouw team Gezamenlijk pastabuffet vooraf Hapjes en drankjes na afloop (5 consumpties p.p.) Jouw merk zichtbaar tijdens de run

description: De Jigler Run by Night is het sfeervolste hardloopevenement van Barneveld, dat plaatsvindt op vrijdagavond 13 november 2026. De start en finish zijn op Sportpark Norschoten, het sportcomplex van SDV Barneveld. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit een 5 kilometer, 10 kilometer of de bedrijvenrun. Het parcours loopt door de wijk Norschoten en biedt een gezellige en sportieve avond met sfeerverhogende attributen zoals lichtjes en fluoriserende kleding. Voor bedrijven is er een speciale bedrijvenrun met een pastabuffet vooraf en een afterparty met DJ en zanger.
course_highlights: Parcours van 5 kilometer door de wijk Norschoten
Start en finish op Sportpark Norschoten (SDV Barneveld)
Hardloopparcours gaat over de openbare weg met normale verkeersregels
additional: Toiletten, kleedkamers en douches aanwezig. Geen kluisjes. Organisatie is niet aansprakelijk voor verlies van waardevolle spullen. De bedrijvenrun vereist minimaal drie lopers per team. Voorafgaand aan de bedrijvenrun is een gezamenlijk pastabuffet en na afloop een afterparty met DJ en zanger. Parkeermogelijkheden bij Sportpark Norschoten, Aeres, Schaffelaarse Bos en Vetkamp. Fietsen wordt aanbevolen. De route is deels niet afgesloten, let op verkeersveiligheid. Sfeerverhogende attributen zoals lichtjes en lichtgevende ballonnen worden aangemoedigd. De run is een nachtactiviteit zonder officiële verkeersafsluiting, met parkeergelegenheid bij SDVB en in de buurt. De inschrijving is verplicht.

name: Vijfhoekparkloop
description: Zaterdag 26 oktober is de eerste Vijfhoekparkloop van 2024! De overige lopen zijn op 9 en 30 november. Deze gemoedelijke trimloop vindt plaa

name: Lage Vuursche Trail
description: De Lage Vuursche Trail is een uitdagende afwisselende trail met veel single tracks, zand- en bospaden, gelegen in het unieke gebied van de U

name: Hobbeldebobbelloop
description: De Hobbeldebobbelloop in Zoutelande is een hardloopevenement dat jaarlijks plaatsvindt, ditmaal op 14 november 2026. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit twee afstanden: 6 km en 11 km. Het evenement wordt georganiseerd door Dynamica en biedt een mooie gelegenheid om te lopen in de omgeving van Zoutelande. Voor meer details over inschrijving en faciliteiten wordt verwezen naar de organisatie.
course_highlights: Keuze uit 6 km of 11 km parcours
Lopen in de omgeving van Zoutelande, Zeeland
Georganiseerd door Dynamica
additional: Inschrijving via externe link; evenement vindt plaats op 14 november 2026 tussen 14:30 en 17:00 uur.

name: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers
description: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers is een sfeervol buurtdiner dat plaatsvindt op zaterdagavond 14 november in de Buitenpepers, een levendige buurt in ’s-Hertogenbosch. Het evenement brengt buurtbewoners samen voor een onvergetelijke avond vol gezelligheid, lekker eten en wijn, verspreid door de hele buurt. Het is een mooie gelegenheid om elkaar te ontmoeten en de buurt te versterken in een warme en feestelijke sfeer.
course_highlights: Buurtmaaltijd met diverse gerechten
Gezellige en feestelijke sfeer
Versterking van de gemeenschap
additional: Het evenement is een buurtdiner verspreid door de hele buurt, waarbij bewoners samenkomen voor een gezamenlijke maaltijd en wijn. Het is een sociaal evenement zonder wedstrijdkarakter, georganiseerd door de buurtvereniging De Buitenpepers. Activiteitenkalender, buurtbijeenkomsten, buurtmaaltijd, buurtdiner, gemeenschapsondersteuning

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Biegerparklauf
location: Biegerpark, Duisburg-Huckingen, Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is an officially DLV-measured race on asphalt, with distances of 1.2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for everyone, and 10 km for youth and adults. The races follow a loop through Biegerpark, with the final 300 meters run on the stadium’s cinder track. All participants receive certificates; schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner, and the top runners are awarded medals. The event is organized by Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop through Biegerpark on asphalt
10 km runners complete 3 laps; 5 km runners complete 2 laps
The final 300 meters are on the stadium’s cinder track
additional: Late entries are possible in limited numbers on the event day, up to 30 minutes before the start. Certificates are issued online and at the venue, where there may be a wait. Schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner at the finish. The event provides sports liability insurance under the NRW sports aid insurance agreement. The final 300 meters are run on the stadium’s cinder track. Course: loop through Biegerpark, paved paths, final 300 m on the cinder track; dates and registration by email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail takes place on 14 November 2026 in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and finishes at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km; the longest distance can be run as one or two laps. This is a true forest trail, and poles are permitted. There are no refreshment stations along the course; refreshments are available only in the start and finish area. The event is organised by the running section of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
A true trail where poles are permitted
Refreshments only in the start and finish area; no support along the course
additional: There are several distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail and 16 km (one or two laps). Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; there are no drink or refreshment stations in the forest. Times, results and placings will be published online. The top three will be honoured. A trail with various distances, self-sufficiency required on forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, results and placings online. Cold and wet November weather is possible.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Run takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter run for the youngest participants to the 10-kilometer road race—the largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate—there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races, from 360 m to 10 km
The largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with a special award for every participant
additional: Start times: youngest participants’ race 13:30, children’s race 14:00, youth race 14:30, main race 15:00. All children’s races are free to enter. RFID chip timing for the children’s and youth races. Late entries are not possible, including on the day of the event. Several race distances, including children’s and youth races; registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is an atmospheric autumn race taking place on the evening of Saturday, November 14, 2026, in Kernen. Runners set off at dusk on a loop of approximately 4.5 km along illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. A 10 km distance is also offered. The event celebrates a passion for running and the shared enjoyment of sport in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km loop along illuminated paths
The course passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Starts at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run along illuminated paths, with 4.5 km and 10 km options; an atmosphere enhanced by lights and torches; finish in the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition takes place on 14 November 2026 and offers runners of different ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has attracted many more participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for rankings
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure the event runs smoothly along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. Sponsors include the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for rankings. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed; online registration opens on 01.09.2025; start times from 11:30 a.m.; medals for children; prizes in kind for winners; limited parking; showers available.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional hill race organised by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometres with 350 metres of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and hill-running enthusiasts. The organisers thank their sponsors and are happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course distance: 8.2 kilometres
Elevation gain: 350 metres
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. No events or registration dates are listed on the website. TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be contacted by telephone for further information. The race is part of the Pfälzer Berglauf-Pokal-Cup and has categories for adults and young people, as well as a convenient baggage and clothing transport service to the finish. The event takes place in November.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers a range of distances, from a Bambini run and children’s and youth races to short, middle- and long-distance races. The varied forest trails, with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles, make the race a memorable and adventurous experience. The run is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and places great importance on community and experiencing nature.
course_highlights: All routes lead through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
Muddy, uneven ground and narrow trails with small obstacles
A variety of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Race number collection: Friday, 16:30–18:00, and Saturday from 9:30. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated chip. Recycled technical shirts can be ordered online as an option until 05.09.2026 (children €15, adults €20). Late registration is possible on the event day until 60 minutes before the start; the late registration fee is €3.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon takes place on 14 November 2026 in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course runs mainly along paved forest paths, following a varied route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past several lakes. Events include the marathon, half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organised by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timekeeping with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park, almost entirely on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past the Seven Lakes
Aid stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timekeeping with an integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon course after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car parks, as well as the Tuchanger car park, with a city bus transfer. Race number collection is at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. There is no baggage storage in the start/finish area. Free buses run every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost entirely along paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. Aid stations are available every 5 km. Race numbers include a chip. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car park, and showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and a free bus transfer is available.

name: Griseriløbet
description: Griseriløbet is a traditional fun run held by Brande Motion. The race takes place on paths and roads around Brande, and the worse

name: De Kievitloop
description: Tijdens de herfst- en wintermaanden organiseert Atletiekvereniging SPADO elke derde zondag van de maand een speciale loop in de bosrijke omg

name: Bertusloop
description: De Bertusloop wordt iedere 3e zondag van de maand georganiseerd, met uitzondering van de maanden juli en augustus. Deze recreatieve trimloop

name: Hafkamp Groenewegen De Ronde Venen Marathon
Chocolademelkloop
description: De Chocolademelkloop is een gezellig familiehardloopevenement in de bossen van Bilthoven, geschikt voor hardlopers van alle niveaus. Op zondag 15 november 2026 kunnen deelnemers kiezen uit afstanden van 1, 2 of 5 kilometer. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn warme sfeer, de heerlijke chocolademelk na afloop en de aanwezigheid van pieten die meedoen aan de loop. Het is een sportief en toegankelijk evenement waar jong en oud samen kunnen genieten van bewegen in de natuur.
course_highlights: Lopen door het bos van Bilthoven
Grotendeels onverharde paden
Gezellige familieloop met pieten en warme chocolademelk
additional: Ouders met een 2 of 5 km inschrijving mogen zonder extra kosten de 1 km familieloop meerennen met hun kind. De 1 km familieloop is gericht op kinderen van 3-8 jaar en gaat grotendeels over onverharde bospaden. Er is een prijsverloting waarbij prijzen worden verloot onder alle deelnemers, ongeacht hun tijd. Het start- en finishterrein is bij de Werkplaats in Bilthoven. Afstanden: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km; geen tijdregistratie; ouders kunnen gratis meerennen met kinderen; start en finish op het terrein van de Werkplaats

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: De Knikker Zegerplasloop is een hardloopserie bestaande uit drie wedstrijden in november, januari en februari, georganiseerd door AAV'36 in Alphen aan den Rijn. De wedstrijden vinden plaats rondom de Zegerplas en bieden afstanden van 5, 10, 15 en 20 km, evenals jeugdafstanden van 400 en 1000 meter op de atletiekbaan. Het parcours is bijna geheel autovrij en loopt door het Zegerslootgebied en rond de Zegerplas, geschikt voor zowel beginnende als ervaren lopers. De start en finish zijn op de atletiekbaan van AAV'36, waar ook kleedkamers, douches, een kantine en een massageruimte beschikbaar zijn.
course_highlights: Bijna geheel autovrij parcours door het Zegerslootgebied en rond de Zegerplas
Afstanden variëren van 400m voor jeugd tot 20 km voor volwassenen
Start en finish op de atletiekbaan van AAV'36 met faciliteiten zoals kleedkamers en douches
additional: Er is officiële tijdswaarneming via MyLaps. Voor wandelaars zijn er 5 en 10 km wandelafstanden met een tijdslimiet van 2 uur, startend gelijktijdig met de 20 km hardloopwedstrijd. Er is geen drankpost langs het Aarkanaal vanwege een verbod op plastic bekertjes, maar water is beschikbaar bij de finish en bij een drankpost op de baan voor 15 en 20 km lopers bij hun tweede ronde. Gratis massage van de benen is mogelijk in de massageruimte, verzorgd door Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Kleedkamers, douches, kantine en beperkte kluisjes zijn beschikbaar. Inschrijving via de website, gratis benenmassage door Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn, winterse omstandigheden mogelijk

name: Sterke Start Loop
description: De Sterke Start Loop op 15 november 2026 in Zevenhuizen is een hardloopevenement met afstanden van 5, 10 en 21 kilometer. De routes voeren door prachtige natuur, langs water en door bosrijke gebieden, met voornamelijk verharde ondergrond en bij de 21 km ook grondpaden. Het evenement biedt een unieke en gevarieerde loopervaring en staat in het teken van het steunen van premature baby's. Daarnaast is er een Kidsrun van 1 km met obstakels, symbolisch voor de uitdagingen van te vroeg geboren kinderen. De start en finish zijn bij de Willem-Alexanderbaan, waar deelnemers en supporters samenkomen voor een sterke start van de dag.
course_highlights: Routes door natuur, langs water en door bos
Voornamelijk verharde ondergrond, met grondpaden bij 21 km
Kidsrun van 1 km met obstakels voor kinderen
additional: De start en finish zijn bij de Willem-Alexanderbaan in Zevenhuizen. Parkeren is duidelijk aangegeven en er is geen OV-bereikbaarheid vanwege de vroege starttijd. De Kidsrun start om 11:00 uur. Deelnemers kunnen worden aangemoedigd bij de finish, met geschatte aankomsttijden per afstand. Er wordt gezocht naar vrijwilligers om het evenement te ondersteunen. Het evenement ondersteunt onderzoek en zorg voor premature baby's, met een Kidsrun en de mogelijkheid om virtueel deel te nemen. De opbrengst gaat naar goede doelen en wetenschappelijk onderzoek.

name: Loetcross
description: De Loetcross in Lekkerkerk is een uitdagende crosscountrywedstrijd die plaatsvindt op 15 november 2026. Het parcours voert over wisselende ondergronden zoals gras, schelpenpaden en langs slootkanten, wat zorgt voor een afwisselende en natuurlijke loopervaring. Er zijn verschillende afstanden beschikbaar, variërend van 1,2 km tot 7,2 km, geschikt voor diverse leeftijden en niveaus. De wedstrijd staat bekend om zijn ruige karakter waarbij schoenen gegarandeerd niet schoon blijven. Voorinschrijving is mogelijk tot en met 13 november 2026.
course_highlights: Crosscountry over gras, schelpenpaden en langs slootkanten
Afstanden variërend van 1,2 km tot 7,2 km
Natuurlijke en wisselende ondergrond met uitdagende secties
additional: Dames kunnen zich inschrijven voor de lange afstand van 7,2 km, maar deelname valt buiten de damescompetitie en prijsuitreiking. Schoenen blijven tijdens de wedstrijd niet schoon door het terrein. Velden met * zijn verplicht bij inschrijving. Het evenement omvat verschillende onderdelen voor verschillende leeftijden en niveaus, en inschrijving is vereist.

name: Bommelasloop
description: De Bommelasloop is een geliefde recreatieve natuurloop die al vele jaren wordt georganiseerd door Rekreatie Sport Twente. De loop vindt plaats in het prachtige Natura 2000-gebied Het Buurserzand, gelegen tussen Enschede en Haaksbergen. Er zijn vier verschillende afstanden, zodat elke loper een passende uitdaging kan vinden. De start is om 11:00 uur en na afloop ontvangen deelnemers een gratis consumptie. De sfeer is ontspannen en gericht op recreatie, zonder prijsuitreiking of medailles.
course_highlights: Natuurloop in het Natura 2000-gebied Het Buurserzand
Vier afstanden: 7,6 km, 11,7 km, 16 km en 20,5 km
Start en finish bij Camping Twente in Enschede
additional: Na-inschrijving en afhalen startnummer mogelijk op de dag zelf van 09:45 tot 10:50, mits er nog plekken vrij zijn. Er is geen prijsuitreiking of medaille, maar deelnemers kunnen een consumptie krijgen bij inlevering van het startnummer aan de bar bij de camping. Vanwege beperkte parkeergelegenheid wordt fietsen aanbevolen. Natuurloop in Buurserzand, inschrijving op de dag mogelijk, geen prijsuitreiking of medaille, gratis consumptie na afloop, geen honden of rolstoelen toegestaan

name: Sytze Wetting Trail
location: Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, Friesland, Netherlands
description: De Sytze Wetting Trail is een jaarlijkse trailrun georganiseerd door AV Lionitas in het natuurgebied de Lytse en Grutte Wielen nabij Leeuwarden. De trail biedt een avontuurlijk parcours van voornamelijk onverharde paden, gras en smalle paadjes, waarbij genieten van de natuur centraal staat. Er zijn drie afstanden: 19 km, 7,9 km en een Kidsrun van 1 km. De loop is uitdagender dan een wegwedstrijd en vereist goede trail- of schoenen met profiel. Na afloop is er gratis snert voor de deelnemers.
course_highlights: Grotendeels onverhard parcours door natuurgebied de Lytse en Grutte Wielen
Avontuurlijke route over gras en smalle paadjes
Mogelijkheid tot natte voeten, aanbevolen goede trail- of schoenen met nopprofiel
additional: Kleedgelegenheid en douches aanwezig. Tassenrekken om je tas op te slaan. Verzorging onderweg en na afloop. Parkeren graag in de Kleine Wielen (Groene Ster), niet bij Restaurant Groote Wielen. Na afloop gratis snert aangeboden door Restaurant de Groote Wielen. Trail door natuurgebied, onverharde ondergrond, start en finish nabij Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, met verzorging en gratis snert na afloop.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a long-established running event held annually in Geislingen. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages, including student races and an integration run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied, well-organized route. The event is popular in the region and is hosted by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at the Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
Student race for all school grades
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, 15 November 2026. There are student races and an integration run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until 12 November 2025; the event includes children’s, youth, open and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for ranking lists. The route runs along finely graveled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, and water, tea, and special sports drinks are available at several refreshment stations. A high-quality technical shirt is included in the entry fee for all participants and can be collected at the runners’ expo. In addition to the main race, there is also a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for ranking lists
Finely graveled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters; total elevation gain approx. 300 meters
additional: Refreshments at kilometers 5, 11, and 17 with water, tea, and UltraSports products; finish refreshments with raisin rolls, water, UltraRefresher, and hot tea; start and finish at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, near the runners’ expo; runners’ expo and race office in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; free Nikolauslauf app for current information and race bib management; high-quality technical shirt included in the entry fee, with the option to exchange it at the runners’ expo; shirts for virtual 10 km participants are shipped within Germany only. The test run takes place on November 16, 2025, is free, and requires no registration; run in groups with pacers; parking available at Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; finish refreshments with pretzels and vegetable broth; no shower facilities on site.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event held at LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. It is aimed at recreational runners, families, and club athletes, and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running races, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Distances from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course, approx. 2.9 km
additional: The program includes an 800 m stadium cross-country race for younger children, approx. 1,600 m for older children and teenagers, and the main race of approx. 5.8 km for older teenagers and adults. The event takes place in the morning in November. Typical November weather, with temperatures of approx. 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. Several running distances and a Nordic walking option make the event ideal for families and recreational runners. The event takes place in November at LOWA Stadium.

name: Kreis Herbst Waldlauf Meisterschaften
description: The District Autumn Forest Running Championships take place on 15 November 2026 in Usingen/Merzhausen. This event is part of the traditional competitions organised by the HLV Hochtaunus District and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course winds through autumnal woodland and promises a varied, nature-filled running environment. The championships are an important fixture in the regional athletics calendar and support the development of young athletes.
course_highlights: Run through autumnal woodland
Nature-filled cross-country course
Event in Usingen/Merzhausen
additional: Weather-dependent event in November; no fixed distances for all categories; regional event with several participating clubs

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and Volkswald Run is a traditional running event that has taken place annually since 1972. The race is open to municipal employees, company sports participants and guest runners, who compete on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual events, there are team classifications, with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Course consists entirely of forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults and walkers
additional: The Authorities Forest Run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available at the Arbeiterwohlfahrt recreation grounds. Free tea is offered after the finish. The award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual events. For travel, participants are advised to use the car park at Nasses Dreieck, opposite the Stadthalle. The course consists entirely of forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025; late entries are accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Free tea, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg
location: Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, Freiburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 50th Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg is a traditional cross-country race in Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, organized by TV Riegel. The event offers various distances for children, young people, open runners and Masters, including short cross-country and road races. The courses run around Michaelsberg and offer local runners and young athletes an excellent opportunity to gain race experience. The longest distance is 8.1 km and is open to men, women and Masters.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around Michaelsberg
Distances from 0.5 km to 8.1 km
Separate starts for children, young people, open runners and Masters
additional: The program includes children's races (520 m), youth races (840 m, 1,400 m), a 2,900 m race for older youths and adults, and the main race over 8,100 m. Typical November weather, with temperatures around 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. An off-road running event in November, with typical weather conditions around 7°C, often rainy, and various distances for all age groups.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
