name: Sonnefelder Wald-Cross-Lauf
description: The 5th Sonnefeld Forest Cross-Country Run takes place on June 4, 2026, in Sonnefeld. It offers runners of all abilities an appealing event in scenic surroundings, on field and forest paths. Events include an 8.3 km main race with 110 metres of elevation gain, a Nordic walking competition on the same course, and a 1.7 km student race. The event is open to competitive runners, Nordic walkers, and young athletes, and is held under official athletics regulations. Food and refreshments, showers, and changing facilities are available, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Loop course on field and forest paths in scenic surroundings
8.3 km main race with 110 metres of elevation gain
1.7 km student race with a turnaround point
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available at the sports clubhouse. Sports drinks are free in the finish area. Sustainable prizes will be awarded to the top three finishers in each age group in the main and student races, and to the fastest woman and man in Nordic walking. Finisher medals for all races. The event takes place in all weather. Late registration on race day costs €3.00 (no later than 1 hour before the start). Course: 8.3 km with 110 metres of elevation gain, cross-country atmosphere. Registration is open until June 2, 2026. Various race categories for children, young people, and adults. Finisher medals for all participants.

name: Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen
description: The Wacker Frohnhausen Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen, held annually by SV Wacker Frohnhausen. The races take participants around Donnerberg and offer courses for different ability levels. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and involvement of the local community. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with varied courses.
course_highlights: Run around Donnerberg
Distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km
Long-standing event with a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The race takes place at the Waldsportplatz in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen; the weather is expected to be sunny at around 23°C. Participants should contact the organizer for registration and further details.

name: Borkener Citylauf
description: The Borken City Run is a traditional fun run that has been held annually in Borken’s city centre since 1987. The event offers races for all ages on a closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, the town park and across the market square. Starting and finishing at the market square, the City Run is a popular event that appeals to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. It is organised by the Borken City Sports Association and several local clubs, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of age groups and awards.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, town park and market square
Start and finish at Borken market square
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are accepted at the Tourist Information Centre in Borken on the day of the event from 14:00 until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race, for a fee of €2.00. Race packs are available from 14:00. Transponders can be returned after crossing the finish line for a €2.00 refund. Races for various age groups, online registration, on-site late registration available, special support for young runners with children acting as guides

name: Wallauer Mittsommerlauf
location: Wallau, Hofheim am Taunus, Hesse, Germany

name: 1. Westerwälder Backyard Ultra
description: The Westerwälder Backyard Ultra 2026 is a unique ultramarathon held in Höchstenbach in the Westerwald (Rhineland-Palatinate). Participants run a marked 6.706 km loop with 71 metres of elevation gain per lap, along forest, woodland and meadow paths. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, electronic lap timing, refreshments in the start/finish area, and a medal for everyone who completes at least one lap. A portion of the entry fee is also donated to local youth work and a tree-planting project.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop with 71 metres of elevation gain per lap
Route along forest, woodland and meadow paths
Electronic lap timing via RaceResult
additional: Bib pickup begins on 5 June 2026 at 17:00. Mandatory briefing 15 minutes before the start. Runner-friendly drinks and snacks are available in the start/finish area. Camping and setting up a gazebo are possible on a limited basis. A shower trailer is available on site. No refunds of the entry fee for non-participation; substitute runners are allowed. A waiting list will be available if the event sells out. A portion of the entry fee is donated to youth work and a tree-planting project. A medal is awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap. The awards ceremony will take place shortly after the finish. Participants may camp or set up gazebos in the start/finish area. The entry fee includes a donation to a charitable cause; an additional €1.50 is charged per lap (up to a maximum of 10 laps). The event is limited to 200 participants and starts on 5 June 2026 at 19:00.

name: Freundschaftslauf
description: The saarLANDlauf is a friendship run around Saarland, held in 20 stages along the Saarland Circular Hiking Trail, covering a total of about 400 kilometers. The runs are guided friendship runs organized by local hosts and are intended for experienced runners who can comfortably complete a half marathon. The aim is to strengthen the community of Saarland runners and running clubs and to explore the region’s most beautiful spots together on foot. Participation is free, although a small donation is welcome.
course_highlights: 20 stages, each about 20 km long
Routes follow the Saarland Circular Hiking Trail, with plenty of climbs and descents
Guided runs without markings; GPS data is provided
additional: These are not races but friendship runs. There are no running pacers or course markings; instead, GPS data for the routes is provided. The event encourages sociability and community, with a relaxed get-together after the runs. Changing facilities, showers, and parking are available at the meeting points. Participants explore the mystical, marshy Rötelsteinpfad region, with picturesque views of the Nahe. The event is part of a multi-day, regionally focused running event with several stages and route options.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a traditional race in Heide, organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive route through the city. The race is known for its welcoming atmosphere and the support of the local sports club. The course is well marked and offers a varied running experience in Heide’s beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course runs through downtown Heide
Well-marked route with varied city scenery
Organized by the long-standing MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide
additional: The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and fosters community through sporting activities in Heide.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Bambini Schlosspark Run is a traditional children’s race taking place on June 5, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. in Saalfeld’s Schlosspark. The event is for children born between 2017 and 2023, who run one or two laps depending on their age. It is organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. and offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 9
Lap count varies by age group (1 or 2 laps)
Event held in Saalfeld’s picturesque Schlosspark
additional: Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone through Uta Weber (Tel.: 0176/84770473). There are no entry fees. Races are grouped by year of birth, with 1 or 2 laps. A liability disclaimer applies to damage and injuries. The event is organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. Children’s race in Schlosspark, part of the Saalfelder Kulmberglauf; dates and results available

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Spargellauf in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five runners make their way together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the relay baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and fun comes first, as the winning team is selected by lottery. Alongside the race, there is a culinary mile featuring regional specialties and a family programme with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be available for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route through Deinste’s asparagus fields
Relay race with an asparagus spear as the baton
Suitable for all fitness levels; participants can walk, power walk or run
additional: The 2026 anniversary celebration includes an after-show party, an anniversary magazine, a prize wheel, and special anniversary dishes and drinks. The winning team is drawn by lottery and receives regional products (asparagus, potatoes, ham and strawberries). Anniversary race shirts featuring a custom team name or logo can be ordered until 16 May. The culinary mile offers a variety of food and drinks. The family programme includes a bouncy castle. The anniversary event also features music and refreshments along the route.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km race measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), starting and finishing at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports ground. The course winds through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, along farm tracks, school routes and village streets. Part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community, the event offers runners a well-organised and varied course in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Start and finish at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports ground
Route follows farm tracks, school routes and village streets
additional: Online registration is available until race day. Start and finish at the sports ground in Stapelmoor. Nordic walking is also offered without timing.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small race held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. The event offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5-Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3-Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Short distances: 555 m and 9.3 km
Locally inspired nautical race names (5 Seemeilen-Lauf, 3 Seemeilen-Lauf, 3 Kabellängen-Lauf)
Venue in Warnemünde with a coastal character
additional: The event takes place on 5 June 2026 in Warnemünde. Typical June weather is around 23 °C high and 13 °C low, with mostly sunny days. Detailed course information is not available; results are provided online. The event also includes running routes in the fields of maritime studies, engineering, and logistics; results are available online.

name: Hollen in Heesch
description: Hollen in Heesch is een hardloopevenement voor jong en oud, van beginner tot gevorderde, dat plaatsvindt in het hart van Heesch. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit verschillende afstanden en genieten van een prachtig parcours door het dorp, met start en finish op de sfeervolle binnenplaats van de Eijnderic. Het evenement wordt afgesloten met een gezellige afterparty op dezelfde locatie, wat het een sportief en feestelijk hoogtepunt maakt voor iedereen. De loop is toegankelijk voor individuen, groepen, vrienden en collega's, en biedt een warme en enthousiaste sfeer.
course_highlights: Prachtig parcours van 2,5 km door het hart van Heesch
Afhankelijk van de afstand loop je 2 of 4 rondes door de straten van Heesch
Start en finish op de sfeervolle binnenplaats van de Eijnderic
additional: Er is een Kidsrun van 1 of 2 kilometer voor kinderen. De start-to-run training van 10 weken wordt aangeboden in samenwerking met Fruntrunners om beginnende lopers voor te bereiden. Het evenement sluit af met een afterparty op de binnenplaats van de Eijnderic. Vrijwilligers zijn welkom om mee te helpen met diverse taken zoals hekken bewaken en water uitdelen. Evenement gericht op alle leeftijden, met nadruk op gemeenschapsgevoel, plezier en een afterparty.

name: KLM Aruba Marathon
location: Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort, Oranjestad, Aruba
description: De KLM Aruba Marathon is een officieel gecertificeerde marathon door World Athletics en AIMS, die plaatsvindt op het prachtige eiland Aruba. De race biedt een tropische loopervaring langs de kustlijn van Aruba, met start en finish bij het Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort. De marathon bestaat uit meerdere afstanden, waaronder de volledige marathon, halve marathon, 10 km en 5 km, en wordt gekenmerkt door een feestelijke sfeer met een beach party na afloop. De race is een unieke combinatie van sport, cultuur en vakantie, ideaal voor zowel competitieve lopers als recreanten.
course_highlights: Tropische route langs de kust van Aruba, inclusief Eagle Beach en de beroemde vuurtoren
Volledige marathon bestaat uit twee rondes van de halve marathon, start in het donker en eindigt in daglicht
14 waterposten op de marathonroute, met Powerade en bananen op geselecteerde punten
additional: Race packet pickup is at the Grand Ballroom of Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort on June 4th (08:00-17:00) and June 5th (08:00-12:30). The race features a Track & Trace app for live tracking. The full marathon has a 6-hour time limit with a sweeper vehicle enforcing cutoffs. Post-race celebrations include awards ceremonies and beach parties on both race days. Participants receive a personalized start number, timing chip, finisher medal, and a complimentary UV-protective dry fit running shirt. Het parcours omvat stranden en stadswegen; registratie vereist ID en leeftijdsverificatie; race dag activiteiten omvatten prijsuitreikingen en feestelijke strandparty.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre course from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and a sense of community, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite sports. The fastest relay teams take around 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at approximately 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging in distance from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams entering the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. Race packs can be sent by post (the shipping option can be booked until 31.03.2026) or collected at one of two collection times (22 May, 10:00–18:00; 29 May, 13:00–20:00). The race starts at the Hafenspitze in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route includes 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at level crossings. Relay marathon, registration opens on 13 June 2025, various stages, team and individual participation, refreshments and accommodation on site

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a varied running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for Bambini runners to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a slight cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all ages, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a slight cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon
additional: The €3.00 late-entry fee does not apply to the 400 m and 1,500 m events for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in all weather. Age groups are determined in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, participation in all weather, various age groups

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbach Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The run is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various race distances for children, school students, and adults. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and scenic course around Lingelbach. Entry fees are paid in cash at the race-number collection.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes offering a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The entry fee must be paid in cash at race-number collection. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures of around 23°C; there are various categories, including children’s races and walking. Cash payment is available on site.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Anmeldung zum regulären Preis ist bis zum 01.06.2026 möglich.

description: The 41st Silberberglauf on 6 June 2026 offers runners and walkers varied routes around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as children’s races over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all ages and ability levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup, and promises a lively sporting atmosphere with refreshments, medals and award ceremonies. The children’s sports festival in the afternoon makes the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 600 metres of elevation gain
11 km route with approximately 250 metres of elevation gain and a Nordic walking category
Children’s races and children’s sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race number collection on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for the main races; children’s race numbers from 14:00. Last-minute registration on site until 08:30 for the main races and until 14:40 for the children’s races. Refreshments along the routes and at the sports ground, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals and certificates. Carrying poles is compulsory on the 11 km route; running is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs and bicycle accompaniment are not permitted for safety reasons. The finish closes for all routes at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, safety rules concerning equipment, participation in multiple cups

name: Wolfhager Volkslauf Rund um den Graner Berg
2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique “Last Human Standing” race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start together every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within one hour. Anyone who fails to complete the loop or gives up is eliminated. The race ends when only one runner remains who completes the loop within the time limit. In addition to the individual ranking, there is a team ranking for teams of up to three participants, based on the most laps completed over the course of the event.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with some steep climbs
Beautiful scenery and rewarding views
Start and finish at the Cospeda sports field in Jena
additional: Arrival is possible from 05.06.2026 at 16:00. Tent camping is available on the event grounds, but there are no spaces for caravans, campers or cars. Parking is only permitted in designated parking areas on Mühlenweg, a few minutes’ walk from the event grounds. Basic supplies of drinks, fruit, vegetables and snacks will be available during the event. The race starts at 6 a.m.; participants must bring their own food and refreshments. Tent and parking facilities are available. The participant limit has already been reached, and all places have been allocated.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
price_range: €5.00 bis €35.00 je nach Veranstaltung und Anmeldedatum
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place on 6 June 2026 in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers a range of distances from 400 m to the 42.5 km Leaders Akademie-Solling Marathon. The routes pass through the varied landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for competitive runners, recreational runners and walkers. The event is organised by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for winners.
course_highlights: 42.5 km marathon through the Solling area
A range of distances from 400 m to 42.5 km
Walking and hiking options with a 6-hour time limit
additional: Walking and hiking are available on routes of various lengths; registration for these is only available on site. It is not permitted to transfer bib numbers or to run a different distance from the one entered. Walking and hiking on the running routes have a 6-hour time limit. Several running and walking options; on-site registration available; age-based prices

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
price_range: 8,5 km: 12 EUR, Jugend 5 EUR, Schüler frei

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Schüler m/w gebohren 2010 und jünger: FREI

price_tiers.distance: Jugendliche und Erwachsene über 1,5 km & 3 km

description: The Below, Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. Alongside the main race, there are also categories for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: Route through the Wittstock Heath and forest
Natural running course with varied terrain
Refreshments provided on the course by the organizer
additional: Trophies for the overall winners of the races; certificates available on request; 2nd Sparkasse OPR School Cup, with a prize for the three schools with the most participants; late registration closes on 24.05.2025 at 9:30 a.m.; participation at your own risk; liability excluded for accidents, theft and damage; start and finish at Stadion des Friedens, Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Str.62, 16909 Wittstock. Route through the Wittstock Heath and forest; online registration; participation at your own risk

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place on 6 June 2026 in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied range of races for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green spaces and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. There are also age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, its start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 5 km loop with approximately 6 metres of elevation gain
The route passes through green spaces and runs along the Elbe
Start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square
additional: Late entries are possible at Market Square until approximately one hour before the start (18:15), for an additional fee. Showers and changing facilities are available at Gorch-Fock-Halle, approximately 250 m away. The event is part of the BSV Summer Cup and the Hamburgiade. It is organised sustainably, with reusable cups, recycled medals and waste prevention. The awards ceremony takes place at Market Square from approximately 20:15. Route along the Elbe route; registration online and on site; start at 19:15; awards ceremony at approximately 20:15; accompanying vehicles are not permitted; sustainable organisation with reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkamm Run in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest race, taking place for the 23rd time in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. The course has been adjusted because the sports field is being renovated. The race is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and inspires around 250 participants each year to achieve sporting success in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Idyllic forest route around Hahnenkamm
Routes from 1,000 m, signposted year-round
Adjusted course because the sports field is being renovated
additional: Race-number collection from 13:30 at the sports clubhouse. Children's races start from 15:00 (400 m and 600 m Bambini, 1,000 m and 2,000 m schoolchildren), followed by the awards ceremony. Youth, women's and men's races start from 17:15. The routes are divided into DLO age categories and also count toward the District Cup and the municipal rankings. Online payment of the entry fee is available, as is payment on race day. Children's running training starts in May to prepare for the race. Routes at Hahnenkamm; online registration available; late entries accepted on race day until 14:00; race-number collection at the sports clubhouse; course secured by the fire brigade; free refreshments; medical care provided by First Responders.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied running competition on the track behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers several races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and award ceremonies are provided for the top runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the track behind Oranienburg Palace
Results are based on laps completed within the time limit
Several events ranging from 15 to 60 minutes, plus children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: A maximum of 100 participants per start. Late registration fees: €2.00 for children and €5.00 for adults. Registration is exclusively online via myracepartner.com. Payment methods: direct debit and PayPal (group registrations by direct debit only). Every finisher receives a medal; certificates are available online. Award ceremonies for children’s and youth races, as well as the main races, by age group and overall standings. The event is part of the EMB-Energie-Cup Oberhavel and offers online registration and parking.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organised by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main race is a 10 km course for runners aged U20 and older, complemented by shorter races for youths and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at Badestrand InselseeHeidberg and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Start at Badestrand InselseeHeidberg in Güstrow
10 km main race for U20 and older
Shorter races for youth and children’s age groups
additional: The event includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km road race for JU14, JU16 and JU18, and a 1.2 km race for KU10 and KU12. Typical June weather in Güstrow is around 23 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 65 mm. The event is part of the regional running calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. June weather in Güstrow is typically pleasantly warm, at around 23 °C.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique nature and running experience right by the sea. Choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Run exclusively on sand, with no asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (marathon)
11 aid stations with water, sports drink, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (finish cutoff at 16:00). After the time limit, course support and refreshments are no longer provided. The relay consists of 5 legs, with at least 3 runners per team, and categories for women’s, men’s, and mixed teams. Start areas are in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a shared finish area in Ahlbeck. The finish area hosts a professional program with entertainment and information from 10:00 to 18:00. Run on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, refreshments, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers included.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
location: Wremen, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wremer Deichlauf is the traditional highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities. Two courses are offered: a short 5,300-meter loop and a long 15,900-meter course through the green marshland. The routes run mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads, and also go outside the dike directly alongside the water and tidal flats. The short loop also features a separate walking event.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads
Run directly alongside the water and tidal flats on the Treibselräumweg
Two distances: 5.3 km and 15.9 km through the green marshland
additional: Walking event on the 5,300-meter loop. The event is the highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season. The courses are mostly paved and also run outside the dike alongside the water. Routes mostly follow paved cycle paths or farm roads; run along the water and tidal flats; walking event on the short course.

name: De brabantse wal marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Eiberrun
description: De Eiberrun is een gezellig en sportief hardloopevenement in Eibergen, dat plaatsvindt op zondag 6 juni 2027. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit verschillende afstanden, waaronder 5 km, 10 km, een bedrijvenrun, kidsruns en een spectaculaire Urban Fun Run voor de jeugd. Het evenement start en finisht op het gezellige sportplein De Brink, dat speciaal voor deze dag wordt omgetoverd tot een levendige locatie. De routes voeren door het dorp en het Mallumse buitengebied, met uitdagende en leuke parcoursen voor alle leeftijden en niveaus.
course_highlights: 10 km afstand loopt twee keer het 5 km rondje door dorp en Mallumse buitengebied
Start en finish op het gezellige sportplein De Brink
Urban Fun Run met een route door winkels en over obstakels in het dorp
additional: Startnummers met tijdsregistratiechip liggen klaar bij het inschrijfbureau op De Brink. Afhalen kan zaterdag 5 juni (tijd nog te bepalen) en zondag 6 juni vanaf 09:00 tot een half uur voor de start. Bij inschrijving vóór 31 mei 12:00 uur staat de naam op het startnummer. Na-inschrijving is mogelijk op de wedstrijddag vanaf 09:00 uur tegen een hoger tarief. Prijsuitreiking vindt plaats rond 12:00 en 13:00 uur. De Eiberrun biedt ook clinics en trainingen aan via ASV Eibergen ter voorbereiding. Inschrijving voor de editie op 6 juni 2027 is open, met ook clinics en vrijwilligersmogelijkheden. Het evenement start en eindigt op sportplein De Brink, waar ook de gezellige sfeer wordt ervaren.

name: Alemannia Stadtparklauf
location: Aachener Stadtpark, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Aachener Stadtparklauf by CAROLUS THERMEN takes place in the picturesque Aachen City Park and offers a pleasant running atmosphere away from roads. The course follows winding park paths and showcases the park’s special beauty. Races are offered over 2 km, 4 km and 8 km, as well as a 600 m schoolchildren’s race and a Bambini race for the youngest runners. The start and finish are by the large fountain on Monheimsallee, where refreshments and a supporting program are also available. Since 2024, the Stadtparklauf has been part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup.
course_highlights: Winding paths through Aachen City Park
Start and finish by the large fountain on Monheimsallee
Distances: 2 km, 4 km, 8 km, 600 m schoolchildren’s race and Bambini race
additional: The start and finish are by the large fountain, with the race office, race-number collection, a refreshment station and a supporting program. Easily accessible via several bus routes, with a large public car park nearby. Results and certificates are usually available online shortly after the event. The event takes place in Aachen City Park and features various race distances, children’s races and a supporting program. Registration is online, and results are available shortly after the race.

name: Obermosel Trail
location: Sportplatz Wasserliesch, Wasserliesch, Trier-Saarburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Obermosel Trail makes its debut on May 31, 2026, in Wasserliesch. The event offers varied courses through the impressive landscape of the Upper Moselle, suitable for ambitious trail runners, recreational runners, walkers, and young athletes. Distances range from 5 km to 33 km, with the 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km courses also available for walking. The start and finish are at the Wasserliesch sports ground, and the event places emphasis on well-marked courses, refreshment stations, and medical support.
course_highlights: Technically challenging single-track trails with roots and small hills
Vineyards with steep climbs and scenic views
Wide gravel tracks and forest and meadow paths offering varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the Wasserliesch sports ground until 30 minutes before each start. A mandatory briefing takes place 15 minutes before every start. The event ends for all participants at 7:00 p.m. Refreshment stations with drinks and fruit are available along the course and in the finish area. Carrying a mobile phone is expressly recommended. Dogs are not allowed. It is possible to switch to another distance, but there is no refund for switching to a shorter course or for not participating. Race bibs are personal and may not be transferred. Travel by train, bicycle, or car is possible; parking areas are signposted, but the car park directly at the sports ground will be closed on the event day. Several courses are available, including youth races and walking options; start and finish at the Wasserliesch sports ground; registration runs from March to May 2026.

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The routes pass through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and offer a top-level sporting experience. In the shade of the Salzkotten saltworks, runners can enjoy a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chill-out area. All event proceeds go directly to youth programs run by local clubs, supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course of approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured and compliant with IWR/DLO rules
Loop course with around 25 metres of elevation gain; flat 10 km course ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary by distance: the marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, the 10 km race at 10:30, the 5 km race at 11:30, and the Bambini races from 15:30, with different start times for each age group. The courses are officially measured and comply with international competition rules. On event day, roads through the town and side streets will be closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. A supervised bicycle parking area is available at the Sälzerhalle car park in exchange for a voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for a stress-free journey and parking search. The marathon places particular emphasis on community and team spirit, with company teams able to take part in the team competition. The event also offers parking, pacemaker teams, and a family program.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf on 7 June 2026 is a varied popular and cross-country running event in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all abilities. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes follow the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, passing through the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trails and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trails along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon routes
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number collection are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are offered for the Fun Run (1 km), Schoolchildren’s Run (2.5 km), Everyone’s Run (5 km), Main Run (15 km) and Half Marathon (21.1 km). A raffle with great prizes is held for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Benrather Schlosslauf 2026
location: Schlosspark Schloss Benrath, Düsseldorf-Benrath, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 14 EUR (5 km), 16 EUR (10 km), 3 EUR (Bambinilauf), 7 EUR (Schülerlauf), 0 EUR (Inklusionslauf), 15 EUR (Staffel)
description: The Benrath Palace Run takes place on June 7, 2026, in the park of Benrath Palace in Düsseldorf-Benrath. The event offers 5 km and 10 km runs, both on flat, shaded paths through the park. There are also shorter runs for children, school groups, and people with disabilities, making this a family-friendly and inclusive event. The course starts and finishes on the palace’s north terrace and is easily accessible by public transport.
course_highlights: Flat, shaded paths in Benrath Palace Park
One 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km
Start and finish on the north terrace of Benrath Palace
additional: The program also includes a 1.44 km schoolchildren’s run, a free PAULI inclusion run, a Bambini run, and a primary-school relay. The U72 tram stops right by Benrath Palace, and Benrath station is a 10-minute walk away. In June, average temperatures of 23 °C and mostly sunny weather can be expected. Medals for all participants, trophies for winners, cash prizes for kindergartens, late entries possible for a fee, dogs and jogging strollers not permitted, start and finish at Benrath Palace, easily accessible by public transport.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running programme with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic course follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere. Special and team classifications add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A range of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
The Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services will be stationed at the finish and along the course. Late entries are possible online until 11 June 2026 and on the day of the event until 1 hour before the respective start. Photos and videos will be taken by a commissioned service provider and may be published. The Deichlauf in Greven drew over 800 participants in June 2026, with distances from 2 km to 10 km, including climbs, and suitable for all age groups. The event is a community event with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The Mainauenlauf 2026 takes place on June 14 on the grounds of the former State Garden Show in Bayreuth. The scenic, challenging, undulating course runs through green parks with wonderful panoramic views over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish in the Finisher Park, with excellent refreshments and a unique finisher medal. City championships will also be held across all distances for the first time.
course_highlights: Challenging, undulating 5 km loop with 85 meters of elevation gain per lap
Highest point on the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park, with refreshments and a medal
additional: Showers are open at the Ost school center until 3:00 p.m. There is a photo booth in the start/finish area. Bag drop is available in the Finisher Park, with bags to be collected by 3:00 p.m. Group warm-up run on Saturday at 6:30 p.m. in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6, and 7 provide water, isotonic drinks, baked goods, and fruit. Restrooms are available near the finish area and at the Ost sports center. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races; start on the State Garden Show grounds; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park

name: Taunussteiner Waldlauf 30.7
description: The Taunusstein Forest Run is a long-established running event that has attracted around 700 runners to the scenic forests and hills of the Lower Taunus every year for over 30 years. The main 15-kilometre course offers a demanding challenge, with varied terrain and around 250 metres of elevation gain. Shorter distances of 5 and 2 kilometres are available for beginners and children, making them ideal for getting a taste of competition. The event stands out for its varied scenery and lively programme in the finish area.
course_highlights: Scenic, varied routes through forests and fields between Hahn, Wingsbach and Watzhahn
Main 15 km course with around 250 metres of elevation gain and demanding terrain
Refreshment stations at km 3, 6, 7, 10 and 13 on the 15 km course
additional: Start and finish at Gesamtschule Obere Aar (Pestalozzistraße 3, 65232 Taunusstein). Race-number collection from 07:30 in the cafeteria of IGS Obere Aar; runners are advised to collect their numbers at least 40 minutes before the start. The time limit for the 15 km race is 2:30 hours. All finishers receive a medal. The fastest men and women in each distance receive prizes, which are awarded only on race day. Participants in the 2 km race take part in a raffle. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Walkers are welcome and are classified separately, but receive no prizes. On-site late registration is available for a €2 fee. Results and certificates are available online. Refreshments, cake, grilled food and drinks are available in the start/finish area. The event is family-friendly, welcomes walkers, and offers refreshments and drinks in the finish area. Registration is available both online and on site.

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V.
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt City Run on June 7, 2026, is an accessible community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge that promotes community and inclusion. The race stands for togetherness and brings friends together through shared exercise. Every step strengthens social bonds and sends a message in support of an inclusive future. The race is open to all age groups and combines sport with social commitment.
course_highlights: Accessible race promoting inclusive participation
Togetherness and social connection
Community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge
additional: The race is designed to be accessible and promote inclusion. There is a running championship for primary schools. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V. Accessible, inclusive, community-focused, community race, parking at Schulzentrum Süd and Gymnasium, changing rooms, showers, bag storage in the TSV club building.

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens and sights of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With over 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for running enthusiasts of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the many impressions along the route through the city’s history.
course_highlights: Run past historic palaces, churches, parks and gardens
Route along lakes, rivers and bridges, and through the Russian Colony
Temporary road closures in central Potsdam and the surrounding area
additional: The race takes place on 7 June 2026 from 09:00 to 12:00. The route is temporarily closed to traffic in several sections and reopened after the runners have passed. Start-place transfers are possible through the davengo account until 30 April 2026, and after that only via a re-registration form until 20 May 2026. The day before, 6 June 2026, a sports activity day featuring activities and exercise stations for families and children will take place at Sportpark Luftschiffhafen. Routes, start times, fees, special-edition T-shirt, pasta party, certificate for download, age restrictions, race numbers and timing with EasyChip, online registration, run past historic landmarks

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
location: Park Schönfeld, Kassel-Wehlheiden, Kassel, Hesse, Germany
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a long-standing recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas
5 km out-and-back course
Children’s races in the Angerstation, with distances of 400 m and 1000 m
additional: The wearing of spikes is prohibited. Bib numbers must be worn clearly visible; safety pins are not provided. Changing and shower facilities are available, but have no windows and therefore pose an infection risk. The event is part of the Nordhessencup and the HLV Running Cup. Advance registration is mandatory; on-the-day registration is not possible. The event takes place in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a series of running events in North Hesse.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
price_range: additional fee for late entries, exact price not specified
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race taking place on June 7, 2026, in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km) on road and trail courses, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organized by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are scored according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with specific age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.
course_highlights: Start at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building in Bleicherode
Four distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km on road and trail courses
German Athletics Association age-group system, with age restrictions for schoolchildren
additional: Race-day registration is available for all distances, including the 2 km and U12 races, for an extra fee. Trophies for the overall winners of the 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km races. Certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Courses through woodland with elevation gain, various distances, youth races, registration via Race Result

description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. On June 7, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various distances, including 5 kilometers, 10 kilometers, a fun run, and a Bambini run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free courses and is supported by the police, THW, and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun, and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Traffic-free courses in a closed-off area
Start and finish at Moorbek Stadium in Norderstedt
The 10-kilometer run consists of two 5-kilometer laps
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the shoe. The course is kept traffic-free and secured by the police, THW, and volunteers. The start and finish are at Moorbek Stadium, Moorbekstraße 25, Norderstedt. There are different start times: the 5 km runs start at 9:00 a.m., Nordic walking at 9:05 a.m., and the 10 km run at 9:50 a.m. Late entries are possible for an additional fee until race day. Baby joggers and animals are not allowed on the course. Online registration is available; late registration is available on site. Race numbers and medals for winners are provided, and results are available online.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Eversten Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg, taking place on June 7, 2026. Various races are offered, including children’s races, a company and fun run over 6.3 km, and a 10 km road race. The course runs through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large field of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start on Wienstraße, finish in Eversten Holz
10 km road race with three laps plus 400 m
6.3 km company and fun run with team scoring
additional: The start and finish are in Eversten: the start is on Wienstraße, and the finish is in Eversten Holz. Feststraße Sports Hall serves as the venue for registration, bib collection, changing and showers, as well as the awards ceremony. There is a €5 late registration fee; late registration is only possible on the Saturday before the race. Free entry is available to fast 10 km runners who provide proof of their personal bests. Parking is recommended at the large Prinzessinweg Park & Ride car park. Participants can look forward to various categories, such as the company run and IT-City-Battle; detailed information about registration and results is available on the website.

name: Frankenthaler Strohhutfestlauf
description: The Frankenthal Straw Hat Festival Run 2026 takes place on Sunday, June 7, from 10:00 a.m. The event offers races for all age groups, including a 120-meter Bambini Run, a 2.7-kilometer schoolchildren’s run, and a 5.5-kilometer main run. The aim is to get active together, have fun, and turn Frankenthal pink. The event is organized by Landfrauenverband Pfalz e.V. and welcomes everyone—members, families, friends, and anyone interested—for a sporty and cheerful day.
course_highlights: Bambini Run (120 m) for the youngest participants
Schoolchildren’s run over 2.7 km
Main run over 5.5 km
additional: When registering, please use the spelling LandFrauen Lambsheim (with a capital F). Registration is also possible via the QR code on the flyer or through Alice Höfer. Several distances are available: Bambini Run (120 m), schoolchildren’s run (2.7 km), and main run (5.5 km). Register online or on the day of the event. The course is in the city of Frankenthal. Festive atmosphere with award ceremonies.

description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all ages and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The route passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”
course_highlights: Bambini race with parents over one lap of the stadium
Inclusive fun run over 2.3 km
Short course/walking: 5.5 km
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 11 a.m. until 30 minutes before the respective start. The late registration fee for the 5 km and 10 km races is €3; there is no late registration fee for the inclusive fun run. Entry fees are collected by direct debit for online registrations. Race packs can be picked up in advance at Active Sportshop Osnabrück. Toilets and showers are available at the sports field. The cool “Jede Oma zählt” running shirt can be purchased for €25, while supplies last. All participants receive medals (except in the short- and long-distance races, where trophies are awarded to the top three women and men). Terrain: stadium and road race; registration online and on site; dogs and jogging strollers are not allowed.

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Run is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place on June 7, 2026, in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Saxony-Anhalt Athletics Association and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register via the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and course recommendations apply.
course_highlights: A variety of courses for different age groups
Part of the renowned Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt
Event in the Magdeburg sports region
additional: All races must be registered via the LADV registration portal. The age-group and course recommendations must be observed. The event is part of the State Cup, a series of races across Saxony-Anhalt. The race takes place in typical June weather, with temperatures around 13–23°C. Registration is through the state association’s official channels. The event is open to all age groups and promotes running in the region.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The Run around the Himmelsschaukel in Bründersen is a traditional scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup. A range of distances from 400 metres to 20 kilometres is offered, suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to seniors. The event takes place at the Bründersen sports ground and features a varied course through the beautiful surrounding area. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines sporting competition with community spirit and regional ties.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m to 20 km
Scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup
Venue: Bründersen sports ground, surrounded by nature
additional: Age groups: Bambini, children U10 to U12, youth U14–U18, senior women and men. The venue is the Bründersen sports ground, Naumburger Straße 60, 34466 Wolfhagen. The race is part of the club life of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. The race features a varied course through the picturesque surroundings of Bründersen. Results and further details are available on the official website.

name: Pfreimdtaltrail 2026
description: The Pfreimdtaltrail is a trail half marathon around Trausnitz, taking place on 7 June 2026. The course covers approximately 21 kilometres with around 450 metres of elevation gain and features varied landscapes along the Pfreimd, including steep climbs, downhill sections and scenic stretches on the Goldsteig. The event is registered as a UTMB Index Race and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Alongside the sporting challenge, the race offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with refreshments, an awards ceremony and food and drink provided by TSV Trausnitz.
course_highlights: Steep climb straight after the start, with most of the elevation gain coming before kilometre 8
Long downhill section after the first refreshment point at the Hochspeicher
Scenic 5-kilometre stretch along the Goldsteig, with a riverside route and several refreshment points
additional: Race-number collection from 7:30 a.m.; late registration available until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability; participant limit of 250; refreshments at several points; free photos in JPG format; awards ceremony with prizes; coffee, cake and barbecue provided by TSV Trausnitz; pre-event course-check runs require registration by email. Trail of approximately 21 km with 450 m of elevation gain; registration on an external website; course checks and a T-shirt for registrations by 15 April.

name: Schwäbische Zeitung Halbmarathon
description: The Schwäbische Zeitung Half Marathon in Sigmaringen is a challenging and inspiring running event organized by a dedicated team of runners for runners. The event offers a beautiful setting and ideal conditions for personal bests or running for a good cause. The organizing team places great importance on community, safety, and a great atmosphere along the course. The Limitless Hybrid Running Club supports participants with group training sessions and individual training plans.
course_highlights: Beautiful setting in Sigmaringen
Professional course planning and safety
Refreshment stations along the course
additional: Group training with the Limitless Hybrid Running Club and LG Winterlingen, training times: Sunday at 10:00 and Thursday at 17:30. Individual training plans available. Course profile, start times, race categories, refreshment stations, awards ceremony, parking, pacemakers, sponsors, timing

name: Spechaa Lauf Spöck
description: The 5th Spechaa Run takes place on June 7, 2026, as part of the TV sports festival in Stutensee-Spöck. Events include a 10 km main race, a 5 km beginner’s race, and a 5 km walking course. The routes follow forest and agricultural paths, starting and finishing at the TV sports grounds. The races are part of the Stutensee Cup, with individual and team standings alongside other races in the region.
course_highlights: Routes on forest and agricultural paths
Start and finish at the TV sports grounds in Spöck
Part of the Stutensee Cup, with standings across multiple races
additional: The race is part of the TV sports festival. There are individual and team standings for the Stutensee Cup, which includes other races in the region. The routes start and finish at the TV sports grounds. Registration is online only, and results are available online.

The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

The start is at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe, and the finish is at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional entry points at 13, 10 and 5 km; walking routes are up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place on June 11, 2026, in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and follows flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of an opening section of 1.7 km followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere with no organizational fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

Loop course with 10 laps of 4.06 km each around Bugasee
Start and finish in front of the information sign between Restaurant Strandbar and parking lot P1

The event promotes inclusion and combines exercise with a sense of community.

name: Gaperloop
description: De Gaperloop is een snel en vlak hardloopevenement dat jaarlijks plaatsvindt in Gapinge. De race biedt twee afstanden, 5 km en 10 km, en trekt zowel recreatieve als competitieve lopers aan. Met een starttijd van 19:30 in de avond is het een ideale loop voor wie van een snelle, gezellige wedstrijd houdt. De Gaperloop wordt georganiseerd door Loopgroep Gonzalez en heeft een lange traditie met inmiddels acht edities.
course_highlights: Vlak en snel parcours
Twee afstanden: 5 km en 10 km
Starttijd in de avond om 19:30
additional: De inschrijving voor de Gaperloop start in maart 2026. Er zijn categorieën voor mannen en vrouwen, zowel open als 40+. De race is inmiddels volgeboekt voor 2026. De organisatie is Loopgroep Gonzalez. De race wordt gehouden op 11 juni 2027 om 19:30, met categorieën voor verschillende leeftijden en prijzen voor topfinishers. Deelnemen is op eigen risico, en alle finishers ontvangen een paar hardloopgapersokken.

name: Loop door Houten
description: Loop door Houten is een sfeervol hardloopevenement dat jaarlijks plaatsvindt in het centrum van Houten. De loop biedt diverse afstanden, van de Kidsrun en Jeugdloop voor basisschoolkinderen tot de 5 en 10 kilometer, de SAMSAMLOOP voor duo's en een teamloop voor teams van vier lopers. Het parcours voert door het Oude Dorp en Castellum, met een finish op Het Plein, en staat bekend om zijn gezellige sfeer en enthousiaste deelnemers. Vrijwilligers spelen een belangrijke rol in het succes van het evenement, dat ook een feest is van samen lopen en vieren.
course_highlights: Kidsrun en Jeugdloop door het Oude Dorp met meerdere doorkomsten over Het Plein
5 en 10 km parcours met waterposten in Castellum en doorkomst op Het Plein
Teamloop waarbij vier lopers samen finishen na wissels op verschillende punten
additional: Startnummers kunnen op de dag van de loop vanaf 16:00 uur tot 19:15 uur worden opgehaald in de zaal van de Roskam op het Oude Dorp. Na-inschrijving is digitaal mogelijk tot 18:00 uur op de dag van de loop, zolang het maximum aantal deelnemers niet is bereikt. Voorinschrijving start op 15 maart. De loop kent een warming-up voor de Kidsrun/Jeugdloop en wandelen om 17:45 uur, met start van de wandelingen om 18:00 uur, Kidsrun om 18:10 uur, Jeugdloop om 18:25 uur, SAMSAMLOOP om 19:10 uur en 5, 10 km en Teamloop om 19:40 uur. Er is een prijsuitreiking voor diverse categorieën na afloop. Er worden trainingsmogelijkheden en parcoursverkenningen aangeboden voorafgaand aan het evenement. De organisatie vraagt deelnemers om zich goed voor te bereiden, ook met tips voor lopen bij hoge temperaturen. Afstanden variëren van Kidsrun (1 km) tot 10 km, inclusief Jeugdloop en SAMSAMLOOP; inschrijving en vrijwilligers gezocht; evenement vindt plaats in Houten.

The event offers races for all ages, from Bambini to adults, and runs through various parts of Neumünster. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.

From short, free Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and firefighters’ race, there is something for everyone. The flat, paved courses run through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km route through the countryside at the same time.

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place on June 12, 2026, at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in its tried-and-tested format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants, with shorter distances, while the longer races are the main attraction in the evening. Particularly popular are the relay races for Bambini and youth, as well as the Nordic walking event along the scenic Ruhr Valley Cycle Route. The 10 km course is measured according to DLV criteria and follows a loop over paved and surfaced paths through a wooded area, finishing in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured according to DLV criteria
Loop over the paved Ruhr Valley Cycle Route and surfaced forest paths
Finish in the stadium at the GWG Schwerte Arena

The entry fee includes timing via a disposable transponder, a personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen clubhouse, baggage storage without liability, water stations for the 5 km and 10 km races, and drinks in the finish area. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The event offers a variety of running opportunities for all age groups and supports community sport. Registration is via the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

Events include races for schoolchildren and young people, a 10 km main race and an inclusive race. The event is family-friendly, with suitable competitions for all age groups.

The races follow a very scenic route, with several refreshment stations to look after participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe, smooth experience; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.

description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a long-standing three-day event that covers approximately 82 km from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, to Steinau, where the collectors of fairy tales spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for recreational runners as well as competitive athletes. It follows historic trade routes, passing historic buildings, scenic attractions, and spa and recreation resorts in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley. The event takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026, and registration opens on 11 November 2025.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km from Hanau to Steinau, divided into 5 stages

Scenic attractions and spa resorts in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly paved, with some sections through open countryside and forest. The elevation profile is flat, with only minimal inclines (maximum elevation approximately 130 m). The stages include cycle paths, forest trails, and paved paths, among other surfaces. Stage starts and finishes are in various towns along the route, such as Niederrodenbach and Neuenhaßlau. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. Multi-day running event, 5 stages, registration opens on 11 November 2025, participant limit: 550, individual stage registration available.

The courses pass through Rathausplatz and the IGS grounds, as well as along Meyenfelder Straße and by Lake Berenbostel. The course runs along the dike and offers an attractive running backdrop. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and attracts around 2,000 participants each year.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derentaler Löwenlauf is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a sporting family festival for all age groups. The event offers various distances that lead through the beautiful Derentaler countryside and the Steinbach Valley. A particular focus is placed on embracing diversity, tolerance and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” foundation for each participant. The race is organised with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run with no timing, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometre routes. The 10 km loop starts at the market square and follows the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and along the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The 5 km route also starts at the market square and follows the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The run is a great opportunity to experience the region on varied routes.
