The entry fee includes a T-shirt and medal for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt optionally for €15.00. The event takes place whatever the weather. Participation is at your own risk. Trophies and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each distance and category, and cash prizes go to the fastest team. Multiple race distances, team competition, online registration via RUNTIMING, no late entries on the event day, medals and T-shirts for participants

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony, and Hesse. The event offers several race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 13 km, with a mix of loop courses and out-and-back routes. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Arenshausen sports field
Loop courses for the 1.2 km, 2 km, and 13 km races
5 km race is an out-and-back route with a lap of the stadium
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the starts, with a late-entry surcharge of 2.00 EUR, except for the children's races. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports building. Parking is available directly at the Arenshausen sports field. Nordic walking (approx. 8 km) starts at approx. 14:00 with no rankings and no entry fee. The 400 m fun run is for preschool children, with no timing or placings. There is no entry fee for the main race. Online registration is open from 01.05. to 11.06.2026. Parking and changing and shower facilities in the sports building are available.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
location: Sportplatz Schackensleben, Schackensleben, Börde, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Schackensleben Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. All races start and finish at the sports field. Distances include 400 m for children, 1.4 km for young people, and 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes pass through the village and the surrounding countryside, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region, along roads and paved farm tracks. Refreshments include drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food. After the finish, there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.
course_highlights: Routes through the village and nearby area, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region
Roads and paved farm tracks, with several drink stations
Start and finish at the sports field, with good changing and shower facilities
additional: The 0.4 km and 1.4 km races take place on the running track and in the immediate vicinity. After finishing, participants receive drinks and fruit for refreshment. The clubhouse at the sports field offers a generous selection of coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks, and grilled food. A raffle with attractive prizes traditionally takes place alongside the awards ceremony. Multiple distances, online registration, changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and a raffle. Supports the German athletics system through official timekeeping.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course, starting and finishing at Ballindamm. Alongside the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run, a 1-kilometre race for girls aged 5 to 10. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and can use the showers and changing facilities after the race.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km loop course according to IWB and AIMS
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg
1 km Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available after the race at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz. A bag drop is available for personal belongings. The race number includes a disposable timing chip and must be attached visibly to the running shirt. Photos can be purchased from a photography partner after the race. The event also includes a 1 km Girls’ Run for girls aged 5 to 10, starting at 11:30. Changing facilities, showers and refreshments are available on site.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkassen City Run on June 14, 2026, offers a range of races for everyone from beginners to half-marathon runners through Heidenheim city center. The half marathon follows two nearly identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as St. Paul’s Church, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as student and Bambini races. All participants receive chip timing via a transponder integrated into their bib number and ample refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Half marathon on two nearly identical laps through Heidenheim
The course runs through the city center and Brenzpark, passing the Schlossarkaden
Finish area beside St. Paul’s Church, with strong spectator support
additional: Timing uses a disposable transponder in the bib number. Technical shirts featuring the city run design can be ordered when registering. Baggage drop-off is available from 7 a.m. in the Rathaus underground garage. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross. Awards ceremonies take place in front of St. Paul’s Church. Photos will be posted online after the race. Event in Heidenheim with various race distances, online and on-site registration, bib number collection, medical support, baggage storage, and race-day refreshments.

name: Hohenneuffen-Berglauf mit BW Trail
description: The 37th Hohenneuffen Mountain Race takes place on June 14, 2026, in Linsenhofen, finishing at Hohenneuffen Castle. The main course is 9.3 km long, with approximately 535 m of elevation gain and 180 m of descent. There is also the 24th Students’ Mountain Race, with various distances and elevation gains, open to children from first grade onward. The start is in Balzholz at the town hall, and the finish is at the kindergarten on Jahnstraße. We look forward to welcoming many runners from near and far.
course_highlights: 9.3 km course with approx. +535 / -180 m of elevation change
Start in Balzholz at the town hall; finish at Hohenneuffen Castle
Students’ Mountain Race with distances from 1.56 km to 3.25 km and up to 100 m of elevation gain
additional: Course length approx. 9.3 km, elevation change approx. +535 / -180 m, online registration, children’s and youth races, start in Linsenhofen, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 takes place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects the two cities with varied routes, numerous races, and a colorful program of activities. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of exercise, fun, and community. Races range from the marathon and half marathon to 10K races and Nordic walking, as well as children’s and youth races.
course_highlights: Start in Fürth, finish at Hauptmarkt in Nuremberg
Varied routes with plenty of refreshment stations
Professional support from the Laufteam Fürth 2010 and Team Klinikum Nürnberg clubs
additional: Pacemakers are available for the half marathon and marathon. Participants can download personalized certificates, and medical care, changing facilities, and showers are provided. A prize draw is offered for participants who also take part in the DATAGROUP Triathlon Nürnberg 2026. Races: marathon, half marathon, 10K, Nordic walking, youth race, KIDSmarathon; start in Fürth, finish in Nuremberg; activities along the course; refreshments, pacemakers, certificates, medical care, changing facilities, and showers

name: Nesselwanger Seenlauf
description: The 1st Nesselwang Lakes Run, presented by Endress+Hauser and organised by Skiklub Nesselwang e. V., is the successor to the former company run and is open to people of all ages. The event promotes exercise and community, offering various courses for children, young people, adults and families, including routes suitable for pushchairs. The start and finish are at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event welcomes individuals as well as companies, clubs and running groups.
course_highlights: Bambini Run, approx. 0.4 km, for children born 2019–2021
Children’s Run, approx. 1.6 km, for U10, U12 and U14
Lakes Run, approx. 10.7 km, starting and finishing at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu
additional: Start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event includes several races: Bambini Run (0.4 km), Children’s Run (1.6 km), Village Run (5.2 km) and Lakes Run (10.7 km). The run is also suitable for families with pushchairs. Courses for children, families, companies and clubs; registration until 4 June 2026; participation from age 4; various races including the Bambini Run, Children’s Run, Village Run and Lakes Run.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-City Run in Erkelenz on June 14, 2026, is a popular running event that takes runners of all ability levels through the city centre. The event offers a sporting, community-focused atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an electrifying atmosphere, the NEW-City Run is a highlight of the regional events calendar. Taking part is an invitation to enjoy the joy of running together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Course through Erkelenz city centre
Varied running course
Sporting atmosphere and shared experience
additional: The event takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026. Registration and further information are available at www.new.de/laufserie. The organiser is the City of Erkelenz; contact is available through City Marketing. Run in the city centre, anniversary event, for all ability levels

name: saarBRÜCKENlauf
description: Laufgemeinschaft Saarbrücken warmly invites you to the saarBRÜCKENlauf, a guided run across (almost) all of the state capital Saarbrücken’s bridges. Two distances are offered: a 10 km loop with 7 bridges and a 20 km loop with 17 different bridges. This is not a race but a leisurely run with different pace groups, allowing participants to tackle the challenging route—with ramps, stairs and frequent changes of direction—together. The run starts at 10 a.m. at the Kulturbiergarten opposite the Römerbrücke power plant.
course_highlights: Guided run across (almost) all of Saarbrücken’s bridges over the Saar
Two distances: 10 km with 7 bridges and 20 km with 17 bridges
Challenging route with ramps, stairs and frequent changes of direction
additional: Pace groups are available (60, 70 and 80 minutes for the shorter distance; 2:00, 2:20 and 2:40 hours for the longer distance). No timing and no race numbers. Participation is only for adequately trained runners with no health concerns. This is not a race but a leisurely run. Because of the route, groups should stay together; runners may drop back to a slower group. The guided run has no timing, is suitable for groups and includes refreshments in the finish area at the Kulturbiergarten. The event is suitable only for fit runners.

name: Sparkassenlauf
location: Hessisch Lichtenau, Landkreis Kassel, Hessen, Germany
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-standing running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races run through Wittringer Forest and offer a flat, fast loop course on paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalized race bib with their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road-running championships and offers net times and live timing.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop course through Wittringer Forest on paved walking paths and asphalt
Start and finish at the stadium on Bohmertstraße, with the finish on the tartan track
Two refreshment stations along the course, with additional stations if needed
additional: Personalized race bibs with first names for all participants. Net times and live timing are provided. The course is DLV-certified and eligible for rankings through 2027. Official bike escorts and marshals help ensure the runners move safely through the course. The Fun Walk cutoff time is 10:15. The race is part of the district championships and offers medals, shirts and a festive atmosphere, including live results and personal support.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund is a traditional running event held annually in Kappeln in the Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on a varied course through the town and its surroundings. The race is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with a well-organized program and helpful support.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town of Kappeln and the surrounding countryside
Varied terrain with urban and natural sections
Well-marked course with support along the way
additional: The event is organized by TSV Kappeln, which also offers other sports activities and training times for various sports. A participant list, results, and a live list for following the race are available. Further details about the schedule, course, timing, and awards are available on the website. The event includes running and Nordic walking competitions; results are usually available shortly after the finish, and activities are offered for children and young people.

name: TVE-Sommerlauf 2026
description: The TVE Summer Run is a traditional public race organised by Turnverein 1890 Edingen e.V. in Edingen-Neckarhausen. The event offers races for various age groups, from the youngest participants to seniors, with official timing and certificates. The course has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for rankings. Runners enjoy a varied route along the Neckar, with the start and finish in the stadium.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sports and Leisure Centre, including a lap of the running track
The route passes the Fischkinderstube and follows the Neckar towards Wieblingen
Officially measured course eligible for rankings
additional: Late entries are possible until one hour before the start of the respective races, provided the participant limit has not been reached; a late-entry fee of 3 euros applies. Certificates can be downloaded online and printed out. Age-group and overall winner classifications are held, with prizes for places 1–3. Running and Nordic walking event, various distances, registration until 13 June 2026

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Freizeit-, Vereins- und Schulteams beträgt 70 € (10 € pro Starter)

description: The Alfeld Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is jointly organized by several local running clubs and the City of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using single-use transponders. There is also a children’s run of approximately 700 m.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km loop, to be completed twice
Start and finish on the market square in front of the citizens’ office
Route through the town center and parks, with a varied course
additional: Each relay team consists of 7 people, who must be registered by name and run in the order specified on the day of the event. Bib numbers are personalized and equipped with single-use transponders for electronic timing. Participants may keep their bib numbers as souvenirs. A maximum of 80 teams may take part. The children’s run starts at 10:30 a.m. for girls and 10:45 a.m. for boys, over approximately 700 m. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere, including preparation and training sessions, and is a major event in the regional running calendar.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Volkslauf is a traditional running event held every June at the sports ground in the Barsbüttel Sports Centre. It offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, mostly on flat, paved or firm sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: The routes are mostly flat and follow paved or firm sandy farm tracks
Routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views
The 10 km route runs along a small avenue and past the Stapelfelder Moor
additional: Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. The shortest distance (400 m) takes place entirely on the stadium’s tartan track. The 1 km and 2 km routes partly leave the stadium; the longer routes (5 km and 10 km) offer beautiful views and follow firm sandy tracks and paved farm roads. Food and refreshments are available for runners and spectators. Event on roads, registration online via TrainerDay, refreshments for participants and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge for endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is for runners ready to take on a genuine test while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 48-hour run with distances of 43.2 km and 172.8 km
Venue in Unna, with typical June weather around 23 °C and mostly sunny skies
Charity event focused on endurance and willpower
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The run takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026; registration is open until 11 June 2026. Donations go to the German Children’s Hospice Service and NABU.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four different distances: a 21.1 km half marathon, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and has more of a friendly club-run feel than that of a large competition.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half marathon
Distances ranging from 1000 m to 21.1 km
Event in Fambach with a friendly club-run atmosphere
additional: The event comprises four races on the same day, including a children’s race. Participant numbers are low, suggesting a friendly club event. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23 °C. Several running distances are offered, including a half marathon, sprint, and children’s race; the event is part of the Landschaftscup 'Rhön - Thüringer Wald - Werratal'; participant numbers may be limited.

name: h Lauf Reichenau
description: The Reichenau 24-Hour Run is an extraordinary ultra-running event on the island of Reichenau, attracting individual runners, teams of six, and corporate teams. The event runs around the clock, from Saturday at noon to Sunday at noon, challenging participants’ endurance and fitness on a prepared course around Hochwart. The run has established itself as an impressive sporting challenge and attracts both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The atmosphere is defined by community spirit and sporting ambition, supported by a runners’ camp and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Loop course around Hochwart on the island of Reichenau
Run continuously for 24 hours, from Saturday at 12 noon to Sunday at 12 noon
Prepared dirt tracks and a scenic course
additional: Participation is open to individuals, teams of six, and corporate teams. A runners’ camp on the “Mofarennen-Acker” provides a place to stay. The event is organized by two running clubs. The top individual runners receive vegetables as prizes. The course runs around Hochwart on unpaved paths. The event is for recreational and professional runners, and the course is closed to traffic.

name: KarlsruheLäuft 100 Jahre Berufsfeuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: In 2026, the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade celebrates its 100th anniversary with a diverse program of events for the whole city. The anniversary includes sporting competitions, historical highlights such as a vintage vehicle gathering and hand-pump competitions, as well as ceremonies and the Schlosslichtspiele. The events offer fascinating insights into the fire brigade’s history and technology and invite everyone to celebrate and remember.
course_highlights: A range of running distances, including children’s races, relay races, 5 km and 10 km
A special anniversary celebration for the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade, with a focus on firefighting
Venue near West Fire Station – Günther Klotz Park
additional: Alongside sporting competitions, the 2026 anniversary year features historical events such as a vintage vehicle gathering with around 120 historic fire engines and the Historic Hand-Pump Fire Engine Competition. There will also be a State Florian Celebration, a children’s play and a variety of insights into fire brigade technology and history. Events will take place at locations including Karlsruhe Palace and the Daxlanden Fire Station. Registration closes on 10 June 2026; the event is part of the anniversary celebrations and is open to runners of all ages.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder- und Jugendläufe, Startgebühren für längere Rennen
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberg Forest and Meadow Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Murrhardt. This is a short running event with two distances, taking runners through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical June weather, with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.
course_highlights: Run through forest and meadow landscapes
Two distances: 450 m and 10.8 km
Typical June weather with mild temperatures and sunshine
additional: Please check the event details with the organiser before registering. A June event with routes through nature, focused on community and health; a regional event.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Gardens Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with walking routes of 5 and 10 km also available. New to the programme is a Bambini Run for the youngest children, with no registration or results, and an official medal waiting at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and experienced runners alike to enjoy the beautiful parkland.
course_highlights: Routes through the historic Ludwigslust Palace Park
A range of distances from 2 km to 15 km, plus walking routes
Bambini Run for children born in 2021 or later, with a medal
additional: The Bambini Run is free, requires no registration and has no results. It is approximately 500–600 metres long. Adult accompaniment is expressly welcome. Registration for the other races opens on 15 March. Run in Ludwigslust Palace Park; no registration required, no fees, no results, medals for everyone, parking available, drinks and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, 40th anniversary in 2026, route partly outside the park due to park restrictions, post-race party as part of the Linden Festival.

name: Ortslauf Wallertheim
description: The Wallertheim Local Run is a traditional annual running event in Wallertheim and part of the Wingertscup. Various distances are offered, from 900 m for children to 10 km for experienced runners, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event features a family-friendly atmosphere, electronic timing with transponder technology, and convenient online registration. It welcomes runners of all abilities and offers a sporting community experience amid the beautiful Rheinhessen countryside.
course_highlights: Distances from 900 m to 10 km
Electronic timing with transponder technology
Part of the Wingertscup, with the opportunity to collect points
additional: Online registration via br-timing.de with direct debit; the event is the third stage of the Wingertscup; routes for children, beginners, experienced runners, and walkers; team registration available using the provided form. Registration closes on 12 June 2026; late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start. Changing and shower facilities are available in the multi-purpose hall. Refreshments include a cake buffet. Prizes are awarded to winners, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Isernhagener Volkslauf
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen takes place on June 14, 2026, and warmly welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. There are four distances to choose from: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and the classic 10 km race, which is officially measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass. The event features clearly marked courses, professional timekeeping with the runtiming system, and a lively fun-run atmosphere with more than 400 participants. A T-shirt and medal are included in the entry fee for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt optionally. Late entries on the day of the event are not possible.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
10 km course officially measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass
Professional timekeeping with the runtiming system
additional: Registration is online via the RUNTIMING portal until June 11, 2026, at 24:00. Late entries on the day of the event are not possible. All participants receive refreshments at the finish. A T-shirt and medal are included in the entry fee for children and young people; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt for €15.00. The event takes place in all weather. The start and finish are at the TSV Isernhagen sports grounds, Auf der Heide 32, 30916 Isernhagen H.B. Parking is available nearby. More than 400 participants annually; online registration via RUNTIMING; no late entries on the day of the event.

name: 55. Melibokus Lauf
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional running event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place for the 55th time on June 14, 2026. The event offers various races, including a half-marathon trail, 10 km and 5 km running trails, and a mountain bike summit sprint. The courses have been evaluated by ITRA and feature varied trails with challenging climbs and beautiful views. Children and young people can take part in dedicated races over 400 m, 800 m, and 1,500 m. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish in Sperbergrund.
course_highlights: Half-marathon trail (21.2 km) with challenging trails
Mountain bike summit sprint: 450 m uphill, 130 m downhill over approx. 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running courses with GPX files available
additional: Start and late registration from 8:00 a.m. in Sperbergrund, 500 m above Bürgerhaus Sonne. The mountain bike summit sprint starts at 9:00 a.m., the half-marathon at 9:30 a.m., the 10 km at 9:45 a.m., and the 5 km at 10:00 a.m. The children’s races start from 11:00 a.m. at the sports grounds at Hinkelstein. Gravel bikes are permitted in the mountain bike summit sprint; e-bikes are not. Late registration costs an additional €3.00 per race. Results are calculated immediately after the race in the Großsporthalle at Melibokusschule. The event also includes mountain bike summit sprints and trail-running elements; registration is required; detailed course and event information is available.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn
description: The COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn is a mountain run and trail running event with a 3.14 km course. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bad Wildbad and offers runners a challenging and varied route. It is part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge and attracts trail running enthusiasts looking to combine nature and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Trail run on a 3.14 km course
Mountain-run character with varied terrain
Part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge
additional: The event is part of a series of trail and mountain runs in the region, with results and media coverage available. The route is varied and offers both a sporting challenge and an experience in nature.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with around 150 metres of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through the Vöppstedter Forst, by the Forsthaus Liebenburg and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is aimed at well-trained runners. Refreshments are available in a covered room, including drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: 9.1 km loop through the Vöppstedter Forst
Loop course with around 150 metres of elevation gain and loss
Route along the Salzgitter golf course
additional: Refreshments are available in a covered room: hot tea, broth, cola, water, spritzer, pretzel sticks, nuts, bananas, cake and chocolate bars. No liability is accepted; participation is at your own risk. This is not an official DLV event. The marathon is part of an event in the Terrainkurwege series held in the Salzgitter region. No specific information about registration or entry fees is available.

name: LKZ Firmenlauf
description: The LKZ Company Run is organized by MTV Ludwigsburg in partnership with the Ludwigsburger Kreiszeitung and takes place on June 17, 2026. The 4.5 km course runs around the Ludwig-Jahn-Stadion and MTV Ludwigsburg. Every year, more than 100 companies send several thousand runners, Nordic walkers and walkers to take part, supported by numerous volunteer helpers. Alongside the sporting competition, fun and team spirit are central to the event and are celebrated after the run with cold drinks and an after-run party. MTV members can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course around the Ludwig-Jahn-Stadion
Start and finish at MTV Ludwigsburg
Strong participation from more than 100 companies, with several thousand participants
additional: Participants must be born in 2012 or earlier. Register by email by May 15, 2026, stating your year of birth and event (running or walking). MTV members can take part free of charge. Volunteer helpers are sought to assist with start and finish operations and course management. The after-run party lasts late into the night. Course length: approx. 4.5 km. Registration by email. Participation is free for MTV members. The event takes place on June 17, 2026, and includes team marquees and awards for winners.

name: Sommernachtslauf am Hufeisen
description: The Sommernachtslauf am Hufeisen is a traditional race in the municipality of Linsengericht, organized by Laufteam Gelnhausen for over 20 years. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and popularity in the Main-Kinzig district. The start and finish area is in the Hufeisen car park, nestled in woodland between the villages of Geißlitz, Großenhausen and Lützel. As part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge, the race is a mainstay of the regional race series and offers runners an appealing course in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Hufeisen car park in a wooded area
The route runs mostly through the dense woodland of the Vorspessart
Beautiful views of the Kinzig and Bieber valleys
additional: The race is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge, the region’s largest race series. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and continues to attract strong participation. The course follows forest paths with care for nature and woodland wildlife. The race is known for fast times and takes place in the Hufeisen woodland. There are various race categories, including children’s and youth competitions.

name: Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm 2026
location: Campus Selm, Selm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm is taking place for the fourth time as part of the popular town festival weekend. The officially measured course runs through the beautiful Auenpark and is popular with athletes from Selm and the surrounding region. The event offers races for various age groups, from Bambini races to fun runs over 5 and 10 kilometres. Mayor Thomas Orlowski will take part in the 10-kilometre race himself, highlighting the event’s friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured course through the Auenpark
Various races for children, teenagers and adults
Start and finish at Campus Selm
additional: The Stadtlauf begins with the Bambini race at 16:00 in the stadium (400 m). This is followed by school races over 1 km and 2.5 km, as well as fun runs over 5 km (18:00) and 10 km (19:00). Award ceremonies take place between the races. Volksbank Selm-Bork eG is the event’s main sponsor. Several race distances, start in the Auenpark, children’s and youth races, registration now open

name: Grachtenloop
description: De Zorgspecialist Grachtenloop is een sfeervolle avondloop door het prachtige oude centrum van Haarlem, waarbij deelnemers langs de grachten en singels lopen. Het parcours voert langs diverse culturele en toeristische trekpleisters en wordt ondersteund door een enthousiast publiek, bandjes en DJ's. De 10 km afstand bestaat uit twee keer de 5 km ronde. Er is ook een Hero KidsRun voor kinderen vanaf 4 jaar en een BusinessRun met extra faciliteiten. De loop biedt een unieke combinatie van sportiviteit en gezelligheid in een historische stadsomgeving.
course_highlights: Parcours door het oude centrum van Haarlem langs grachten en singels
Langs diverse culturele en toeristische trekpleisters
Muzikale ondersteuning door bandjes en DJ's langs het parcours
additional: Inschrijving is inclusief voornaam op startnummer, officiële uitslagen op website, veilig en afgesloten parcours, verzorgingsposten onderweg en bij de finish, medische verzorging, persoonlijke finishvideo, unieke medaille, entertainment, tijdregistratie verzorgd door ChronoRace, en thuisbezorging van startnummer via PostNL bij inschrijving voor 1 juni. Er is een BusinessRun met VIP-locatie, eten, drinken en massage. Er is ook een mogelijkheid voor groepsinschrijving met aparte facturatie en startnummerverzending. Het evenement biedt startnummers, parcours, verzorgingsposten, medaille, entertainment, tijdregistratie en medische ondersteuning. Startnummers worden thuisbezorgd voor Nederlandse deelnemers.

name: 44. Heiligenröder Abendlauf
price_range: modest registration fees, free for Bambinis
description: The 44th Heiligenröder Evening Run is a traditional night road race in Niestetal, Germany, and part of the Nordhessencup running series. The event offers distances for all ages and ability levels, from 400 m for Bambinis to 20.35 km for experienced runners. It combines competitive racing with more relaxed running options: Bambinis, walkers and Nordic walkers are timed but not ranked. Participation is free for Bambinis, while children, teenagers and adults pay moderate entry fees.
course_highlights: Night road race in Niestetal-Heiligenrode
Distances from 400 m to 20.35 km
Part of the Nordhessencup running series
additional: Bambinis run for free; entry fees for children, teenagers and adults are moderate. Bambinis, walkers and Nordic walkers are timed but not ranked. The event is listed on laufen.de. Typical June weather: approx. 23 °C, mostly sunny. Night race, multiple distances, events for all ages, part of the Nordhessencup running series.

name: Gänseliesellauf
location: Krischerstraße, Monheim am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Stadt Monheim am Rhein, Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inklusive 100 Meter-Lauf für alle keine Anmeldegebühr

description: The 40th Gänseliesellauf takes place on June 12, 2026, in Monheim am Rhein and traditionally kicks off the town festival. Five different races are offered for various age groups, ranging from a 900-meter race for kindergarten children to a 10-kilometer race for adults. The event is organized by the City of Monheim am Rhein together with Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e. V. Alongside the races, it offers a varied program of food and festival activities. The races start and finish on Krischerstraße, and all participants receive certificates that can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Krischerstraße at number 10
Five races for different age groups and distances
Event held as part of the Monheim town festival, with a festival program
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before each race. Certificates can be downloaded after the race via my.raceresult.com. Refreshments and food are available nearby during the races. The event is supported by MEGA Monheimer Elektrizitäts- und Gasversorgung GmbH. various race distances, registration by email, certificates available online, town festival program

name: Erftflitzer Lauf
description: The Erftflitzerlauf in Neuss-Holzheim is a family-friendly running event with a long tradition dating back to 1993. It offers various races for children, young people and adults, from short Bambini races to 5.5 km races for adults and young people. The event is known for its fun-focused spirit, with community and the joy of running at its heart. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Holzheim and offers suitable challenges for all age groups.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 400 m to 5.5 km
Relay races of 3 x approximately 400 m for different age groups
Family-friendly atmosphere with an emphasis on fun and community
additional: The Erftflitzerlauf includes several races, with start times from 17:30, beginning with Bambini and children’s races, followed by youth and adult races and relay races. The event is designed as a fun run without prizes for winners; instead, there is a raffle. Age categories are clearly defined, and races are available for children born in 2019 through to adults. The event takes place at the sports facility in Holzheim. Races for all age groups, family-friendly, central location, known as the Erftflitzerlauf since the 1990s.

name: Lauf - Lauf durch den Sportpark Koblenz
organizer: Meddy's Lauf- und Walking-Treff Koblenz e.V.
description: The 29th International Run through Sportpark Koblenz takes place on 19 June 2026. The flat course runs through Stadion Oberwerth, Sportpark Koblenz and the traditional Wasserwerksrunde, mostly on asphalt and paved paths. The event offers categories for the main race, youth and Bambini, as well as children’s races and walking/Nordic walking. The event is shaped by a welcoming club atmosphere and good facilities, including changing rooms, showers and free parking.
course_highlights: Flat course through Stadion Oberwerth and Sportpark Koblenz
Traditional Wasserwerksrunde
Asphalt and paved paths
additional: The start and finish are at Stadion Oberwerth. Timing is by a transponder attached to the race number. Race numbers can be collected on the event day at the stadium grounds. Late entries and changes of registration are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €2.00. Changing rooms and showers are available at the stadium. Free parking and a bus stop (EPG ARENA/Stadion) are nearby. Course route through the stadium, Sportpark and Wasserwerksrunde; registration until 18.06.2026; race number collection on the event day; results online; changing rooms and showers at the stadium; free parking; nearby bus stop.

name: Legdener Volkslauf / Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Legden Midsummer Night Run is a popular fun run through the centre of Legden, taking place on 19 June 2026. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and lack of competitive pressure, as only the times of the first three women and first three men are recorded. Events include children’s races, a kids’ race for older children, 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults, and a 5 km course for walkers and Nordic walkers. Wheelchair users are warmly invited to take part in the 5 km walk. Due to a road closure, the route has been slightly adjusted and now runs along Windmühlenweg, Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg.
course_highlights: Run through the centre of Legden with cheering spectators
5 km and 10 km courses with a revised route via Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg
Children’s races in two age groups (400 m for children born in 2022 or later, and for those born in 2020 and 2021)
additional: Race-number distribution on 19 June 2026 from 17:30 at Dahliendorfstadion. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Prizes in kind will be awarded by drawing race numbers. Group registration is available until 15 June 2026; no group registrations will be accepted after that date. Courses for children, teenagers, adults, walkers and wheelchair users; route changes due to a road closure.

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
location: Laatzen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf takes place on June 19, 2026, and offers runners 3.5 km, 6.5 km and 10 km routes through the idyllic Leine-Masch, with nature, water and wide meadows. The event also includes a 1.2 km Bambini run and a 6.5 km walking category. The 10 km route includes a team classification for mixed teams. The traditional Laatzener Winzerfest takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.
course_highlights: Run through the Leine-Masch, with nature, water and wide meadows
Refreshment station and musical support on the 6.5 km and 10 km routes
Team classification for mixed teams on the 10 km route
additional: Race-number distribution from 15:00 at the park of the Altes Rathaus. Timing by RUNTIMING GbR. Late entries can be made on site on race day from 15:00 until around 30 minutes before each race. Trophies for the 10 km winners; certificates and surprises for the top finishers and teams. Bambini run participants receive a small surprise. The event takes place alongside the Laatzener Winzerfest, with musical and culinary entertainment. Routes go through the Leine-Masch and finish at the wine festival; suitable for walkers, teams and children.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweiger Night Run on 19 June 2026 offers a varied programme of sporting events for all age groups, from Bambini races to recreational races. The races run through Braunschweig city centre, starting and finishing on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it develop. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download a certificate, and baggage drop-off is open until 23:30.
course_highlights: The route runs through Braunschweig city centre, starting and finishing on Bohlweg
The Bambini races start at Burgplatz
The race bib serves as a public transport ticket (Zone 40) on the day of the event
additional: Registration is via Davengo from 16 February 2026 to 14 June 2026. There are Bambini, children’s, youth, recreational and team races, with different start times from 18:00. The route will be closed to public traffic from 16:00. Baggage drop-off is located at Schlossplatz. For the Bambini races, accompanying runners can be registered at the same time; for the children’s races, accompanying runners must be registered separately. Teams can register collectively or individually; four or more runners count as a team. Registration is available via Davengo, with individual and team entry options. The event is open to all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere in the city centre.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, held in an atmospheric evening setting. Depending on the distance, runners can complete the 7.5 km loop around the Alster once or twice. There are special 1 km and 1.8 km races for children. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall, bringing the Hanseatic spirit to life at dusk.
course_highlights: 7.5 km loop around the Outer Alster, with the start and finish area in Alsterpark
The route runs along the banks of the Alster, through Winterhude and Uhlenhorst, past the Hotel Atlantic and over the Kennedy Bridge
Night run with a special atmosphere as dusk falls
additional: There are two children’s races: the 1 km DAK Bambini RUN (up to age 7) and the 1.8 km DAK Kids RUN (ages 7 to 12). The start and finish area features a cheering zone, a photo point for finish-line photos and a large medal wall with finisher medals. Certificates and photos can be downloaded from the SportScheck website. This is a distance event, with results, certificates and photos available.

name: Bad Wildbader Stäffeleslauf
description: The Bad Wildbad Stäffeleslauf is a unique running event in the picturesque Black Forest, held annually in Bad Wildbad. The event offers various participation categories, including the Mini-Stäffeleslauf with approximately 500 steps and the challenging Feuerwehr-Stäffeleslauf with 1,987 steps. Runners take on a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings and can test their limits in this special stair race. The event is for all age groups and fitness levels and promises fun and excitement.
course_highlights: Mini-Stäffeleslauf with approximately 500 steps over 0.30 km
Feuerwehr-Stäffeleslauf with 1,987 steps over approximately 0.72 km
Route through the picturesque Black Forest scenery
additional: The race takes place at Uhlandplatz in Bad Wildbad. The available pages do not provide explicit information about start times, waves, entry fees or late registration. The event is held in June and has age categories starting from age 8, including special categories for children and firefighters, in a scenic setting.

name: Benefizlauf - Laufend Gutes tun
location: Niederwangen, Wangen im Allgäu, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Niederwangen Charity Run is an inclusive running event organised in support of Lebenshilfe. It combines sporting effort with social commitment and is open to runners of all ages. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Niederwangen and offers a great opportunity to do good and get active together. The run is supported by various local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Inclusive running event in support of Lebenshilfe
Run through the scenic surroundings of Niederwangen
An event with a strong sense of social commitment and community
additional: A wide range of sports, including triathlon, swimming, cycling, running, children's sports, ball sports, recreational sports and inclusive events. Online registration.

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
location: Stadion Bildungszentrum am Ziegelweg, Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Brunsbüttel City Run is an urban running event in Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, featuring 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a short stadium run for children. The start and finish are at the Bildungszentrum stadium on Ziegelweg. The event is open to adults, teenagers, school groups, company teams and children, and is not just for club athletes. The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. The youngest participants can take part in a children’s run of approximately 400 m in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the city
10 km course consisting of two laps of the 5 km course
Children’s run of approximately 400 m in the stadium
additional: Timing is provided using transponders, which are handed out at collection. Changing facilities are available. All participants receive a medal. The children’s race takes place in the stadium, allowing families to follow everything from one location. A running event for athletes and families, with modern timing, changing facilities and medals for all participants.

name: Fürstenwaldlauf
description: The Fürstenwaldlauf is a traditional cross-country race in Upper Swabia, taking place for the 45th time in 2026. It is held as part of the Öchslefest in the town of Ochsenhausen on June 19 and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere. The main race is a quarter marathon, run mostly on forest paths with some challenging sections. It starts and finishes with a lap of the track at the Hopfengarten sports grounds.
