Water stations along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Every participant receives a unique, handmade, pottery-crafted medal. Medals go to the first 250 registrants in the 12 km main race and the 6 km beginners’ race, as well as the first 200 children and schoolchildren. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 11:00 a.m. at the sports field. Overall winners receive pottery-crafted trophies and certificates. There is no parking directly at the sports field, but designated parking areas are nearby. Timing is electronic and provided by GO-timing. The course is clearly marked, and the fire brigade ensures safety at road crossings. A bicycle escort accompanies all courses. Courses for children, beginners, recreational and elite runners; anniversary event; family and community atmosphere

name: Waiblinger Stadtlauf
description: The Waiblingen City Run takes place on June 21, 2026, and offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a range of distances. The event is family-friendly and accompanied by a varied entertainment program at Rathausplatz. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department provides food and refreshments. Participation in the children’s or youth run also supports Tour Ginkgo, which helps seriously ill children and their families.
course_highlights: Children’s run: 2 laps, approx. 1,400 m
10 km and 6 km runs, plus walking: 1 lap, approx. 2 km
Varied entertainment program at Rathausplatz
additional: Registration opens in early 2026. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department provides food and refreshments. Volksbank Stuttgart will donate €1 to Tour Ginkgo in the Rems-Murr district for every successful participation in the children’s or youth run. Online registration is available; the event takes place in June 2026; contact by phone and email.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The route follows loops through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, and also offers a Kids’ stage for younger participants. The event is organised by regional clubs and will take place for the 18th time in 2026.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each, following loop courses
Countryside in the Harz foothills around Osterode
Additional 750-metre Kids’ stage in Schützenpark
additional: The stages start at 18:45 each day, except for the first stage on 21 June at 10:45 and the final stage on 27 June at 16:00. The awards ceremony takes place on 27 June at 18:00. Runners, walkers and Nordic walkers may participate. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Club membership is not required. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshment stations and social activities at the finish. Registration is mainly by email, and the routes are tailored to the stages scheduled for each day.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad and offers a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Around 10 km per stage
Dunes, beaches and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea
additional: Race bibs are distributed from approximately 1 hour after the special ferry arrives until 30 minutes before the start. The race bib, with an integrated timing chip, is used for all stages. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available on the islands. Bag storage is provided. Information events are held on 19.06. before the race. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on Borkum. Stage race across seven islands; no waiting list; limited number of participants; race entries cannot be transferred.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Baltrum (3. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run on Baltrum is the third stage of a popular running series on the East Frisian Islands. The car-free island of Baltrum offers a peaceful, natural setting with wide sandy beaches and the Wadden Sea, ideal for runners seeking nature and relaxation. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the town hall, and the event is well suited to families, walkers, and anyone looking to escape the stresses of everyday life. The awards ceremony takes place on the village square on the same day.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the town hall
Run through the car-free, natural island of Baltrum, with its wide sandy beaches
Charming island-village atmosphere and Wadden Sea setting
additional: Race bib collection from 09:00 to 11:00 at Haus des Gastes. Bag storage from 10:30 to 13:30 at Haus des Gastes and Sanitärhaus Ost. Changing facilities at Haus des Gastes and the town hall. Showers at SindBad, Mehrzweckhalle, and Sanitärhaus Ost. Toilets at several locations near the harbor, town hall, Haus des Gastes, SindBad, Mehrzweckhalle, and Sanitärhaus Ost. Awards ceremony at 14:00 on the village square in front of the town hall. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the town hall, with extensive facilities including changing rooms, showers, and bag storage. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00. The event is part of the larger North Sea Run, which takes place from 20 to 27 June 2026 on several islands.

name: Sparkassen-Minimarathon
description: The Sparkassen Mini Marathon in Karlsruhe is a special running festival for children and young people, taking place on September 19, 2026, at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium. Three distances are offered: the Mini Marathon, approximately 4.2 km; the Mini Half Marathon, approximately 2.1 km; and the Bambini Run, approximately 333 m. All races start and finish in the stadium, with the longer distances passing through the beautiful Günther-Klotz-Anlage. The event is inclusive and offers every child a medal and a personalized online certificate. Timing is done using a chip in the race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium in Karlsruhe-Beiertheim
The Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon pass through the Günther-Klotz-Anlage
Inclusive event; children with disabilities may be accompanied by a support person
additional: Race number collection on event day from 11:00 until 30 minutes before each start. Changes to registration details can be made online free of charge. The timing chip is included in the race number. Prizes for the three fastest girls and boys in the Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon. Results and personalized certificates are available online. Distances: approximately 4.2 km, 2.1 km, and 333 m; registration on event day; inclusion for children with disabilities; start at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium.

name: Darmstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Darmstädter Merck City Run is a long-established city race celebrating its 47th edition in 2026. The route runs through downtown Darmstadt and has been adjusted due to construction work to include historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße. The race attracts numerous participants every year and offers a lively atmosphere with live music and an enthusiastic team of commentators. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and appealing route through the pedestrian zone.
course_highlights: Route through central historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße
Run through the pedestrian zone with a lively atmosphere
Includes Luisenplatz, Ludwigsplatz and Piazza as well-known sections of the course
additional: The event will take place on 24 June 2026, subject to approval. The route has been changed due to construction work, offering an appealing alternative via Ernst-Ludwig-Platz, Marktplatz, Kirchstraße and the Stadtkirche. The event includes seven races with large fields and is run by a dedicated organising team. Route changed due to construction work; race on Tuesday; includes youth and school classes; cultural accompanying events

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
location: Schwiegershausen, Osterode am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, with varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at Schwiegershausen Sports Hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to anyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping, and promotes a sense of community among regional clubs.
course_highlights: Beber nature reserve with varied paths
Great view of the Harz after a steep climb
A mix of gravel, concrete and grass paths
additional: The awards ceremony takes place on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 18:00, with a raffle of prizes. The 750 m Kids’ Stage is offered on 27 June 2026. The event is jointly organised by seven regional clubs. You can take part without being a club member. Minors need written consent from their parents. Multi-stage marathon event, scenic route through Beber, start and finish in Schwiegershausen

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approx. 10 km per stage
Scenery featuring dunes, beaches and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea
additional: Race numbers are distributed from approximately 1 hour after the special ferry arrives on each island until 30 minutes before the start. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated timing chip. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available on the islands. Sports-bag storage is provided. There is no waiting list or reserve list; entries are non-transferable and will not be reallocated if cancelled. Stage race across seven islands, approx. 10 km per stage, no waiting list, limited capacity due to ferry and infrastructure constraints, fully booked.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
price_range: 5 Euro (bei Meldung bis 21. Juni), 7 Euro (bei Nachmeldung am Starttag bis 17.30 Uhr)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 7 Euro (bei Nachmeldung am Starttag bis 17.30 Uhr)

description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organized by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. On 24 June 2026, runners can take part in various races, including a 10-kilometer individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometer road race. There is also a 25 x 400-meter team race and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer individual race over 5 laps of 2 km on the university campus
25 x 400-meter team race on a 400-meter loop
Bambini run for children aged 2 to 6 over a 400-meter lap
additional: The Bambini run has no entry fee, and every child receives a medal; teams in the team race consist of 2 to 5 runners; a team is classified as female only if all runners are women. Races take place on a 400-meter or 2 km loop on the university campus; various races for children; university championship in the 10 km race

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
location: Kurplatz, Juist, Nordsee, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on June 24, 2026, on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, known for its dunes and Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race bib is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.
course_highlights: Run across Juist, the longest East Frisian island (17 km long, max. 900 m wide)
Dune landscape with dunes up to 22 m high and Juist Water Tower
Start and finish at Kurplatz, Juist
additional: Race bib pickup from 10:00 to 12:00 at Haus des Kurgastes. Sports bag storage from 11:30 to 14:30 at Haus des Kurgastes. Changing rooms and showers at the seawater leisure pool. Toilets at the National Park House and the town hall. Awards ceremony at 15:00 at Kurplatz. The race bib has an integrated timing chip, is valid for all stages, and may be kept or discarded after the final stage. Stage race across seven islands, approx. 10 km per stage. Registration is full; there is no waiting list. Participant numbers are limited due to infrastructure. Start and finish at Kurplatz, start at 12:30, awards ceremony at 15:00.

name: Firmenlauf Renningen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 501 bis 1.000 Anmeldungen bzw. bis zum Meldeschluss am 15. Juni 2026 (18:00 Uhr)

description: The 1st AOK Renningen Company Run takes place on June 24, 2026, in Renningen and offers a great team event for colleagues. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each. The run is part of the BW-Running company run series and emphasizes inclusion, shared experiences, and celebration. After the run, free refreshments will be provided at the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with musical accompaniment.
course_highlights: Course length: approximately 4.6 km, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each
Group warm-up shortly before the start
Free refreshments at the finish, including Erdinger Alkoholfrei, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 5:00 p.m., a DJ will create an upbeat atmosphere on stage. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony and musical entertainment. Participant changes can be made by email up to one day before the event; on the event day, they are only possible in person and for a fee. The minimum age to participate is 16. A run for everyone, including an inclusive run. Online registration is open until June 15, 2026. Participant limit: 1,200.

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voorinschrijving, 8 euro tijdens de wedstrijd
description: De Ronde van Nieuwveen is een hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt in en rond het dorp Nieuwveen, onderdeel van het Gemeente Nieuwkoop Circuit. De wedstrijd wordt gehouden op de langste avond van het jaar en biedt diverse afstanden voor zowel jeugd als volwassenen. Voor kinderen tot 13 jaar zijn er gratis kinderlopen van 400 m, 800 m en 1,7 km, terwijl volwassenen kunnen deelnemen aan 5 km, 10 km en 15 km routes. De wedstrijd kenmerkt zich door een gevarieerd parcours door de wijk en het dorp, met speciale aandacht voor een goede spreiding van lopers over het parcours.
course_highlights: Parcours door en rond Nieuwveen met start en finish bij W.P. Speelmanweg
Kinderlopen van 400 m, 800 m en 1,7 km door de wijk en het dorp
5 km, 10 km en 15 km routes die door en om Nieuwveen lopen
additional: Start en finish bij W.P. Speelmanweg met kleedgelegenheid, douches en bewaakte tassenafgifte. Er is een speciale G-loop voor deelnemers met een verstandelijke of lichamelijke beperking, die samen met begeleiders kunnen lopen. Parkeergelegenheid is beschikbaar bij het gemeentehuis, Teylersplein 1, en De Hogendijk naast de voetbalvelden. Voor kinderen is deelname gratis, maar vooraf inschrijven wordt gevraagd voor een vlotte doorloop. Parcours door en om Nieuwveen, verschillende afstanden voor jeugd en volwassenen, gratis deelname voor jeugd en G-Loop, kleedgelegenheid en bewaakte tassenafgifte.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
location: Dorste, Osterode am Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The races follow circular routes through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event starts in Förste on Sunday, 21 June 2026, with a new stage each day through Saturday, 27 June 2026. Walkers and Nordic walkers are also warmly welcome. There is also a 750-metre kids’ stage on 27 June in Schützenpark.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 km each on circular routes
Countryside in the Harz foothills around Osterode
750 m kids’ stage in Schützenpark
additional: Stage start times: Sunday, 21 June 2026 at 10:45, Monday to Friday at 18:45 each day, and Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 16:00. Awards ceremony on Saturday at 18:00, with a prize draw for non-cash prizes. Open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. No club membership required. Minors need written parental consent. 7 stages, 5–7 km per stage, medical support, free drinks, commemorative gift, marathon certificate, no club membership required

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Corporate Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with team spirit and togetherness at its heart. It is aimed at companies, groups of friends and running communities who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timekeeping will be available for the first time for anyone who wants to measure their athletic performance. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food and drinks provides a relaxed end to the evening.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 5 km through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee and the marina
Start and finish area behind Paulaner’s im Wehrschloss
At least one refreshment point along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Teams must have at least 5 people. Official timekeeping is new for 2026 and optional. Late registration is possible online on the day of the event, but only by direct debit. Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest; race number belts are not allowed. Showers and changing rooms are available on site. The course is a loop, completed once. The route passes through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee and the marina. Registration is online; participation is open to groups of 5 or more, and includes refreshments along the course and music at the party. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability level.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organised by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. For life.” The event promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and runs mainly on unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on 25 June 2026 at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5.3 km long
Mainly unpaved paths, with approximately 1 km of asphalt
Refreshment stations approximately every 2 km and in the finish area
additional: Team race packs must be collected on the event day from the Sportheim Stahlbergbaude. Changing facilities and showers are in the Rasenallee sports hall next to the event area. Public transport: RegioTram 4, Heckershausen stop, approximately 500 m walk to the sports facility. Parking is available at the Rasenallee Sports Centre or on streets in the Heckershausen district. Road traffic regulations must be observed. Event date: 25.06.2026. Course and registration details are available on the website; results will be published online.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run takes place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is open to employees and apprentices from companies, government agencies, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event offers teams a great opportunity to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park
Run for employees and apprentices from companies and government agencies
Limited parking available; alternative transport is recommended
additional: Participant limit: 500. For every 10 participants registered as a group, one entry-fee discount is available until the end of May. Parking at the Nordsee-Stadion is limited; alternative transport is recommended. Participant limit of 500; parking is limited; registration is open.

name: Havendagen Run
description: De Havendagenrun Terneuzen is een sportieve loopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt in de binnenstad van Terneuzen. De tweede editie van deze run biedt een unieke route door de stad met afstanden van 1, 3 en 5 zeemijl (1,85 km, 5,55 km en 9,25 km). Start en finish zijn bij het Veerplein, vlak bij het ponton. De Kidsrun voor kinderen tot 12 jaar is 1 km en start iets eerder. De run is geschikt voor jong en oud en biedt een sportieve uitdaging met een verbeterd parcours ten opzichte van vorig jaar.
course_highlights: Unieke route door de binnenstad van Terneuzen
Start en finish bij het Veerplein, vlak bij het ponton
Loop langs het Stadhuisplein en de Markt
additional: Er is een Kidsrun van 1 km voor kinderen tot en met 12 jaar die om 18:15 uur start. De Havendagenrun vindt plaats op vrijdag 26 juni 2026. De route is verbeterd ten opzichte van vorig jaar voor een betere loopervaring. Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, onderdeel van de Havendagen met diverse festiviteiten in Terneuzen

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: The “Meine Nacht” charity relay race is a community running event in Meine, held in support of charitable causes. The event promotes team spirit and sporting commitment in a special atmosphere. Participants experience a varied course through the municipality that strengthens the sense of community.
course_highlights: Relay format for teams
Course through the municipality of Meine
Charity run with a commitment to social causes
additional: Charity run, registration available via the website, event promotes community and spirituality

name: MidSummerRun 2026

late_fee.price: 3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter
3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter

description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organised for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 metres, a 5 km run and a 10 km run along the wild upper reaches of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a Future Fair featuring sustainability partners and a food truck will also be on hand. The MidSummerRun champions environmental protection and sustainability, and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper reaches of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
Sustainably organised race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 across all races combined. Late registration is available from 10 June 2026 and on race day, provided the limit has not been reached. First aid is available on an outpatient basis in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed gathering after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organisation, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover. Various distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. Two aid stations along the course provide refreshments, and timing is done using rental chips. Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00. Timing is done using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be dropped off before the start at the tent opposite the clubhouse. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, relay 23.1 km; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23; online registration until 25.06.2026, on-site late registration available.

name: Bergdorfmeile
description: The Bergdorfmeile is a traditional race over a historic 8.88889 km course in Karlsruhe-Hohenwettersbach, taking place on Friday, June 26, 2026. With around 140 metres of elevation gain, the course is more challenging than a flat city route, but is designed so recreational runners can also take part comfortably. The race starts at 19:00 on Lindenstraße and finishes at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground. Alongside the main race, there is also an approximately 2 km youth race for children and teenagers. Every participant receives a high-quality technical shirt, and timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib.
course_highlights: Historic 8.88889 km course with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain
Start on Lindenstraße; finish at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground
Refreshments at kilometre 5 and at the finish
additional: Race-bib collection and technical-shirt distribution take place on June 26, 2026, from 16:30 to 18:30 at the schoolyard, Kirchplatz, right by the start. Late entries are possible on race day, subject to the participant limit. Bag storage is available from 17:00 at the start; bags can be collected at the finish until 21:00. Showers are available at SV Hohenwettersbach. Timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib, which must be worn on the chest. The finish closes at 20:15. Participants who reach the hiking car park at Lambrechtshof (approx. km 3.8) later than 19:34 will be removed from the results. The event is limited to approximately 1,000 participants, with chip timing and an online results list. The course is challenging, with around 140 metres of elevation difference.

name: Burg-Lauf Eppstein
description: The Eppstein Castle Run is a traditional Taunus running classic, held annually since 1986 and attracting up to 500 runners as well as numerous spectators. The varied 7.777 km course passes through the forest and the historic old town, loops twice around the medieval castle, then climbs Schmerzberg to the finish at the TSG Eppstein sports ground. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a sociable program featuring a cake stand, a Castle Run glass and refreshments. The run is suitable both for ambitious runners and for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the special atmosphere and challenge of the “old German mile.”
course_highlights: 7.777 km course adapted to the topography
Route through the forest and old town, and twice around the medieval castle
Climb to the finish on Schmerzberg, back to the TSG Eppstein sports ground
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00 until half an hour before the start at the “Am Bienroth” sports ground. Chip timing is used. Prizes and non-cash awards are available for the fastest participants, and medals are awarded to student relay teams. Please note the important travel information due to the partial closure of the B455. Eppstein railway station is easily reached on the S2; the start is about a 15-minute walk from the station. The run takes place on varied terrain adapted to the topography. Registration is available online and on the day of the event. Awards, medals and prizes are presented to the winners.

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Kleeblatt Run on June 26, 2026, is a new running event inviting runners of all ages to Niederrhein Stadium. Organised by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen City Sports Association, the event aims to bring people from across the city together—from beginners to ambitious athletes. The course runs mostly along a lit, kilometre-marked running track beside the Rhine-Herne Canal, offering an attractive route that can be used year-round. After the run, the City Sports Association’s recreation area invites participants to relax, socialise and enjoy the end of the event together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometre loop along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Lit, kilometre-marked running track available year-round
Start at Slinky Springs to Fame, with the route extending to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all ability levels and aims to become a fixture in Oberhausen’s sporting calendar. After the run, a programme featuring food and drinks will be held at the City Sports Association’s recreation area to encourage community and socialising. Run on a lit route along the Rhine-Herne Canal; various running distances for all age groups; registration until June 21, 2026.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weezer Sommerabendlauf is a popular running event held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the race is once again attracting large numbers of participants, with over 380 starters in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children’s and youth races, and starts on June 26, 2026, at 5 p.m. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: Weeze town loop over the new Niers bridge and through the animal park
Approx. 300 m children’s race, with a loop starting from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Registration closes on June 24, 2026, at midnight. Online registration is via raceresult, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late entries can be paid for in cash or by card on site. Race bibs with chips must be returned on the day of the event; the €3 chip deposit will be refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available in the Bürgerhaus. Eight tickets to the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). The race takes place in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on site up to 45 minutes before the start. Start times are between 6:00 p.m. and 7:30 p.m.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
price_range: 32,00 € – 37,00 € für Shirts, 10,00 € – 15,00 € für Tücher und Flaschen
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Capacity is limited, making the event very popular and causing it to sell out well in advance.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approximately 10 km per stage
Route through dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site
additional: Race bibs are distributed on each island from approximately one hour after the special ferry arrives until 30 minutes before the start. The race bib, with an integrated timing chip, is used for all stages. The start and finish of Stage 1 (Borkum) are on the promenade. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available on the islands. There is no waiting list, reserve list or transfer of race entries. A technical shirt, technical scarf and other merchandise items are available for purchase. Stages on seven North Sea islands; no waiting list; participant capacity is limited due to infrastructure; race in June 2026; includes island walks and a shared community experience.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Stage 5 takes runners to the car-free island of Langeoog, which delights visitors with its 14 km sandy beach, dunes, tides, and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. The start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and experience of nature.
course_highlights: Car-free North Sea island of Langeoog with a 14 km sandy beach
Route through dunes, tidal areas, and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park
Start and finish at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße
additional: Race number distribution from 11:30 to 13:30 at Haus der Insel. Sports bag storage from 13:00 to 16:00 at Haus der Insel. Changing rooms and showers at the swimming pool; toilets at Haus der Insel. Awards ceremony at 16:30 in the start/finish area on Barkhausenstraße. A race number with an integrated timing chip will be issued and is valid for all stages. Stage race across seven islands; advance registration only; participant numbers are limited due to ferry capacity; merchandise available.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
location: Sportplatz RW Sutthausen, Osnabrück, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen takes place on June 26, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the non-profit organization Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports field and heads into the Hörner Bruch woodland, where one lap is approximately 3 kilometers long. Distances range from 500 m for the Bambini run to 10 km for adults, with no individual timekeeping. After the run, participants can round off the evening with food and drinks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the RW Sutthausen sports field
Run through the Hörner Bruch woodland, with approximately 3 km per lap
Refreshment station along the route
additional: Bambini run starts at 7:00 p.m. (500 m); running, walking, Nordic walking, and strolling start at 7:30 p.m. No individual timekeeping; a clock is located in the start/finish area. Showers and changing facilities are available. Due to limited parking, participants are advised to come on foot, by bike, or by carpool. Refreshment station along the route. Relaxed get-together with food and drinks after the run. Woodland route, online registration, no individual timekeeping, refreshment station, showers and changing facilities available.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
location: Lauf an der Pegnitz, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km Hauptlauf: € 20,- bei online Anmeldung bis 24.06.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km/5 km Nordic Walking: € 15,- bei online Anmeldung bis 24.06.2026

description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend of June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg
5 km race and Nordic walking with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße
Pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge, creating a unique setting
additional: Race pack collection and on-the-day registration are available on race day from 14:00 to 17:00 in the finish area (Nürnberger Tor, Friedensplatz 1, 91207 Lauf). On-the-day registration incurs an additional fee of €3, payable in cash. Entries received by 19.06.2026 will receive a personalised race bib with the runner’s name. €1 of the entry fee is donated to Lebenshilfe im Nürnberger Land. The race takes place every year on the last weekend of June, with start times of 18:00 for the 10 km race and 18:05 for Nordic walking. The course is scenic and promotes community spirit and charitable causes.

name: Bietigheimer Fackellauf
description: The Bietigheim Torch Run is a special running experience held annually in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The 10 km run covers three laps on a flat, paved farm track between Bietigheim and Ingersheim, illuminated by torches. The start and finish are at the Olymp company car park, where a unique atmosphere with music, food and drinks awaits participants. The run starts on 26 June 2026 at 10 p.m. and offers an atmospheric nighttime event for running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10 km run over three laps
Flat, paved farm track between Bietigheim and Ingersheim
Course illuminated by torches
additional: Race numbers are issued exclusively at the stand in the start/finish area. Nordic walking poles and other objects are not permitted on the course. Registration is online only. The registration deadline is 26 June 2026 at 12 p.m. Torch-lit course, nighttime event, music, food and drinks in the start/finish area

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
location: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadion, Schwalmtal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a varied race programme on a late June evening. OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with more than 1,000 participants from different age and ability groups, from young people to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometre road race and the 5,000-metre “Race of the Aces” for stronger runners. Participants can compete individually, as part of a team or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and experienced athletes. The race honours Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and a promoter of the women’s marathon.
course_highlights: A combination of track and road races
A 5-kilometre road race and the 5,000-metre Race of the Aces
A range of age and ability groups up to M75/W75
additional: The event takes place late in the evening in June. Ten races are offered, with more than 1,000 runners taking part. The event honours OSC founder and promoter of the women’s marathon Ernst van Aaken. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23 °C. Various race distances, team classifications, online registration; check parking information.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The SchiederSee Summer Run is part of the 2025 Lippe Summer Series and takes place on June 26, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is open to runners of all ability levels. The scenic course runs around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather averaging 23 °C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.
course_highlights: Scenic course around SchiederSee
Two distances: 1 km and 8.3 km
Pleasant summer weather averaging 23 °C
additional: The event recommends checking the details with the organizer before registering. Results may be included in official athletics rankings. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23°C, creating ideal conditions for a summer run. The event is part of the annual Lippe Summer Series, known in the region for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
price_range: Erwachsene: 14 EUR, Schüler/Jugendliche: 5 EUR, Bambini: frei
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional running event taking place on June 26, 2026, in Retzbachpark. The event includes races for various age groups, from Bambini to youth, as well as a Fun Run and a main race. The course is a flat loop, mostly on gravel paths, and counts toward the Sport IN Laufcup standings. Races start in the late afternoon, and results are published shortly after the races. The event is family-friendly and offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat loop course
Mostly on gravel paths
Start and finish in Retzbachpark, Gaimersheim
additional: Race start times are staggered from 17:10 (Bambini U7/U8) to 19:00 (Youth U18/U20, Fun Run, main race). Race packets can be collected from 16:00 at the start/finish area. Travel by bus and train is possible, with stops nearby. Parking is available, but do not park in the car park of the adjacent Edeka store. Results will be published at the venue as soon as possible after the races. The event takes place on public roads. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the start. Travel by bus or train is recommended; parking is available at EDEKA, the sports hall, and other locations.

name: Filsum Löppt
description: Filsum Löppt is a traditional fun run held annually on the last Friday in June as part of the SV Blau-Weiß Filsum e.V. sports days. The event offers races for all age groups, from children to experienced runners, on varied paved country roads and footpaths around Filsum. The start and finish of all races are at the sports ground, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The course is well marked and secured by numerous marshals, with refreshment stations along the main races. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organization, including electronic timing.
course_highlights: Routes on paved country roads and footpaths in scenic Filsum
Kilometre markers and several refreshment stations along the route
Start and finish at the sports ground, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 17:00 until 30 minutes before the relevant start, with a late-registration fee of €4 ( €1 for the 400 m Kinnerloop). Electronic timing uses transponders on the back of the race bib (except for the 400 m Kinnerloop). Race bibs must be worn clearly visible on the chest. The participant limit for the main races (5.2 km, 5.2 km walking, 10.3 km) is 500 runners/walkers. The start and finish are at the sports ground, with changing rooms and showers available. Children’s races take place on grass and on secured routes. Events: 400m Kinnerloop, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, 5.2 km run & walking, 10.3 km run; participant limit: 500; registration opens 02.04.2026; refreshments available on site.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kinderlauf (1,17 Km auf maximal 50 Teilnehmer/Innen begrenzt)

description: The Osterrönfeld Moor Run takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and a 10-kilometer Moor Run. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is recorded using transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and on-site parking.
course_highlights: Start at the sports field on Aukamp Street
Run through the moorland
Three distances: 1.17 km children’s run, 5 km fun run, 10 km Moor Run
additional: Race packets can be collected on event day from 4:00 p.m. at the sports hall at Fehmarnstraße 2. Timing uses transponders worn around the ankle, which must be returned after the run (a €40 fee applies if lost). Showers and parking are available at the sports hall. Entry for the 5 km and 10 km runs includes a voucher for a grilled sausage. Late registration on event day is possible for a €2 fee, subject to bib availability. Terrain: moorland run; registration at the sports hall; transponder timing; certificates and medals; parking behind the sports hall

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: De Lingewaalloop is een gezellige hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, gericht op inwoners van Herwijnen en omgeving. De wedstrijd biedt diverse afstanden, waaronder jeugdloopjes en 5 en 10 kilometer, met een parcours dat start en finisht op de Vervoornlaan en via de Waaldijk loopt. De jeugdloop vindt plaats op en rond de Vervoornlaan, terwijl de 5 en 10 kilometer lopers een ronde over de dijk en Achterweg lopen. De organisatie zorgt voor faciliteiten zoals omkleed- en douchegelegenheid en een prijsuitreiking na afloop.
course_highlights: Jeugdloop op en rond de Vervoornlaan
5 km ronde via Achterweg, Waaldijk en Katerdam
10 km bestaat uit twee keer dezelfde 5 km ronde
additional: Na-inschrijven en ophalen startnummers jeugd vanaf 09:30 uur in voetbalkantine De Kol. Omkleed- en douchegelegenheid aanwezig op sportpark De Kol. Prijsuitreiking jeugd bij finish, voor 5 en 10 km na afloop in voetbalkantine. Parkeren langs Parallelweg, niet bij omliggende winkels. Tien leeftijdscategorieën voor mannen en vrouwen, ongeacht wedstrijdlicentie. De race wordt gehouden op en rond de Vervoornlaan, met inschrijving vooraf en op de dag, en faciliteiten op sportpark De Kol. De editie van 2027 is geannuleerd vanwege extreme temperaturen.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the southern Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on 27 June 2026 in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises varied natural surroundings. The event is open to children, young people, adults and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the southern Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for a range of age groups and ability levels
additional: Registration is open until 24 June 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time on 27 June 2026. The flat, scenic course is a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail, and is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings list. In addition to the marathon, the event offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and student races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal valley with scenic surroundings
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail
Start and finish at Löningen market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen market square, with information and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink car park. Refreshments are organised by the St. Vitus Löningen altar servers. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen,” a marathon brochure, and is usually held in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly welcomes runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers various distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town centre and along the harbour. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race materials can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Courses through the picturesque town centre of Glückstadt
Races along the harbour head and past the Legends Park
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race materials can be collected at the harbour head on race day from 9:00 a.m. Late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €5. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are available at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones may not be worn and animals or jogging strollers may not be brought along during the race. The event offers shower and changing facilities, safety and data protection provisions, as well as medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Idar-Obersteiner Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtjugendamt Idar-Oberstein in Verbindung mit Stadtverband sporttreibender Vereine und TV 1848 Oberstein
price_range: 5 euro für Erwachsene, 2,50 euro für Kinder/Jugend, U8 frei
description: The Idar-Oberstein Old Town Run is a traditional running event in the historic old town of Oberstein, held annually on the last Saturday in June. The event features six different races for various age groups, from U8 children to adults, with distances ranging from 370 metres to around 6.5 kilometres. The route runs through the pedestrian zone below the striking Felsenkirche, a city landmark. The start and finish are behind the Tourist Information in Oberstein. Entry fees are deliberately kept low to encourage broad participation.
course_highlights: Route through the pedestrian zone below the Felsenkirche
Start and finish behind the Oberstein Tourist Information
A range of distances from 370 m to 6.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are not possible after the registration deadline. The event features six separate races for different age groups. Typical June weather is around 23 °C and mostly sunny. Running event in the old town; online registration is available; start and finish at the Oberstein Tourist Information.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a traditional running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time on June 27, 2026. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a Bambini run, Schoolrunning, a fun run, a corporate run, speed skating and the main race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and accompanies participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with a lively atmosphere, plenty of spectators and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Various race distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the centre of Isselhorst, with several laps
Popular corporate race featuring team rankings and outlandish costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to two weeks before the event, subject to a late-entry fee, except for the Bambini and school races. On the day of the event, registration is available on site from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate based on kilometres run. There is an extensive preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” with weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with spectators lining the route, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied programme, music and a party.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: XTrail Breitnau is a versatile running event in the Hochschwarzwald that brings runners and Nordic walkers of all age groups together for a day. Four different events are offered: the popular XT-Run, with half-marathon and 10 km distances; the XT-Walk, with 12 km and 8 km distances; the XT-Challenge, an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20; and the XT-Kids run for the youngest participants. The courses cross varied terrain, with trails, steep climbs and panoramic views, and include an attractive race pack and professional timekeeping. The event is organized by Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place on June 27, 2026.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course with steep climbs and trails through the Ravennaschlucht
Nordic-walking routes on natural paths through Moos, Föhrwald and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with a serpentine climb and a varied course through the Kurgarten
additional: Race-number collection on event day from 08:00–11:00 and 12:30–13:45 at the fire station. Race numbers for XT-Kids and XT-Challenge are issued in sets for each club. Participation conditions and equipment requirements must be observed; for example, trail-running shoes with profiled soles for RUN and Nordic-walking poles for WALK. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish. Participants receive a personal digital certificate; XT-Kids finishers receive a medal. Exclusive trophies and prizes are awarded to overall and age-group winners. Late registration is possible for a fee until June 26 at 18:00, and on event day until one hour before the start. Multiple event types, distances and age groups; online registration; race numbers; refreshments; prizes; possible course changes.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The first stage starts in Förste on Sunday, 21 June 2026, and leads through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, and also offers a 750-metre kids’ stage in Schützenpark. The stages take place daily through 27 June 2026 and are organised by regional clubs.
course_highlights: Circular routes of 5 to 7 kilometres per stage
Route with views of Lichtenstein and impressions of the gypsum karst landscape
Passage past the world-famous Lichtenstein Cave
additional: The first stage starts at 10:45 a.m. on Sunday at the sports ground in Förste. The awards ceremony takes place on Saturday, 27 June 2026, at 6:00 p.m., including a prize draw for non-cash prizes. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers; club membership is not required. Minors need written consent from their parents. After the first stage, participants can enjoy a meal featuring pasta specialities from MTV Förste. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supports local sponsors and uses varied routes that encourage participants to discover both the natural surroundings and the local area.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra
description: The Hofer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event taking place on June 27, 2026, in Hof, Bavaria. The race starts at 09:00 and is, by definition, “open end”: it finishes only when one runner remains or everyone has dropped out. The course is a 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain, running along forest and woodland trails as well as asphalt. The event attracts participants from across Germany and beyond, and offers a special challenge for runners who want to discover and push their limits.
course_highlights: 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain
Course runs along forest and woodland trails as well as asphalt
Marked with Hofer Backyard Ultra arrows
additional: Maximum of 100 places. Check-in on June 26, 2026, from 07:30 at Hof Airport. 200 free parking spaces approximately 100 m from the start/finish area. A personal headlamp is required at night (from lap 13). Timekeeping may continue beyond 24 hours because the race is open end. The course includes paved paths, gravel and woodland trails, and the runway at Hof Airport; online registration; accommodation recommendations available; maximum of 100 participants; running continues until the final runner finishes.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a long-standing stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The 7th stage takes place on June 27, 2026, on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, which delights visitors with unspoiled nature, endless beaches, and a relaxed atmosphere. The stage starts and finishes on Gartenweg, near the Kurpark. The event offers a unique running experience in a special island landscape, combining a sporting challenge with enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Run across the car-free North Sea island of Spiekeroog, surrounded by unspoiled nature
Start and finish on Gartenweg, near the Kurpark
A relaxed atmosphere, endless beaches, and the island’s charm
additional: Race bib collection from 11:30 to 13:30 at the Inselkino. Sports bag storage from 13:00 to 16:00 at the Sportdeck. Changing rooms at the Sportdeck; showers at the Sportdeck and Inselbad. Toilets at the Sportdeck, Touristinfo “Kogge,” and the Kurpark. Awards ceremony at 16:30 at the Kurpark. Stage race across 7 North Sea islands; no waiting list; capacity is limited due to ferry and infrastructure constraints; registration is already sold out.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organised by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., takes place on 27 June 2026 from 18:00. Distances include 1 km for children and 5 km and 10 km for teenagers and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families and colleagues. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, free hot and cold drinks in the finish area, and changing and shower facilities after the run. A DJ provides entertainment, and an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails and drinks follows the races.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on an officially measured 5 km loop
1 km children’s race
2x5 km relay for teams
additional: The start and finish area is in the car park in front of Brünings Scheune (Landstraße 22). Walkers can register for the 5 km race. Free parking is available at the Fischerhude sports ground. Changing and shower facilities are available in the TSV-Fischerhude-Quelkhorn clubhouse. Races start from 19:45. The event takes place in all weather. The after-run party features a barbecue, cocktails and drinks. Proceeds go to regional projects. The event also includes a barbecue and after-run party, parking at the sports ground, and is scheduled to take place in all weather.

name: Südeichsfeldlauf
description: The Südeichsfeld Run in Diedorf is a traditional running event that takes place in all weather. Various races are offered, including a half marathon of 21.1 km with 445 metres of elevation gain, a long race of 11.3 km, and a short race of 5.9 km. There is a Bambini run and a schoolchildren’s race for children. All finishers receive medals, and the top runners are honoured with trophies and certificates.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21.1 km with 445 metres of elevation gain
Long race: 11.3 km with 210 metres of elevation gain
Short race: 5.9 km with 111 metres of elevation gain
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day from 8:00 to 8:45. All finishers receive medals. The top three men and women in the main races receive trophies; places 1–5 for men and women receive certificates on site. The Bambini run is untimed, and every participant receives a medal. The start and finish are at the sports ground, Katharinenbergerstraße 2, Diedorf. Course profiles and further information are available on the website. Registration opens on 01.03.2026; late registration is available on the event day.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
description: The University of Tübingen 100 km relay race is a long-running university sports event held annually in Tübingen. Teams of students and other participants cover the total distance of 100 kilometres together in relay legs. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Tübingen and offers both a sporting challenge and a shared experience. Refreshments and an accompanying programme are provided, making the race a special event for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A total distance of 100 kilometres covered in relay legs
A scenic course around Tübingen
A shared running experience as part of university sports
additional: The race is run as a relay, with refreshments and an accompanying programme available on site. Participation requirements and registration are handled through the University of Tübingen university sports website. Course through Tübingen, time limit of 4h 10min, team and runner registration, start at 13:00, support from physiotherapy students, medical care provided by Lorettoklinik

name: Ansmann Cup 2026
organizer: TSV Assamstadt 1947 e.V. und Laufgemeinschaft Tauberfranken
description: The Ansmann Cup 2026 is a long-standing fun run organized by TSV Assamstadt at Waldstadion Assamstadt. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, from the Bambini race to the 10 km main race. The course was redesigned in 2025 and features less elevation gain, making the event particularly appealing. Alongside the competition, the focus is on enjoying exercise and community.
course_highlights: New course since 2025 with less elevation gain
5 km loop with approximately 50 m of elevation change
Start and finish at Waldstadion Assamstadt
additional: Race number pickup from 13:00 to 16:00 in the festival tent. Water is available along the course; water, tea, and fruit are available at the finish. Showers are available at the sports clubhouse. Awards ceremonies for the Bambini race, the student/youth race, and the other races take place in the festival tent. Timing is provided by racesolution.de. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the respective start. The course has featured less elevation gain since 2025. Online registration is open until 23.06.2026; late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and showers are available at the sports clubhouse.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners every year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. Alongside the main race, there is also the Tower Staircase Run, in which participants climb 306 steps in the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, promising an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.
course_highlights: Uphill route at the Kyffhäuser Monument
Tower Staircase Run with 306 steps and 70 m of elevation gain
A range of distances from 2 km to marathon
additional: The Tower Staircase Run starts in groups of 10, with 2 minutes between groups. 60–70 starters are expected. The event takes place in summery temperatures and attracts over 2,400 participants every year. The event offers a unique opportunity to experience the nature of the Kyffhäuser Mountains, with details about registration and participation available on the official website. It is an ideal event for mountain-running enthusiasts and nature lovers.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basalt Run takes place on 27 June 2026 in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses are gently undulating, well marked and have kilometre markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organisers provide refreshments at the finish. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys being active in a group.
course_highlights: Gently undulating courses
Well-marked routes with kilometre markers
Drinks along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Race packs can be collected from 14:00; participants should arrive 30 minutes before their race. Certificates and small gifts are awarded for the Bambini and school races. The first three men and women in the main race receive certificates and prizes; age-group winners receive certificates. The event promotes community and enjoyment of sport, not just competition. Gently undulating course, registration until 26 June, changing rooms and showers available, community spirit and fun.

name: Citylauf Leonberg
description: The City Run Leonberg on June 27, 2026, offers a varied running experience for all age groups and ability levels. The routes pass through Leonberg’s historic old town, the picturesque center of Eltingen, and the modern city center at Neuköllner Platz, with several fan zones featuring live music and enthusiastic spectators. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is a 5 km race, a 1.4 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 0.4 km children’s race. The event is a lively sporting highlight for the whole city, with a fantastic start and finish atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through Leonberg’s historic old town and the center of Eltingen
Several fan zones with live music along the route
Flat course with moderate climbs and little elevation gain
additional: The start and finish are on Steinstraße, between the sports center/indoor swimming pool and the fairground. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports center. Timing uses a transponder integrated into the race bib (except for the children’s race, which is untimed). Age categories follow the German Athletics Federation’s rules. The 10 km race is approximately 9.7 km due to the course combination. The children’s race is untimed but includes team scoring. The schoolchildren’s race has age-group rankings and prizes. Race-pack collection begins at 15:00 at the Steinstraße fairground. The event includes various race categories, including relay and schoolchildren’s races. Registration for the 5 km race is open until June 22, 2026; participation in the 10 km race is also available. Special offers are available for groups and families.

name: DJK-Willibaldslauf
location: DJK Eichstätt Parkplatz, Eichstätt, Bavaria, Germany

description: The DJK-Willibaldslauf is an inclusive running event in Eichstätt, taking place for the second time on June 27, 2026. All age groups and fitness levels are welcome, from the children’s run and inclusion runs to the main run and Nordic walking. The scenic course follows the Altmühl and leads to the cathedral. The start and finish are at the DJK Eichstätt car park. The event focuses on community and fun, with no timekeeping. All participants receive high-quality running shirts and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Altmühl
The course leads to the cathedral and returns via a detour
Start and finish at the DJK Eichstätt car park
additional: Start and finish at the DJK Eichstätt car park; changing facilities directly at the start and finish area; free parking at the Volksfest car park. The programme includes a spiritual reflection and a blessing for athletes at 15:00. Staggered start times: children’s run at 15:30, youth run afterwards, inclusion runs at 16:00, main run at 17:00, and Nordic walking afterwards. No timekeeping; each participant receives a high-quality running shirt and a commemorative medal. On-site late registration is possible from 12:00 to 14:00. Various running categories, including inclusion runs. Online registration available.

name: Fuchsburg Lauf
location: Vohburg, Landkreis Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Fuchsburg Run is organized by TV Vohburg and takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival on June 27, 2026. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes through the region. The races include a 10 km main race, a 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 600 m Bambini race. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and the joy of sport, supported by a committed team from TV Vohburg.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the scenic surroundings of Vohburg
2.3 km schoolchildren’s race for young runners
600 m Bambini race for the youngest participants
additional: The run takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival. Separate races are held for Bambini, schoolchildren, and adults. The event is supported by a committed team, including course safety and refreshments. There is a participant limit; exact numbers are available on the website. Details about the routes, registration, schedule, and participation conditions are available on the website.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberg Run (LC/NLC) takes place on June 27, 2026, in Diekhof (Laage) and is hosted by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from a stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an appealing challenge for all participants. Registration is open until June 24, 2026.
course_highlights: Various distances for all age groups (2 km, 5 km, 10.5 km)
Scenic route around Schmooksberg
Part of the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Running Cup and the Nachwuchslauf
additional: Athletics competition, event held away from a stadium, registration deadline: June 24, 2026, with various age groups and race distances

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
location: Dorfplatz in Lubast, Kemberg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The 13th Lubaster Waldlauf takes place on 27 June 2026 in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy a short but varied forest run. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: Run through the Lubaster Forest
Two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km
Typical June weather with pleasant temperatures
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event is part of the Ranglistenläufe series; June weather is typically warm and sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: Ludwigshafener Stadtlauf
description: The Ludwigshafen City Run offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From races for toddlers and schoolchildren to youth and beginner races and a fun run for adults, there is something for everyone. The event features a friendly atmosphere, electronic timing, and a functional city-run shirt for all participants. The races take place on varied routes in Ludwigshafen am Rhein and are supported by the City of Ludwigshafen and the Ludwigshafen Sports Association.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from 2.3 km to the fun run
Electronic timing and a certificate available to download
Free refreshments and a city-run functional shirt for all participants
additional: Bib pickup from 12:00 at the tent on the square by the Werfthalle. Late registration is available until 1 hour before the respective race for an additional fee of 3 euros. Prizes for places 1 to 3 in various age groups and categories. Reusable cups are used for refreshments to reduce environmental impact. Terrain: urban/street, registration via www.br-timing.de, early registration recommended

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, the Müritz, and takes place on June 27, 2026, in Waren (Müritz). The course showcases the full diversity of the northern German landscape and has a gently rolling profile, making it ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organized by ESV Waren e.V., a long-established sports club that, with support from numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Loop around the Müritz, Germany’s largest inland lake
Gently rolling course profile
Diverse northern German landscape
additional: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is organized by ESV Waren e.V., which is also responsible for overall organization, course marshals, medical support, and catering in the finish area. The event is supported by numerous sponsors and receives help from local clubs and volunteer fire brigades. There is a relay race around the Müritz as well as the Röbel–Waren city race. The event offers a scenic setting, different race formats, and online registration. The course is gently undulating, with sections through nature and the national park.

name: Ravensburger Stadtlauf
organizer: Stadt Ravensburg, Sportverband Ravensburg, Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg
description: The Ravensburg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in the historic old town of Ravensburg and offers a unique running experience amid the picturesque city center. The event is being held for the 35th time and welcomes both active runners and spectators to enjoy its special atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Ravensburg, the Ravensburg Sports Association, and Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg, and hosted by LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V. The event promises exciting and entertaining running events in the sports city of Ravensburg.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Ravensburg
A unique running experience in the heart of the city center
An atmosphere with enthusiastic spectators lining the course
additional: Organizers: City of Ravensburg, Ravensburg Sports Association, and Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg; host: LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V.; information available from the City of Ravensburg’s Office for Education, Social Affairs and Sports at Tel: 0751 822443; event hours: 16:00 to 22:00. The run takes place in central Ravensburg, particularly around Marienplatz. Registration is open until June 24, 2026. The event is free for spectators to attend.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
location: Schöneiche bei Berlin, Oder-Spree, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The 14th Eichkaterlauf on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and children’s races to fun runs and the challenging 12 km premier event, there is something for everyone. The courses pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and offer a chance to enjoy a sporting event together. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with on-the-day registration also possible.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 400 m to 12 km
Courses through the natural surroundings of Schöneiche
Family-friendly event with Bambini and children’s races
additional: Online registration closes on June 26, 2026, at 12:00. Late registration is available at the venue on race day. The event takes place at Dorfaue / corner of Stegeweg (near the fairground) in Schöneiche. Various race distances, online registration, family-friendly, courses through natural surroundings

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
location: Stadion in Abensberg, Abensberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight of TSV Abensberg’s athletics department, which is committed to promoting recreational sport. By taking part in the city run, you support local running and make a statement in favor of a vibrant sports culture. The run is a great opportunity to log miles together toward a new tartan track and modern training equipment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the new Abensberg Stadium
Run together to help expand the sports facilities
Recreational sports event focused on community and the joy of exercise
additional: Training for youth and adults takes place at the stadium on Mondays from 18:00 to 19:30, and for children aged 6 and over on Fridays from 17:00 to 18:30. There is a running group on Mondays from 19:00 to 19:45. Taking part in the city run supports the development of a new tartan track and modern training equipment. City run on 27.06.2026, running event, support for local running, participation promotes local sports culture
