description: The REWAG Company Run on 15 July 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region, offering a unique opportunity to run, socialise and celebrate with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. Alongside the sporting experience, the run supports Jumpakids, the Regensburg Centre for Obesity in Children and Adolescents, with a donation. Registration opens on 1 May 2026, with individual and group entries available.
course_highlights: A major company running event with 3,000 places
Run and celebrate together in a relaxed atmosphere
Support for the Jumpakids social project
additional: Registration opens on 1 May 2026 at 9 a.m. Group registration is available and makes team scoring easier. Changes and reservations are possible until 6 July 2026. Transfers after registration closes are only possible on site for a fee of 5 euros. Start at the Stadtwerk.Donau-Arena; registration opens on 1 May 2026; start time is 6 p.m.; participation requires registration and payment; limit of 3,000 runners

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The race features a scenic loop of approximately 5 km on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approximately 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km. Participants can choose their preferred number of laps flexibly on race day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay, in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km loop in Wilhelmsburger Inselpark
Asphalt and paths underfoot
Checkpoint on the course to count laps
additional: Race packet distribution starts at 17:30. The finish closes at 21:30; sunset is at 21:41. The race distance can be chosen flexibly on race day. Relay teams consist of 2 to 4 runners; team members do not need to be named in advance. Eligibility by year of birth: 5 km from 2016, 10 km from 2012, 15 km from 2010. The race takes place at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. Online registration is available. Depending on the number of laps, the course distance is 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km, with a checkpoint to count laps.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
location: Nordufer des Gartower Sees, Gartow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a traditional running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartower Tannen, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the SV Gartow sports club, which has supported sporting activities and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Scenic course along Gartow Lake
Start and finish in the heart of Gartow
Run through the Gartower Tannen and the idyllic Elbe River valley
additional: SV Gartow is a long-established club with more than 600 members, offering a wide range of sports and regularly hosting events that attract participants from beyond the region. The running event is part of a vibrant sports community supported by volunteers. There are no fixed triathlon training times, but participants arrange individual meetups and take part in competitions. The event takes place in a scenic setting that also offers opportunities to relax and enjoy nature. It includes races for children, young people, adults, and seniors, with start times from 19:00. It is a great opportunity to experience nature and take part in sport.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberglauf is a traditional 10.4-kilometre race from Iphofen to Castell, taking place for the 42nd time on July 17, 2026. The course combines challenging climbs through vineyards and stretches through woodland with an idyllic finish in Castell Castle Park, accompanied by a wine-festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels, and its proceeds support social institutions. It is organised by volunteers from TG Kitzingen in collaboration with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at the Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen, followed by a steep climb through vineyards
Water stations at kilometres 3 and 6.5, and shortly before kilometre 7
Finish in Castell Castle Park with a wine-festival atmosphere
additional: Race-bib collection from 15:30 at the Karl-Knauf-Halle in Iphofen. Start groups are arranged according to your own 10-kilometre race time. Toilets are available at the Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departures from 16:50 to 17:45, approximately every 10 minutes). Luggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Showers are available in Castell (men at the Meierei, women at the sports club). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km; start in Iphofen, finish in Castell; refreshments along the course; showers in Castell; electronic timing; awards ceremony at the wine festival; online registration; overnight accommodation in Iphofen is recommended.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf is one of Germany’s largest Bürgerfest running events and takes place on July 17, 2026, in Freiberg. More than 1,600 runners take part across four different distances, from 600 meters to 10 kilometers. The event has a high finisher rate of over 95% and is followed by a Bürgerfest with live music in the market square. The start and finish are in the center of Freiberg, creating a lively, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Four distances: 600m Bambini Run, 1km Student Run, 5km Health Run, 10km OptiMove Run
Start and finish at Marktplatz Freiberg a.N.
Timing with a single-use transponder and a cutoff time of 1:20 hours for the 10km distance
additional: Race packet pickup and on-site registration at PRISMA on the market square on July 16 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on July 17 from 15:00. Awards ceremony from approximately 20:00 on the Seebühne. Changing facilities and showers at the Stadthalle and indoor swimming pool. Parking at the Wasen Sports Center (5–10 minutes on foot). Drinks provided during the race and from 18:00 as part of the Bürgerfest by local clubs. Online registration available; open to all age groups, with a festive program featuring music.

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: De Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op een zomeravond door de schaduwrijke bossen van de Veluwe rondom Apeldoorn. De race biedt vijf afstanden, variërend van 7,5 km tot de volledige marathon van 42,195 km, waarbij de start en finish plaatsvinden bij Sportpark Orderbos. De routes voeren grotendeels over brede Veluwse paden en bospaden met een afwisselend terrein en ongeveer 300 hoogtemeters, waardoor het een uitdagende en sfeervolle ervaring is. De starttijden zijn zo gepland dat je de avond inloopt en de finish ruim voor zonsondergang bereikt, wat de race een bijzondere zomerse ambiance geeft.
course_highlights: Lopen door schaduwrijke bossen van de Veluwe
Afwisselend terrein met ongeveer 300 hoogtemeters en een kwart onverhard
Start en finish bij Sportpark Orderbos, finish in daglicht
additional: Alle vijf afstanden starten later op de dag om de zomerse avond in te lopen. De marathon heeft een limiettijd van 5 uur en deelnemers mogen een eigen meefietser meenemen die langs het parcours kan ondersteunen. Parkeren is gratis en op loopafstand van de startlocatie. Bij de inschrijving zijn een finishmedaille en een Midzomer-shirt inbegrepen. Startnummer omwisselen naar een kortere afstand is op de dag zelf gratis mogelijk bij het secretariaat. Het evenement draait mede op vrijwilligers die helpen met diverse taken. Vijf afstanden: 7,5 km, 14 km, halve marathon, 28 km en marathon; supporter-fietsen mogelijk bij halve en volledige marathon; faciliteiten zoals water- en fruitposten, gratis parkeren en OV-verbindingen.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt 50 Euro pro Teilnehmer.

description: The Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. This unique endurance format is not about speed, but about completing a 6.706-kilometre lap within 60 minutes every hour and starting again promptly on the hour. The course runs mainly along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, starting and finishing at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family-friendly atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.
course_highlights: An exact 6.706-kilometre loop
Course along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim
Start and finish area at the Blatzheim sports field
additional: Each new lap starts promptly on the hour. Anyone who does not finish a lap in time or fails to show up for the next start on time is eliminated. Any time remaining in the hour after finishing may be used freely for recovery, refreshments or short breaks. The maximum number of participants is limited to 50 to ensure a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is online only and is binding only after payment. Participation is at your own risk; good health is required. The course runs along field and farm tracks, with the start and finish area at the sports field. A maximum of 50 participants; the event continues until the 30th lap is reached or a participant is unable to continue.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen offers runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 km circuit and 5 km course with a turnaround point
Officially measured and DLV-approved running courses
Classifications for the district championships (Rotenburg/W.) and regional championships (Lüneburg)
additional: Late registration is possible until 18:00 on the day of the event, with a €3 late-entry fee in addition to the entry fee. Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 at the announcer’s stand at the sports field. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports hall on Schulstraße. Parking is available at the sports grounds and at the gymnasium. Awards will be presented to the top three finishers in each race and gender; all participants will receive a medal. Certificates are available online. The event starts at 19:00 and offers a summery running atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for runners of all ages to compete and take part in championships.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and field paths. Each lap involves about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited participation and no entry fee; runners must bring their own provisions.
course_highlights: 15 laps alternating between asphalt and field paths
About 1,125 m of total elevation gain
6:00 a.m. start
additional: No entry fee; participants must bring their own provisions. A small field, with 21 finishers to date. Typical July weather: around 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night, usually sunny. The event is a small, close-knit ultramarathon community, with about 21 finishers in previous editions.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf
price_range: Bar in bar am Veranstaltungstag, 3€ für Nachmeldung
description: The Hakro City Run in Schrozberg is a charity running event at which €5 is donated for each participant to support Jugendhilfe Creglingen. The run is open to all age groups and encourages young and old to run together. There are individual competitions by registration class, as well as a team competition for companies, clubs, families and friends. The event aims to run smoothly and asks participants to register in advance by 16 July 2025.
course_highlights: Team competition with five runners covering 2 km each
Individual competitions by registration class
Separate classification for children and young people up to 18 years old
additional: Late entries are accepted up to a maximum of 1 hour before the start, with a €3 late-entry fee. The entry fee must be paid in cash on the event day. Participants in the 400 m run receive certificates. The run is open to all ages and genders. The event includes races for companies, clubs, families and friends, including a relay competition. The course runs through the festival grounds, where additional activities are available. Donations go to Jugendhilfe Creglingen.

description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a traditional running event held every July around Lake Altmühl in Gunzenhausen. The event includes various races, including a half marathon, a relay, a fun run, a schoolchildren’s race and a Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and run through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühl. The event offers both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance and enjoy a day of sport together.
course_highlights: Flat half-marathon course around Lake Altmühl with kilometre markers
Relay race with the half-marathon distance divided flexibly among 2–4 runners
The courses pass Schlungenhof, Muhr am See, Streudorfer Brücke and Seezentrum Wald
additional: Relay race for 2–4 runners, starting together with the half marathon at 18:00. Relay baton with an integrated transponder for timing. Late registration for the Bambini run is possible until 15:45 on race day. Medals for all finishers; certificates and trophies for age-group and overall winners. Company relay teams have their own classification. Race bibs display first names for those who register in advance. Course around Lake Altmühl, officially measured; registration by direct debit; start at 18:00; various race categories for children, young people and adults.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf on July 18, 2026, offers runners breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb. The varied course winds along forest-edge trails and open stretches around Weißenstein, rewarding the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event celebrates the joy of sport in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.
course_highlights: Breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb
Varied trails with forest-edge paths and open stretches
Explore the Alb’s elevation gains through sport
additional: Course distances of 4.5 km and 11.5 km, varied scenery, elevation gains of the Alb, nature experience

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: With three scenic routes in the Franconian Wine Country, the Maintal Ultratrail offers an enjoyable trail-running experience. The 30 km route with 720 metres of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves and varied woodlands along the Main River. The event is aimed at trail-running enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared experience of running. The motto for all participants is: fun and enjoying nature come first—not just athletic performance.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 720 metres of elevation gain through the Main Valley and Franconian Wine Country
Varied landscapes: limestone beech forests, Mediterranean flora, vineyards and meadow valleys
Typical meanders of the Main Valley with picturesque views
additional: The online registration deadline is 30.06.2026. A high-quality technical shirt can be ordered for an additional €20 until 31.05.2026. Please note the BLV late registration surcharge. Food and refreshments for runners and visitors are well catered for in the start and finish area. The route is undulating, with some steep climbs; the cut-off time at aid station 5 is 3 p.m. The event also offers longer distances of 13 km and 64 km, with the start and finish at the SV Veitshöchheim sports ground. On-site registration is available, and the route includes natural trails and elevation gain that make the race challenging and varied.

name: Sparkasse Kraichgau CityCup Bretten
location: TV Platz, Bretten, Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkasse Kraichgau City Cup Bretten is a popular race that has been held annually since 2004 and attracts many runners from the region. The races take runners through Bretten’s beautiful old town, with its narrow streets and market square lined with half-timbered houses. Various distances are offered, including children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with medals for all children and special prizes for schools and relay teams.
course_highlights: Run through Bretten’s historic old town
Start and finish at TV Platz
Laps around TV Platz and through the old town
additional: Race-number pickup from 15:15 at TV Platz. Medals for all children at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available. The relay exchange zone is opposite the start/finish, on the sports field. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the race starts, with a €2.00 surcharge. Run through the old town, start and finish at TV Platz, registration open, preparation courses as part of the running group

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Spendenlauf Recke on July 18, 2026, is a charity event in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke, the event offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and those who prefer a relaxed run, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners looking for a greater challenge. The focus is on coming together for a good cause, with the entire entry fee donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route, ideal for beginners and relaxed runners
10-kilometer route for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge
Charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster
additional: The entire entry fee will be donated. The organizers are Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke. The event supports Kinderkrebshilfe Münster, which gives hope and improves quality of life for affected children and families. Routes: 5 km and 10 km; online registration only; run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: De Amsterdam Pride Run is een kleurrijk en inclusief hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt tijdens de Pride Amsterdam festiviteiten. Het evenement wordt georganiseerd door Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam en Pride and Sports en biedt een sportieve viering van diversiteit en gelijkheid. De run vindt plaats in de stad Amsterdam en trekt een breed publiek van hardlopers en supporters die samen de LGBTQ+ gemeenschap steunen. De sfeer is feestelijk en verbindend, met aandacht voor sportiviteit en inclusiviteit.
course_highlights: Hardlooproute door het centrum van Amsterdam
Inclusieve en feestelijke sfeer tijdens Pride Amsterdam
Organisatie door Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam en Pride and Sports
additional: De Amsterdam Pride Run vindt plaats in de middag tijdens Pride Amsterdam, met een deelnamebijdrage die varieert van €8 tot €18. Het evenement is onderdeel van een breder programma van queer sportactiviteiten georganiseerd door Pride and Sports. Er is een feestelijke en veilige sfeer met aandacht voor inclusiviteit en sportiviteit. Route door Flevopark en langs Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, meerdere race-opties inclusief wandeling en business run, kleurrijk en inclusief evenement tijdens World Pride

name: Turfveld Zomercross, Texel

tiers.label: tier_1

description: De Turfveld Zomercross in Den Burg, Texel, is een sfeervolle hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op zondagochtenden in juli en augustus. De route voert door het afwisselende landschap van Texel, met een beschut parcours in het bos, een pittige klim en mooie paadjes. Er zijn verschillende afstanden voor diverse leeftijden, waaronder een eigen rondje voor de jeugd. De start is om 10:30 uur, met inschrijving vanaf 9:45 uur bij Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld.
course_highlights: Afwisselend boslandschap met beschutte paden
Pittige klim in het parcours
Mooie natuurlijke paadjes
additional: Inschrijven kan vanaf 9:45 uur bij Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2, 1791 PB Den Burg. Er zijn aparte afstanden voor jeugd tot 12 jaar (1 km), jeugd 13 t/m 15 jaar (2 km) en vanaf 15 jaar (4 en 8 km). De wedstrijd wordt wekelijks op zondag gehouden in juli en augustus. Hardloopwedstrijd met verschillende afstanden, locatie in bosrijke omgeving, inschrijving vanaf 9.45 uur, start om 10.30 uur.

name: Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and the Youth and Sparkasse Main Run. The event is known for its great atmosphere and sporting challenges. New this year is the Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, combining races in different landscapes and offering a special challenge. Registration is already open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to take part and enjoy an urban and nature-rich running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen
A range of race courses for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, and adults
New: Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, with races in urban, rural, and riverside settings
additional: The event includes several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and Youth and Sparkasse Main Run. A new cup ranking covers three races in 2026 (Essinger Panoramaläufe, Kocher Cup Unterkochen, Aalen City Run). Individual entry in the Team Run is possible. Invoices/receipts can be issued after the event. Various race distances, the “Stadt-Land-Fluss-Cup” race series, online registration, race-bib collection on event day, parking options in Aalen, limited changing facilities, and valuables storage.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
location: Erlenbach am Main, Landkreis Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns to Erlenbach am Main as a city race on July 19. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and follows a flat, scenic route along the Main before passing through Erlenbach’s old town on the way to the finish. The event offers races for different age groups and distances, from children’s races to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, and showcases Erlenbach at its best.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic route along the Main
Start and finish at the old fire station in the town centre
Circuit through Erlenbach’s old town with good facilities
additional: Race materials will be distributed at the old fire station from 13:30 on race day. Shirts are available while supplies last. Timing is done by scanning race bibs at the finish. Parking is available at the outdoor swimming pool and the train station. 80% of the entry fee will be refunded until 12.07.2026, and 50% thereafter. Transfers to another participant are possible at any time. Several race distances are offered, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and shorter races; the event promotes running in the region; registration is possible until race day.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of movement, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and food and refreshments will be available on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport
Distances from 500 m to the half marathon (21 km)
Water station on the half-marathon course
additional: On-site late registration is possible, with a €2.00 late registration fee for events of 4 km and longer. Bib pickup begins at 7:30 a.m. on race day in the terminal building. Awards are given to places 1–3 in the age-group and overall categories. The “Airpott” café and restaurant offers light snacks and drinks. Participants are asked to return their bib after finishing. Various running and walking distances, family-friendly, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport

name: Heumadener Volkslauf 2026
location: Sportgelände Untere Hasenwedel, Stuttgart-Heumaden, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Heumaden Fun Run has been held annually in Stuttgart-Heumaden since 2009 and offers runners three distances: 5.5 km, 10.3 km and, since 2018, a half marathon of 21 km. The route is a long, relatively flat loop with few hills, passing through the districts of Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat. The start and finish are at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds. The event is part of the Family Sports Festival and has a water station on the longer route.
course_highlights: Long, flat loop with few hills
Route through Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat
Start and finish at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds
additional: The 10.3 km route is run twice as a loop. There is a water station halfway along the route. The event is part of TSV Heumaden’s Family Sports Festival. It also includes an inclusive walk after the races and is part of the annual Family Sports Festival in Stuttgart-Heumaden.

name: Internationaler Allgäu Volkslauf
description: The International Allgäu Volkslauf in Leutkirch has been held annually on Children’s Festival Sunday since 1970 and has grown into a major sporting event, attracting hundreds of runners from southern Germany and the partner cities. Organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V., the race is supported by numerous volunteers, the Leutkirch German Red Cross, the city administration, and other partners. The race is a traditional sporting fixture in Leutkirch and offers a varied event for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in the Allgäu region
Various categories for children, teenagers, and adults
A friendly, community atmosphere with warm support along the route
additional: The Volkslauf is organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V. and takes place on Children’s Festival Sunday. The event is supported by partner clubs, the Leutkirch German Red Cross, the Red Cross from the partner city of Castiglione, the city administration, and the municipal public works department. It is a traditional event of great regional significance. The event includes various race distances, including a Bambini run and longer distances for older children, and offers a family-friendly sporting community experience.

name: Jakob Scheuring Lauf
description: The 24th Jakob Scheuring Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Murgstadion Ottenau and includes timed, ranked races over 1.5 km for schoolchildren, 5 km and 10 km. The route leads from the stadium through the picturesque Salzwiesental, mostly through woodland and meadows, and back to the stadium. The event is part of the Sportvereinigung Ottenau sports festival and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony in the festival tent.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Murgstadion Ottenau
Route through the idyllic Salzwiesental, over woodland and meadow terrain
Approx. 140 m elevation difference for the 10 km course and approx. 40 m for the 5 km course
additional: Race number collection at the festival grounds entrance from 07:30 to 08:50. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a €2 fee. Drinks are available in the start/finish area and at the 10 km turnaround point. Certificates and prizes are awarded to the top three in each age group. Special prize of €250 for a course record. Awards ceremony from approx. 12:00 in the festival tent. Changing and shower facilities are available at Murgstadion. Ample parking is available at Murgstadion. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start; refreshments, changing facilities and parking are available.

name: neuefinanzkultur Laufevent mit Biosphärenlauf und Auinger Alblauf
description: The Neue Finanzkultur running event in Auingen on the Swabian Alb is an annual major race day with various events, including the Biosphärenlauf and the Auinger Alblauf. Alongside the sporting competition, there is also a charity walking event in aid of Clowns im Dienst. The event offers transponder timing, awards for the fastest runners in each age group, and special prizes for the largest group. Children can take part in an untimed Bambini run and receive a medal, certificate, and surprise.
course_highlights: Races on the Swabian Alb, including the Biosphärenlauf and the Auinger Alblauf
Transponder timing provided by time 2finish GbR
Untimed Bambini run with a medal and certificate
additional: Start and finish at the Auingen sports clubhouse, with changing rooms and showers. Race-number distribution from 8:00 Uhr at the Auingen community center. Transponder deposit: 5 €; personal transponders are not permitted. Special prize for the largest group by number of participants (excluding walking). Disclaimer: Participation is at your own risk. Running event held as part of the race day; details about terrain or registration are not provided.

name: Sommer Rheinauenlauf
description: The Summer Rheinauen Run in Bad Bellingen is a traditional running event organised by TV Rheinweiler. The races wind through the picturesque Rhine meadows and offer varied routes for runners of all ages. The event includes several distances and welcomes both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. Alongside the sporting competition, the sense of community is also a key part of the event.
course_highlights: Run through the idyllic Rhine meadows
Varied route with a chance to enjoy nature
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Multiple race categories, start and finish in the Kurpark, registration via the website

name: Stundenlauf VfL Dettenhausen
location: VfL Dettenhausen sports ground, Dettenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 24-Hour Run in Dettenhausen is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 20th time on July 18, 2026. The event is held at the VfL Dettenhausen sports grounds and gives both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance. Participation is free, and a strong emphasis is placed on community and fitness. The course uses a microchip integrated into the race bib for easy timekeeping, and overnight accommodation is available directly at the sports grounds.
course_highlights: Loop course at the VfL Dettenhausen sports grounds
Microchip timekeeping integrated into the race bib
Overnight accommodation in tents or motorhomes in designated areas
additional: Race bib collection is on Friday evening from 18:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 8:00 onwards, on site; teams of 5 to 12 people are allowed, with only one runner on the course at a time; showers and toilets are available on site; donations are welcome, and participation is free. The run takes place at the sports grounds; overnight stays in tents or motorhomes are possible; timekeeping is by microchip; barbecues and open fires are not permitted; dogs are prohibited.

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
price_range: Bambinilauf kostenlos, Schülerlauf 3 Euro, 5km Lauf 7 Euro, 10km Lauf 12 Euro, Halbmarathon 15 Euro
description: The Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf will be held for the 21st time on 19 July 2026, organised by Lauftreff Unterreichenbach. The event offers runners of all ages and ability levels a varied running experience on well-marked routes along the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path and surfaced forest and field paths. The races range from a children’s fun run to schoolchildren’s races and 5 km runs, up to the half marathon. The team places great importance on a relaxed and sporting atmosphere, supported by refreshment stations and chip-free timing.
course_highlights: Routes follow the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path and surfaced forest and field paths
Well-marked routes with kilometre markers and directional signs
Refreshment stations every 2.5 km with mineral water, apple spritzer and damp sponges
additional: Timing is chip-free. The start and finish are at 310 m above sea level, and the highest point of the course is at 460 m above sea level. The races start in staggered intervals between 09:00 and 09:35. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (except for the schoolchildren’s and children’s fun runs). Refreshment stations every 2.5 km provide mineral water, apple spritzer and damp sponges. Routes follow the cycle path and forest paths. Water stations, changing rooms and showers are available on site, and parking is available.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Schwäbisch Hall
location: Optima Sportpark, Schwäbisch Hall, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 19,00 Euro pro Person – erste 500 Anmeldungen (Early Bird)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 22,00 Euro pro Person – 501 bis 1.000 Anmeldungen bzw. bis zum Meldeschluss am 13. Juni 2026 (18:00 Uhr)

description: The AOK Company Run Schwäbisch Hall is a popular team event taking place on July 22, 2026, at the Optima Sportpark. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and is run twice, offering a great opportunity to get active with colleagues. Alongside the run, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program featuring a DJ, a group warm-up, award ceremonies, and complimentary refreshments at the finish. The company run fosters team spirit and combines exercise with socializing.
course_highlights: Course is approximately 5 kilometers long and is run twice
Start and finish at the Optima Sportpark Schwäbisch Hall
Complimentary refreshments at the finish, including Erdinger Alkoholfrei, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 5:00 p.m., a DJ will set the mood on stage. There will be a group warm-up before the start. After the finish, award ceremonies and music will take place. Registration is handled through a company registration, with a team captain registering the team members. Changes to registrations are possible for a fee until one day before the event. Minimum age: 16. Run at the Optima Sportpark, team event, preparation tips, refreshments at the finish

name: Wild and Run
description: Wild & Run on July 22, 2026, turns Oberkollbach into a running paradise and is part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw. The event offers runners a varied route through nature and invites both ambitious runners and running enthusiasts to get to the starting line. The Wild & Run team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a sporting atmosphere in idyllic surroundings.
course_highlights: Running route through nature around Oberkollbach
Part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw
Varied and scenic route
additional: Wild & Run is an established event with several editions and also offers children’s races. Registration is online via the official website. The event is organized by Sportverein Oberkollbach. Running route, registration, children’s races, part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lake Lippesee, a popular leisure area and water sports center. Participants must bring their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is intended for experienced runners aged 18 and over, has a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.
course_highlights: Seven laps of 6.1 km around Lake Lippesee, 42.7 km in total
The course is marked with arrows and tape; a GPS track and map are available in advance
The course can be very busy in good weather; participants can access their own supplies at their car after each lap
additional: Timekeeping is done with a manual stopwatch; a photo of the clock taken on race day must be emailed as proof. Showers and changing rooms are not available. Participation is at your own risk, and a liability waiver applies. Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the event, providing personal details. The organizer requests a voluntary donation of €5 for a tree. Minimum age: 18. Participant limit: 18. Course: 7 laps of 6.1 km each. Participants bring their own supplies; no showers or changing rooms. Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability.

name: Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen
description: The Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen is a long-standing running event taking place for the 20th time on 23 July 2026. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, from Bambini and young people to ambitious adults. The race brings the whole city together, with a special focus on the joy of running and sharing the experience. Whether you are a beginner, a team player or a competitive runner, there is a suitable category for everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of courses for children, young people and adults
Start and finish at Rathausplatz in Bad Säckingen
The challenging Grieshaber Grand Prix has a time limit
additional: Parent-child race with no timing and no race number; free participation on the day of the event is possible without registration. Late entry fee on the day of the event: €5 per entry. Adult running shirts can be added for €15; the ordering deadline has passed. Runners with a finish time over 22 minutes start in the second wave at 18:57. The Grieshaber Grand Prix is for competitive runners, with a 35-minute time limit. Certificates can be requested online via Datasport. Registration required; race number collection, award ceremonies and certificates; various race categories and age groups; the event takes place at Rathausplatz.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria, offering races for children, recreational runners and experienced participants. The event takes place in summer and is part of the Bavarian running calendar. Distances range from short races for schoolchildren to main races of about 9 kilometres. Its night-race format gives runners the chance to run under the evening sky, setting it apart from typical daytime races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 780 m to approx. 10 km
Night-race atmosphere under the evening sky
Summer event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for children and recreational runners. July weather is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night. Night race with multiple distances, part of the Bavarian running calendar, held in summer in Bad Staffelstein.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the midst of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a recreational and therapeutic forest unique in Europe, with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large loops of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported running event with manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are requested.
course_highlights: 6 loops of 7.05 km through the Heilwald in Bad Lippspringe
A species-rich therapeutic forest unique in Europe, with a low-mountain climate
Self-supported event, with refreshments available at your own car after each loop
additional: Time is recorded using a manual stopwatch; proof must be submitted by email on race day as a photo of the clock. Showers and changing facilities are not available. Participant limit: 18. Minimum age: 18. Participation is at your own risk, with a liability waiver. The organizer reserves the right to reject registrations without giving a reason. Course: 6 loops of 7.05 km; self-supported; no showers or changing facilities on site; participation at your own risk; limited field of 18.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 20,- EURO in der Online-Voranmeldung für alle Teilnehmer.

description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run takes place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with late-evening start times. The main course covers 10 km through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the waterfront promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the route. Additional races include the Binnensee Run (approx. 5.5 km), the Midnight Run Double Mile (approx. 3.2 km) for young people, and the Mini Midnight Run (approx. 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition, featuring electronic timing and a lively program on race day.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through Heiligenhafen, including the waterfront promenade and inland lake
Gentle ascents and descents; start and finish at the Lütjenburger Weg sports field
Additional distances: 5.5 km Binnensee Run, 3.2 km Double Mile, 1 km Mini Midnight Run
additional: Electronic timing with transponder technology at no rental charge; late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee; participant limit of 1,250 runners; relay race available; extensive supporting program with children’s races, the Double Mile, the Binnensee Run, and Zumba events. The race is officially measured, with certificates, trophies, and cash prizes for the top finishers. Individual and relay races are available; participation is open from age 16.

name: Waldlaufmeisterschaft SV Renquishausen
description: The 37th Waldlauf Championships will take place on July 24, 2026, in Renquishausen in the Black Forest. The race is part of the Silberdistel Runs and offers various distances for Bambini, schoolchildren, the everyone’s race, and the main race. The event is open to all age groups and takes place in all weather conditions. Race numbers will be distributed from 16:00, and the awards ceremony will take place at the sports hall about an hour after the last finisher crosses the finish line.
course_highlights: Distances: Bambini 500 m, schoolchildren 1 km and 2 km, everyone’s race 5.7 km, main race 10 km
Start times from 17:30 for Bambini, 17:35/17:45 for schoolchildren, and 18:00 for the everyone’s race and main race
Changing rooms and showers available at Renquishausen Community Center
additional: Late registration is possible at race headquarters up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Race numbers will be distributed from 16:00 in the foyer of the Community Center. The awards ceremony and certificate distribution will take place at the sports hall about 1 hour after the last finisher crosses the finish line. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Community Center. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Start times: Bambini 17:30, schoolchildren 17:35/17:45, main race and everyone’s race 18:00; July weather is usually around 25°C and mostly sunny.

name: WAREMA Lauf
description: The 19th WAREMA Run in Marktheidenfeld offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. From the short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to the motivating 5 km company run and the challenging 10 km main race, there is something for everyone. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and exciting spirit, which appeal to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at the Kreissportanlage, the event’s central venue.
course_highlights: Bambini and schoolchildren’s races over short distances (630m, 1260m)
5 km company run as a team competition
10 km main race as a challenge for distance runners
additional: Start times: Bambini race 17:00, schoolchildren’s race 17:15, schoolchildren’s relay 17:30, company run 18:00, 10 km race 18:45. Teams consist of 4 people. The event takes place at the Kreissportanlage in Marktheidenfeld. Distances include a 630 m Bambini race, 1260 m schoolchildren’s race, 4x630 m schoolchildren’s relay, 5 km company run, and 10 km main race; registration is online, and the start and finish are at the Kreissportanlage.

name: Moore DRV Run Maasdijk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 10 Km  € 13,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 5 Km  € 12,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

description: De Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is een gezellige hardloopwedstrijd in het Westland, gehouden tijdens het Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. De hoofdafstand is 10 kilometer over een verkeersvrij, snel asfaltparcours door de polder en langs iconische dijken. Daarnaast is er een 5 km prestatieloop, de 5 van DAEL, en een jeugdloop voor kinderen tot 12 jaar. Na de finish ontvangen deelnemers een origineel runningshirt en uitstekende verzorging op het sfeervolle finishveld.
course_highlights: Verkeersvrij parcours door de polder en langs dijken
Geheel geasfalteerd en snel asfalt met waterposten
Iconische finishlocatie in het dorp Maasdijk
additional: Startnummers kunnen op de wedstrijddag vanaf 10:30 uur worden afgehaald bij de kantine van korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. De 5 km start om 14:00 uur, gevolgd door de 10 km om 14:10 uur. Er is kleed- en douchegelegenheid bij de korfbalvereniging. De uitslagen worden verwerkt met een SAW-chip, die eenmalig €4,50 kost en niet inbegrepen is in het inschrijfgeld. De jeugdloop wordt zonder chip gelopen. De race vindt plaats tijdens het Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk en biedt een gezellige sfeer voor alle leeftijden, inclusief jeugdactiviteiten en speciale herinneringen voor deelnemers.

name: DJK Jakobuslauf
description: The Augsburg St. James Run, organized by the DJK Diocesan Association, is a special mass-participation event held as part of Augsburg’s oldest folk festival, the Jakober Kirchweih. The run is open to joggers and walkers and deliberately has no official timekeeping, embracing the motto “Experience over Results.” The event includes children’s races and three distances for adults, including a quarter marathon along the Lech. The start and finish are at Jakobsplatz by the famous Fuggerei, giving the run a historic and atmospheric setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jakobsplatz by the historic Fuggerei
Route along the Lech
10.5-kilometer quarter marathon for adults
additional: The run has no official timekeeping, putting enjoyment and the experience first. The ecumenical event is organized by the Catholic DJK Diocesan Association of Augsburg. The Fuggerei opens to visitors free of charge during the Jakober Kirchweih for the run. Distances are available for children, walkers, and adults; there is no official timekeeping, with a focus on community and experience; start and finish at Jakobsplatz in the Fuggerei.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: Freundschaftslauf Hasborn
description: The Hasborn Friendship Run is a long-standing running event organized annually by DJK Hasborn. It offers a range of distances, from short races for young runners to challenging distances such as 5 km, 11 km and 21 km. The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, with lively crowds and numerous volunteers helping to make the event a success. The run is a sporting highlight in the region and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 100 m to 21 km
Motivating atmosphere with music and refreshment stations
Family-friendly running event with a large number of participants
additional: The run takes place every summer, with a big bridge party featuring music and cheerleaders as a motivational point along the course. Water, sports drinks and snacks are available along the route. The club's running group meets regularly on Wednesdays, providing a good opportunity to prepare for the run. Routes for children and adults; no official times for all distances; an annual event with a special sense of community.

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail race starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The course has a modest elevation gain of around 350 metres and must be completed within 8 hours. It runs through woodland and trails, past Brelinger Berg and its geological nature trail, then back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates and finisher medals.
course_highlights: 50 km trail with approximately 350 m of elevation gain
Loop course over Brelinger Berg and its geological nature trail
Section along Bissendorfer Moor
additional: Participants have 8 hours to complete the course. The event offers finisher medals, online results and certificates. Typical July weather is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days. The route includes 16 km from Kaltenweide to Brelingen, 18 km around Brelinger Berg and the Geological Natural Monument, and the final 16 km back to Kaltenweide along Bissendorfer Moor. The event offers certificates and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs right along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining a sporting challenge with a North Sea atmosphere. The event is hosted by running and sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with extensive experience. The Fries festival takes place alongside the race, bringing atmosphere, music and culinary highlights.
course_highlights: Course right along Schillig beach
Route along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea
Course across sandy beaches, green meadows and muddy seabed
additional: The event is hosted by running and sports presenter Heino Krüger. The Fries festival takes place alongside the Friesencross on Schillig beach, bringing music, atmosphere and culinary highlights. Races on sand, meadows and tidal flats; various distances (400 m to 10 km); supporting program with the Fries festival; registration includes a T-shirt; race commentary by Heino Krüger.

name: Allersberger Kirchweihlauf
location: Marktplatz Allersberg, Allersberg, Mittelfranken, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Allersberg Kirchweih Run takes place annually on the last weekend of July in Allersberg and is part of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup in the BLV Middle Franconia-South district. The event offers various races, including a 400-meter Bambini run and other competitions for schoolchildren and adults. The course is a very flat loop starting and finishing at Allersberg Market Square. Water stations and refreshments at the finish are provided, and the event is organised by an experienced team.
course_highlights: Very flat loop at Allersberg Market Square
2 water stations per lap
Refreshments at the finish: water, isotonic drinks, apples and bananas
additional: The race office, awards ceremony, late entries, race-pack collection and changing facilities are located in the Westhof Gilardihaus at Marktplatz 20. Showers are available at the Rothseehalle TSV Allersberg, Altenfeldener Str. 16. description: De Kooyman Polderloop is een jaarlijkse hardloopwedstrijd in de Kwakel, georganiseerd door Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. Deze populaire loop vindt plaats in een mooie sportzomer en trekt veel deelnemers, waaronder veel leden van AVA. De wedstrijd biedt een sfeervolle en sportieve avond met een uitdagend parcours door het polderlandschap. Het evenement is een vaste waarde in de regio en staat bekend om zijn gezellige en toegankelijke karakter.
course_highlights: Lopen door het karakteristieke polderlandschap
Avondwedstrijd met een sportieve en gezellige sfeer
Organisatie door de lokale atletiekvereniging AVA Aalsmeer
additional: De startlocatie is doorgaans bij AVA, Sportlaan 43 te Aalsmeer. Er is een gezellige nazit met koffie of thee in het clubgebouw. De vereniging organiseert ook wandelgroepen en hardloopcursussen, wat de sportieve gemeenschap versterkt. De inschrijving verloopt via Inschrijven.nl; het evenement maakt deel uit van het Polderfeest met activiteiten zoals food festivals, optredens en familieactiviteiten over meerdere dagen.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each lap. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.
course_highlights: 7 large laps of 6.10 km each, 42.7 km in total
Course marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather
Self-sufficiency is possible, as runners pass their cars after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the parking lot by the Stadthalle, Hauptstraße 120, 33378 Rheda-Wiedenbrück. No showers or changing rooms are available on site, but there are toilets with warm water 150 m away and two additional toilets near the course. Participant limit: 22. Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the event, providing first name, last name, year of birth, and club. Participation is at your own risk; a liability waiver applies. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch; the ultramarathon has external timekeeping, with a photo as proof. Participants who stop the clock for drink breaks will be disqualified. Course: 7 laps of 6.10 km; ultra: 8 laps of 6.25 km; no showers; toilet 150 m away; participants must be at least 18; registration by 6 p.m. on the day before the event.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, featuring a 6.14 km trail loop. The event is not competition-focused; it is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.
course_highlights: Trail course at Heideteich
6.14 km loop
Natural running course in Rheda-Wiedenbrück
additional: The run is explicitly not competition-focused. The organizer is Evi Köppe-Neeb. The course consists of trail loops at Heideteich, each 6.14 km long. The marathon is part of a regional event series; specific details about registration and terrain have not been published.

name: 6. Bienwald Backyard Ultra
description: The Bienwald Backyard Ultra is a challenging ultrarunning event in Kandel, Rhineland-Palatinate. As one of the Silver Ticket Races, it gives the winners the opportunity to compete as part of the German team at the Big Dog's World Championships 2023. The event takes place at Bienwaldstadion and attracts ambitious ultrarunners looking to test their endurance and mental strength.
course_highlights: Venue: Bienwaldstadion in Kandel
Silver Ticket Race with qualification for the Big Dog's World Championships
Ultramarathon format with a special focus on endurance
additional: The race is known for its tactical variety and attracts returning participants. Registration has already closed, and all places have been filled.

name: Nordschwarzwald Trophy
description: The Nordschwarzwald Trophy is a sporting event in Schömberg, offering various competitions and running routes in the picturesque Northern Black Forest. The event features varied courses and a welcoming atmosphere that appeals to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. Organised by Eventservice Stahl, the Trophy combines a sporting challenge with a sense of community in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A variety of running routes in the Northern Black Forest
Natural surroundings and varied scenery
Event in the municipality of Schömberg
additional: Results and certificates are provided online. The event is organised by Eventservice Stahl, which also manages other sporting events. The event also includes results and certificates, which are available online. It takes place in July 2026 and offers varied scenery in the Kurpark and at the Himmelsglück observation tower.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), meaning results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially recognized race in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop measured by the DLV
Kilometer markers color-coded and signposted
Gently hilly course with an elevation difference of approx. 20 m
additional: Start and finish at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe. Registration opens on March 22, 2026. Other events include the 15 km Stadtwerke Springe Run and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. The course is officially measured and recognized for rankings. Starts from 5:45 p.m.; part of the Laufpass series; course profile with 35 m of elevation gain.

name: Xaver-Höger-Gedächtnislauf
location: Waldstadion, Rothensteiner Straße 9, Bad Grönenbach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Xaver-Höger Memorial Run takes place on July 31, 2026, at the Waldstadion in Bad Grönenbach. The event is organized by TV Bad Grönenbach 1894 e.V., Athletics Department, and offers runners a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere. Registration is online via Race Result; late entries are possible up to one hour before the start. Unfortunately, Nordic walkers cannot participate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Waldstadion, Rothensteiner Straße 9
Event starts at 16:00
Nordic walkers cannot participate
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race and incur a €5 late entry fee (except for children). Race numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Start and finish at the Waldstadion; Nordic walkers cannot participate. Registration via Race Result; late entries accepted up to one hour before the start.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional road race with a flat course along the Rhine. On 25 July 2026, events will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish line, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on 25 July 2026 and offers start times for various events. Results will be available shortly after the races finish. The event is particularly appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Die 10 Kilometer von Dürwiß
price_range: kostenlos, Anmeldung online oder vor Ort gegen Gebühr
description: The 10 km von Dürwiß is a traditional road race held annually on the first Saturday in August by SV Germania Dürwiß e.V. More than 500 runners from Germany and abroad take part, with winning times usually around 30 minutes. The flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop runs through the town center of Dürwiß and is completely closed to traffic on race day. What makes this cult race special are the many spectators and lively street parties along the course, with music and decorations creating a unique atmosphere. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and a wide selection of refreshments.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop through the town center of Dürwiß
Five laps for the 10 km main race, on streets completely closed to traffic
Lively street parties with music and decorations along the course
additional: In addition to the 10 km main race, there is a 4,000 m fun run, children’s and youth races from 200 m to 1,000 m, and a 10 km inline skating race with different lap formats depending on age group. The course is completely closed to road traffic on race day, and parking along the route is strictly prohibited. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and extensive refreshments. Course back to 10 km, inline skating and children’s races, street parties, after-run party, music, sponsor prizes

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz Mountains, bringing runners from three different villages to a shared finish in the UNESCO World Heritage City of Quedlinburg. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km and 69 km distances start in Stiege, Alexisbad and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mainly along forest and woodland paths through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.
course_highlights: Scenic trail race along the Selketal-Stieg
Forest and woodland paths with shaded sections
Moderate climbs, with 809 m of ascent and more than 1,000 m of descent on the long course
additional: Three starting points for different distances, all finishing in Quedlinburg. Electronic timing and medals for all finishers. Typical August weather: approx. 25 °C and mostly sunny. Trail-style race with multiple distances, including walking options; course not officially measured; medals for all finishers; online registration; route through quiet Harz forest paths.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbour. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km and a schoolchildren’s race. All start at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is closed to traffic. The event combines a sporting challenge with northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon route runs along the Warnow and through the Warnow Tunnel
The half marathon passes through IGA Park and runs along the Warnow to the city harbour
The Rostocker 7 km is a loop around the city harbour
additional: Start times: schoolchildren’s race 17:00, marathon 18:00, Rostocker 7 km 19:07. Finish closes at 23:30. Start and finish at the Haedgehalbinsel, Rostock city harbour. A technical shirt can be pre-ordered (€28, until 21.07.2026 only; collection only during event weekend). Race-pack collection on 31.07.2026 and 01.08.2026 on site. The event takes place in Rostock, with the start and finish on the Haedgehalbinsel at Rostock city harbour. It is known for its festive atmosphere, medals and professional timing. The routes run along the Warnow and through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event focused on camaraderie and endurance. Runners start on the hour and must complete a 6.706 km loop within one hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and supportive community, welcoming runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop on the tennis club grounds and adjoining field and farm tracks
Starts on the hour, with a maximum of one hour to complete each loop
Night running with headlamps between 21:00 and 6:00
additional: The race is an officially listed Backyard Ultra event and a potential qualifying race for the individual and team World Championships. Starts are announced acoustically with whistle signals and a bell. There is no time limit; the winner is the last runner remaining who completes one more loop than everyone else. Personal assistance on the course is not permitted, but participants may support one another. Trekking poles and artificial aids are prohibited. Participation is limited, so early registration is required; the event follows the Backyard Ultra format and regularly attracts over 400 applicants.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km courses for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating course through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones and enthusiastic fans create an exhilarating atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, is the perfect finale to this sporting night.
course_highlights: Course through City West and along Kurfürstendamm
Live bands and cheering points, especially at the adidas Cheering Zone at Adenauerplatz
Start and finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
additional: Start times: 5 km run at 19:00, 10 km run at 20:00. Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the race bib. The 5 km run has a turnaround point; the 10 km run follows a star-shaped route with several passes by the adidas Cheering Zone. Eligibility: born in 2016 or earlier (5 km) or 2014 or earlier (10 km). Personalized medal engraving can be booked. Extras such as an event shirt and bag storage can be added during registration. The course runs along Kurfürstendamm and through Old West Berlin; the start is at sunset. Includes a medal with a lighting effect; medal engraving is optional. Online registration is available.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in Rostock in August and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course runs through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rostock’s city harbor, with maritime flair
The course passes through the nearly 800 m-long Warnow Tunnel
Run through IGA Park with a picturesque sunset
additional: Start times: children’s race 17:00, marathon 18:00, Rostocker 7 approx. 19:07. Finish closes at 23:30. Marathon participants must pass the Warnow crossing checkpoint by 20:40. Pre-ordered technical shirts are available only during event weekend; no shipping by post. Race packet pickup at the event center on Haedge Peninsula, Rostock city harbor, on 31.07.2026 from 16:00–19:00 and on 01.08.2026 from 12:00–18:30. Event in August, dusk start, various race distances, finisher medals, certificates available immediately, optional event shirt, chip timing.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer event that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of running and a sense of community. Participants can look forward to refreshments, good music and a relaxed get-together at the finish. The run is organized on a voluntary basis by TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for competitive runners, recreational joggers and families.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque countryside around Lake Edersee
Evening start in pleasant temperatures
A shared running experience for all ages
additional: The Evening Run takes place annually in late summer, usually in early August. The event is organized on a voluntary basis. There are refreshments, music and a social get-together at the finish. Timing is done using special software that is used only once a year. The available pages do not provide explicit information about start times, price tiers or registration procedures. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. All finishers receive certificates, Bambini participants receive medals, and prizes are awarded to the top runners in the main categories. On-site registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start.

name: Mehrstetter Crosslauf
description: The Mehrstetten Cross-Country Run takes place on August 1, 2026, in Mehrstetten on the Swabian Alb. The event gives runners the opportunity to run in a well-maintained, natural setting. The municipality of Mehrstetten is known for its beautiful landscape and friendly atmosphere, making the cross-country run a special experience. The event is organized by the municipality of Mehrstetten and is a regular fixture in the local sports calendar.
course_highlights: Run through the natural landscape of the Swabian Alb
Well-maintained course in Mehrstetten
Event in a friendly and welcoming municipality
additional: Registration is via an online form on the municipal website. The municipality of Mehrstetten is the organizer and provides well-maintained facilities. The municipality’s contact form can be used to get in touch. Event is part of the SauHeld-Cup 2026. Runner information and a detailed course description are not available.

name: SWE Halbmarathon Ettlingen
description: The SWE Ettlingen Half Marathon is a challenging and varied 21.1 km cross-country race connecting several Ettlingen districts at different elevations.
