The route starts in the picturesque Horbachpark and leads through wooded areas with distant views of the Black Forest before descending into the Rhine Plain and finishing at Horbachsee. Refreshment stations are provided every 3 km, and local residents offer refreshments and create an encouraging atmosphere. The race takes place on 1 August 2026 and is organised by SSV Ettlingen 1847 e. V., Lauftreff Ettlingen department.
course_highlights: A challenging 21.1 km cross-country race with elevation changes
Woodland sections with distant views of the Black Forest and the Palatinate Mountains
Finish at the scenic Horbachsee in the former State Garden Show grounds
additional: The start and finish are in Horbachpark, by the pavilion, Middelkerker Straße, 76275 Ettlingen. There are two wave starts, approximately 3 minutes apart, to ease congestion during the first kilometres. The field is limited to a maximum of 800 starters. Late entries are possible at the Albgauhalle on race weekend. All pre-registered participants receive a gift with their race number. The team with the most finishers is rewarded with two bottles of champagne. Timing is via a transponder in the race number, with net-time results. Terrain: paved paths, gravel paths, asphalt; registration deadline: 27.07.2026; maximum 800 participants; start times: 16:00 walkers, 17:00 runners; children’s and youth races are new for 2026.

name: virtueller St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf
description: The virtual St. Anna Jedermannslauf in Amerdingen is a popular running event held annually in July. Participants can run the original courses of 10 km, 5.8 km jogging, 5.8 km walking, or 3.5 km for youth. The route leads from St. Anna Chapel through the forest south of Amerdingen, past historic sites such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones, as well as a small lake. Times are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to a leaderboard, making the event especially modern and accessible. The race is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start at St. Anna Chapel
Forest course south of Amerdingen, with historic sights such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones
Route marked with directional arrows, with app-supported timekeeping
additional: The race is virtual and takes place in July, allowing participants to complete their runs at a time that suits them. Multiple entries and a second free attempt are possible. Results are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to the leaderboard. There are different course distances for different age groups and ability levels. Virtual race, route towards the Celtic square enclosure, online registration, event period from 01.07. to 27.07.2025, start times between 06:00 and 20:00, participation from age 8, donations to preserve the chapel

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 EUR bei Anmeldungen bis zum 15. Juni

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 EUR bei Anmeldung vom 16. Juni bis 27. Juli

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic course through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start at the stadium in Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a nearly 10-kilometer loop through picturesque parkland and villages. Several aid stations along the route provide refreshments for participants. The finish is back at the stadium, where spectators can cheer on the runners and enjoy a lovely time together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive castle park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, where enthusiastic neighbors cheer runners on
additional: Personal refreshments can be dropped off before the start (8:00–8:45 a.m.). Water stations are located at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is available until 8:00 a.m. for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with timing chips for electronic timekeeping will be issued and collected after the race, but participants may keep them as souvenirs. The course goes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish at the stadium in Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Live results are available. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern car park.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
location: Koldingen, Pattensen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Running Pass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps for their running pass at each event. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to stay active while doing good.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Hanover Region
Part of a major running series with 43 events in 2026
Opportunity to collect stamps for the Sparkassen Running Pass
additional: Participation in the Sparkassen Running Pass includes a digital app for collecting stamps and a digital running diary. A classic fold-out running pass is also available. The series features a variety of running events across the Hanover Region, with attractive rewards for taking part. The event offers laps for children and young people, with start times between 16:00 and 17:30, and usually takes place in August in warm weather.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen takes place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races, with a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, and 5 km. Some courses are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The routes pass through varied landscapes, including forest trails and different surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on support from many local volunteers.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured by the DLV
11 km course with varied surfaces and forest trails
Aid stations every five kilometers on the half-marathon and marathon courses
additional: Late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €3 late-entry fee (except for children’s races). Handwritten commemorative certificates are available for an additional €3. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start and finish area. Participants travelling from farther away can stay overnight in the sports hall by prior arrangement. First-aid services are provided by the German Red Cross. Course marshals are provided by the Wellen Volunteer Fire Brigade and TSV Wellen volunteers. Walkers are welcome in the 5 km, 11 km, and half-marathon events, but are not ranked separately. Multiple race distances, family-friendly, community event in a small village community, supported by the local volunteer fire brigade.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival, which takes place every year on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, including Bambini, children’s, fun and main races. A special highlight is the Castle Hill Sprint in the main race, where the fastest runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive course, with the start and finish on Marktstraße near the town hall.
course_highlights: 7.6 km main race with a Castle Hill Sprint after 500 metres
Course starts and finishes on Marktstraße near the town hall
Water available in the finish area and showers at the outdoor pool
additional: Race packs are distributed on event day from approximately 7:45 a.m. until 9:00 a.m. Safety pins are not provided. Parking areas around Hilpoltstein are signposted; the town centre is closed to traffic. Showers are available at the outdoor pool. Admission to the municipal swimming pool is free on event day upon presentation of the race number. Special award for the team with the most participants. Certificates are available by email or download. Prizes are awarded only to those present in person. The event includes distances from 0.6 km to 7.6 km; online registration is available. The start is at Siegertstraße 2. Families and children are a particular focus.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
location: DJK SC Vorra, Frensdorf, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race organized annually by DJK SC Vorra. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, a quarter marathon over 10.55 km, and a fun run and Nordic walking, both newly added in 2025. The course runs through the rural surroundings of Abtsdorf and offers both competitive racing and a more leisurely run. The event also hosts the Upper Franconian Half Marathon Championships and attracts many participants from the region.
course_highlights: Half marathon and quarter marathon through the rural countryside
Course with two 5.5 km loops for the fun run and Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports grounds in Abtsdorf
additional: The event patron starts the races promptly at 9 a.m. Nordic walking attracts a large number of participants and emphasizes enjoyment and community. The course is available to download as a GPX file. Changing facilities are available at the Beck restaurant. The event includes elevation gain and team classifications, with the start and finish at the Vorra sports grounds. Results and photos are available.

name: Olewiger Charity-Run
description: The Olewiger Charity Run in Trier is a diverse running event that combines sporting commitment with social solidarity. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a main race, youth race, children’s race and an inclusive race. 100% of all entry fees are donated to Demenzzentrum e.V. for the Trier region, underscoring the event’s charitable spirit. The races take place on August 2, 2026, offering a great opportunity to get active together for a good cause.
course_highlights: Volksbank Trier Eifel 5,000-meter main race
Optik Ruschel 1,000-meter youth race
dm-Markt 1,000-meter inclusive race
additional: The races have staggered start times: Bambini race at 10:25, inclusive race at 10:50, children’s race at 11:45 and main race at 12:15. The event is supported by regional sponsors who emphasize community spirit and the development of the Trier region. Several race categories are available, including a fun run, youth race, children’s race, inclusive race and elite race; registration opens in January 2026; the start is at the Volksfreund Torbogen and Volksbank Trier Eifel Torbogen; participants receive medals, goodie bags and drinks; parking and shuttle information is available.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The BWM Sommerlochlauf takes place on August 4, 2026, in Steinheim an der Murr. It is a 10 km race especially suited to runners who love a fast pace. The flat, fast course through Steinheim offers ideal conditions for achieving personal bests. Its friendly organization and lively atmosphere make it a popular weekday event where running enthusiasts can test their fitness together.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Route through Steinheim an der Murr in the Bottwartal
Ideal terrain for ambitious athletes and recreational runners
additional: The race takes place during the cooler evening hours, offering pleasant running conditions during the holiday season. The event is organized by the Bottwartal-Marathon team, which ensures a first-class race experience. 10 km race, evening event, ideal for personal bests, friendly organization, in Steinheim an der Murr

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: 6. Bärenkopplauf
description: The Bärenkopplauf is a challenging mountain and trail run in the Rhine-Westerwald Nature Park. It follows the premium hiking route “WällerTour Bärenkopp” over approximately 11 km, with around 360 m of ascent and 260 m of descent. The run takes place on the first Friday in August from 18:00, with staggered wave starts. The course is divided into two halves: the first is technically challenging, with trails and steep climbs; the second is predominantly downhill and scenic. A mountain prize is awarded to the fastest man and woman at the Bärenkopp cross. The event is organised by VfL Waldbreitbach and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments and transponder timing.
course_highlights: 11 km course with +360/-260 m of elevation on the WällerTour Bärenkopp
The first half is a challenging trail and mountain run, with steep climbs and technical sections
The second half is a scenic run on a predominantly downhill course
additional: Staggered wave starts take place between 18:00 and 18:30, with 20 participants per wave. After registration closes, race numbers are assigned based on the submitted 10 km time: the fastest runners start first, and late registrants start in the final wave. There are two water stations at 3.3 km and 7 km. The course is permanently marked and includes steep, sometimes narrow trails with steps and wooden bridges; extra care is advised in wet conditions. Race-number collection and bag drop-off are at the schoolyard of the Realschule plus. Timing uses disposable transponders attached to race numbers. Finish refreshments include water, tea and energy drinks. Parking is available near the start and finish; if you park near the finish, you can jog approximately 1 km to the start as a warm-up. Online registration is open until 3 August 2026; late registration is available until 6 August 2026. No showers are available. The event also includes the Bärchenlauf and other activities.

name: Heimat- und Schützenfestlauf
description: The Zerbst Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival Run takes place in the palace gardens of Zerbst/Anhalt and offers flat, varied routes on a 1.5 km loop combining paths and roads, with the start and finish in front of the town hall. The event is open to children, teenagers and adults, with distances ranging from 1.5 km to 9 km. Its friendly, family atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups and teams make it a popular event as part of the Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival.
course_highlights: Flat 1.5 km loop in the Zerbst palace gardens
Start and finish in front of the town hall
Sections on paths and roads
additional: Parking at Gartenstraße 21 (for navigation systems, enter Gartenstraße 26). Changing and shower facilities are available at the gym of the “An der Stadtmauer” primary school (approx. 500 m from the town hall). Certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Trophy for the running group with the most participants (club, company or school; excluding the event organizers). No refunds for non-participation. Participants must be fit to compete. By registering, participants consent to the storage and publication of competition-related data and images in accordance with the EU GDPR. Race distances: 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km and 9 km; online registration; run in the palace gardens; start times and further details on the official website.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the mountain run in Höxter, featuring a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 metres. The course starts on the sports field and runs over grass, paved paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths to the finish in the forest. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km with 50 m of elevation gain on a narrow gravel/forest path
Main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady 170 m climb over paved paths and meadow trails
Start and finish on the sports field, with varied surfaces
additional: After the main race, runners return to the sports field by jogging gently or by car. The children’s mountain run starts on the sports field, with approx. 150 m of flat grass followed by paved and forest paths. The event is organised by TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. It takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25°C and occasional rain. Registration is via the official website; details are available in a PDF file.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
location: Ev.-luth. Friedhof St. Nicolai, Gifhorn, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometre courses. After the run, participants can enjoy a relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines physical activity with a laid-back atmosphere in a historic setting.
course_highlights: 4- and 8-kilometre routes around the cemetery grounds
A relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees
Direct connection to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival
additional: The run supports the Friedhofsmobil, a free transport service for seniors. After the run, participants can go straight to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival. Courses, registration, cemetery tours, refreshments, 2026 dates: 7 and 8 August.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 17 Euro pro Person bei online Anmeldung

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: Güttersbacher Volkslauf 2026
description: The Güttersbach Volkslauf will take place for the 29th time on August 8, 2026, and is an established event on the running calendars of Hesse and the Odenwald. The event is known for excellent organization, a great atmosphere and a smooth-running day. The courses wind through the beautiful countryside around Mossautal and offer a challenge for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are in the village center at the community hall, where food and drink are also available for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the village center at the community hall
Challenging courses set in the beautiful Odenwald countryside
Aid stations along the course and free use of the outdoor swimming pool for participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the start of the race. The first 200 pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt, as do the first 80 registered schoolchildren. The first-place finisher in each age group (except walking) receives a trophy, a non-cash prize and a certificate. Every finisher receives an exclusive finisher medal. Participants can use the Güttersbach outdoor swimming pool free of charge. Food and drink will be provided for runners and spectators. Participants receive medals, and T-shirts are available for early registrants. Parking is limited and road closures may be in effect. Families receive free admission to the outdoor swimming pool after the race.

name: Monschau-Marathon warm-up
description: The Monschau Marathon is a scenic race through the picturesque Eifel region, attracting runners from all over the world. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows and woodland, as well as challenging climbs that offer a sporting challenge. Its warm, welcoming atmosphere is shaped by dedicated volunteers and an international field of runners. Alongside the classic marathon, ultra distances and relay events are also offered, making this a special running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a gentle downhill section and an ideal warm-up loop
Monschau’s historic old town and natural scenery along the Rur
The legendary climb through the Holderbach Valley, gaining 160 metres
additional: Late entries are possible online and in person through and including 09.08.2026; a late-entry fee applies. There are 12 refreshment stations along the course. Medical services, doctors, a massage team and sports physiotherapists will be on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 € per day/person; children free). Showers and changing facilities are in the sports hall at Konzen Primary School. Pacemakers for various target times are available. A finisher’s medal is included; a technical shirt can be booked for an additional fee when registering online by 31 July. Several race distances are offered, including the marathon, ultra, relay and walking events. Participant services include refreshments, medals, finisher shirts, massage services and an after-run party. Registration is subject to deadlines, and personalised bibs are available.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the “Summer in the City” festival in downtown Oettingen. The event offers races for children, teenagers and adults, with timing for the main race, the youth races and the walking event. The routes lead through the historic city centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running, Triathlon and Athletics Department, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city centre of Oettingen
Children’s race: approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event: approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the event day for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The route is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones; start and finish at the market square; open to all physically fit participants; city championship for Oettingen residents.

name: Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden
location: Innenstadt von Kirchheimbolanden, Kirchheimbolanden, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden is a traditional race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in a popular local sporting event in a beautiful urban setting. The route runs through the town centre and offers varied urban scenery. The event is organised by LLG Wonnegau, known for its dedicated running community.
course_highlights: Race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden
Varied urban running route
Traditional local sporting event
additional: Registration for the LLG Summer Runs 2026 is open. LLG Wonnegau also offers an end-of-year celebration for club members and non-members. The LLG Wonnegau office is located in Monsheim. Routes in the town-centre area; start and finish at the car park; free parking; showers and changing facilities in the school gym.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: 1. Hannover Backyard Ultra
description: The 1st Hannover Backyard Ultra takes place on August 8, 2026, in the Georgengarten in Hanover. In this unique race format, runners complete a 6.706 km lap every hour until only one person remains. The event offers a special challenge for endurance runners and promotes community and sporting ambition in the Hanover region.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km lap every hour
Start and finish in the Georgengarten, Hanover-Herrenhausen
Run until only one person remains
additional: The race takes place in the Georgengarten in Hanover. Registration is via an external platform, and participation is limited to 70 runners. The event emphasizes community and experience in ultrarunning.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
location: Krebecker Sportplatz, Krebeck, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene €8,00, Schüler bis 16 Jahre €3,00, Kinder bis 6 Jahre kostenlos
description: The Volkslauf around the Geographic Center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for all ages and for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking distances with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging, on paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings as well as medical support on site.
course_highlights: Changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging
Paved or asphalt running and walking routes
Aid stations on the 5.7 km and 10.4 km routes
additional: Late entries and changes to registrations are possible until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start, for a €2.00 processing fee. Showers, toilets, and changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Participation is at your own risk. Photos and video footage will be taken on event day and may be published. Routes on paved or asphalt paths, fruit and drinks provided, showers, toilets, medical support, online registration available, start and finish at the Krebeck sports field

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp by Lake Aue. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Lake Aue and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized event and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Aue
Paved and partly asphalted paths
No significant elevation changes
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreis Series, which comprises nine races in the region. The series awards ceremony takes place in Espelkamp on 14.11.2026. The race offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical services on site. Registration is by email, and the course follows asphalt and forest paths. The event is also part of a regional running series.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional running event held every year in Karben at Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied courses through the town and surrounding area. An accompanying program provides entertainment and a chance to socialize. The run is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the town of Karben
Finish at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running courses for different age groups
additional: An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is via the separate registration page. The event is organized by Karbener Sportverein. Various race disciplines; online registration is open until approximately 60 minutes before the start; late registration is available for a fee.

name: Monschau Marathon
description: The Monschau Marathon takes place from August 7 to 9, 2026, in the picturesque Eifel landscape and offers runners a challenging course with varied terrain. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes ultra distances (K56 and K70), a Genuss-Marathon, and relay races. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows, and forests, with impressive views, all in a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. The Monschau Marathon is an international running event offering great variety and a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers, and sponsors.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a slight downhill and a fast opening loop
Monschau’s historic old town and nature along the Rur
The legendary Holderbachtal climb, gaining 160 meters in elevation
additional: 12 aid stations along the marathon course. Relay exchange points in Widdau and Kalterherberg. Medical services, doctors, a massage team, and sports physiotherapists on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 euros per day/person; children free). Showers and changing rooms are available in the Konzen primary school gym. Late registrations are possible online and on site until 09.08.2026, with a late registration fee. Pacemakers for various target times. Finisher medal included; technical shirt available for an additional fee when registering online by July 31. Guided bike tour on Saturday with no entry fee. Multiple race distances, including the marathon, ultras (K56, K70), relay, and walking; event in the Eifel with aid stations, start and exchange zones; focus on community and experiencing nature.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a great opportunity to get active and experience a sense of community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is held with great dedication. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: A traditional race in Roth with regional significance
An outdoor event with a varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10 km Championships (when held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports activities and classes. The event takes place on a flat, paved course, with various race categories for all ages and ability levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Stefan-Andres-Freundschaftslauf
organizer: Lauftreff Schweich e.V. / LLG Wustweiler e.V.
description: The Stefan-Andres Friendship Run is a challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich on the Moselle, held without a competitive element. The focus is on the joy of running and sharing the experience. Three distances are offered—12, 18 and 26 kilometres—each with several metres of elevation gain and well-marked routes. After the run, participants can get together over soft drinks at the Haus des Sports, which also has changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich
Three distances: 12 km (approx. 340 m elevation gain), 18 km (approx. 490 m), 26 km (approx. 720 m)
Refreshment stations on all routes, with traditional schnapps at the final station
additional: This is a non-competitive friendship run with no entry fees, held as a charity run in support of the “Region der Lebensretter” emergency responder app project. The start and finish are in Schweich: the start is at Niedeprümer Hof, and the finish is at the Haus des Sports, which has changing rooms and showers. At Schweicher Annaberg, at “Lagenliebe”, each participant is offered a glass of wine. After the run, participants can relax together over soft drinks. The run is usually held in August, when the weather is typically sunny and around 25°C. Refreshment stations offer wine and schnapps tastings, and after the run everyone celebrates together at the Haus des Sports. The event supports the “Region der Lebensretter” app, which alerts nearby first responders.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder-based timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Dieksee
Timing with transponder and race number
Start and finish at the Dieksee promenade
additional: Timing is provided using a race number with an integrated transponder. The race number must be worn clearly visible at the front. Results and certificates are available online and can be downloaded after the race. Terrain along Lake Dieksee, on-site registration available, start and finish area at the Dieksee promenade, refreshments in the finish area

name: Münzwaldlauf (36. Volkslauf)
description: The Münzwaldlauf is a traditional fun run in Lichtenau, Baden-Württemberg, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event offers various distances, from 0.25 km for Bambini runners to the 10 km main race. The routes mainly follow forest and meadow paths and are distinguished by their natural setting, making the run especially appealing to families and nature lovers. Alongside the short children’s races, there are also more challenging sections, such as the 5.2 km trail run. The event is an established local running event with a long history.
course_highlights: Routes along forest and meadow paths
A natural setting, not a typical city-street race
A range of distances from 0.25 km to 10 km
additional: Typical August weather, with an average temperature of 25 °C and mostly sunny days. The event takes place in Lichtenau, with routes around Lichtenau-Ulm. Several distances are available, including 0.25 km, 0.5 km, 5.2 km, 7 km and 10 km. The event takes place on 9 August 2026, with various distances for all age groups. The natural terrain is suitable for both recreational runners and trail enthusiasts.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
location: Familienbrauerei Jacob, Bodenwöhr, Schwandorf, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 2026 Upper Palatinate Cross-Country Championship takes place on 9 August 2026 at Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr. The event is hosted by the Upper Palatinate district and organized by TV Burglengenfeld. The cross-country race offers runners an attractive course in a natural setting and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championship is open to various age groups, from youth to masters, and promises exciting races in the Upper Palatinate region.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a natural setting
Venue: Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr
Part of the Hammerseelauf and featuring a regional championship
additional: Registration closes on 2 August 2026; categories for youth, seniors and masters; venue: Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr.

name: v-office-Europalauf
location: Neustadt in Holstein, Ostholstein, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 09 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic Sea resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon route. The course offers magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route connects Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin
Magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht
The route returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach
additional: The start and finish for all races are at Seebrückenvorplatz, Neustadt-Pelzerhaken. Race pack collection begins at 7:00 at Kurzentrum Soziales Genesungswerk (SGW), Dünenweg 1-3, opposite the Tourist Information office. The schedule includes several start times for different distances and disciplines (half marathon, 10 km Windberglauf, 5 km Promenadenlauf, 5 km Nordic walking, 2.5 km Leuchtturmlauf, 900 m Bambini race). Award ceremonies begin at 10:30. The event ends at 13:00. The event features various race distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races. The race takes place on 9 August 2026 and offers a beautiful setting and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Nettetal-Lauf
distance_verbose: 50 Meilen, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter
description: The Nettetal Run is a traditional road race held annually in mid-August in Ochtendung, Germany. The 2026 event offers a varied selection of distances from 3 km to 10 km, with longer distances also possible in other years. The course is officially measured, allowing results to be recognized in the German rankings. The race is supported by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Officially measured course
Road race in Ochtendung, Germany
A range of distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Typical August weather: around 25 °C during the day and 14 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The start is in Ochtendung. The race is part of the German athletics calendar, with an official measured course suitable for competitions.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
price_range: early bird price (specific amount not provided)
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated course with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km course follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km course also runs along the Elbe and finishes via the Albert Bridge. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team ranking for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 11.5 km course with views of the romantically illuminated Elbe Castles and the Blue Wonder
6.2 km course along the Elbe, returning via the Albert Bridge
Course illuminated by torches and glow sticks, with views of Dresden’s nighttime skyline
additional: Start times: 18:30 Bambini Run (400 m), 19:00 Children’s Run (1.8 km), 20:00 11.5 km Run, 22:15 6.2 km Run. Pacemakers for target times of 50, 60 and 70 minutes on the 11.5 km course. Team ranking with prize money for the clubs/organizations with the most participants. Cutoff times: 21:40 (11.5 km) and 23:15 (6.2 km). Night run, registration for 2026 open, event in Dresden, various race distances available

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Spelle Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organised by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an appealing course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with a family-friendly feel.
course_highlights: Course through the scenic surroundings of Wählehof
Well-marked routes over various distances
Varied paths combining paved and natural-surface sections
additional: The event takes place in the evening, making it a special summer night run. Results are available online, along with detailed directions. Course maps are available as PDFs, including routes for 5 km, 10 km and walking. The event is part of the EL CUP series, offers numerous categories for all age groups, and is known for its flat course and friendly atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy the summer evening with music and refreshments.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Brohlbachtal-Lauf mit Halbmarathon und Walking
description: The 15th Brohlbachtal Run in Gamlen offers runners and walkers a varied sporting event on a flat course. The event includes races over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.0975 km), as well as walking and Nordic walking distances. Children’s and youth races are also offered. The finish is the same for all events; the exact finish address is shown with RUNME Premium.
course_highlights: Flat course
Events for running, walking and Nordic walking
Distances from 5 km to the half marathon
additional: The finish is the same for all events. Children’s and youth races are also part of the event. The exact finish address is only visible with RUNME Premium. The event takes place at the Gamlen community hall and is known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse running events for all age groups.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event gives runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in 5 km and 10 km races. It takes place at Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a team competition in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all abilities.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
location: Lauterbacher Straße, Gedern, Wetteraukreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The 24th Gedern City Run on August 15, 2026, offers runners of all ages a special running experience through Gedern’s historic old town. With distances of 500 m, 1,500 m, 5 km and 10 km, there is an option for children, teenagers, beginners and ambitious runners alike. The longer distances follow a varied loop course of four 2.5-kilometre laps, combining sporting challenge with history. The route follows historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a notable climb to Schlossberg and a section through the castle gardens. The start and finish are on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available at Gedern gymnasium.
course_highlights: Gedern’s historic old town
Four 2.5 km laps on a varied loop course
Sections along the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a climb to Schlossberg
additional: Start and finish on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four 2.5 km laps. The route includes a paved castle courtyard and the castle gardens. The event is organized by the Top-Time timing team. Distances for children, teenagers and adults; start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße; changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach People’s Run takes place on 15 August 2026 in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV, and the event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the race information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – Der Mauerweglauf is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around West Berlin. The approximately 161-kilometre course runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of Germany’s division and is held annually, with the direction changing from year to year.
course_highlights: The course follows the former East German border strip around West Berlin
The direction changes annually; in 2026, the race runs counterclockwise
26 aid stations spaced 5 to 9 kilometres apart, including 3 changeover points with drop bag facilities
additional: Start and finish at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark; there is no parking on site, so using public transport is recommended. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket. Time limit: 30 hours for individual runners and 27 hours for 2-person relay teams. Shuttle buses to the start run on the morning of race day. Three changeover points offer drop bag facilities. There are 26 aid stations, with mostly vegan refreshments. Timing uses transponders from race result germany. Soup is served at the finish, and all finishers are invited to the awards ceremony. The race starts at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg at 6:00 a.m. and finishes the following day at 12:00 p.m. The race is known for its historical significance, varied course and support from numerous aid stations. It is a demanding ultramarathon that challenges participants’ physical and mental strength.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandter Wald is organised by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course consists of a 6.7 km loop, which runs mainly on forest trails and is run in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop, mainly on forest trails
The direction changes: counterclockwise at first, clockwise at night, then counterclockwise again during the day
Start and finish area at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg
additional: The first 8 laps are run counterclockwise; from 18:00 (night course), clockwise; and from 6:00 (day course), counterclockwise again. There are 100 starting places in total. Registration is via RaceResult. Maximum 100 participants; registration via RaceResult; accommodation at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg; race format: hourly laps until only one runner remains.

name: Charity Mega Run
description: The Charity Mega Run in Bingen am Rhein is a unique running event with a mission: to get people moving—for themselves, for others and for a good cause. The event offers four distances from 5 km to 52 km along Germany’s most beautiful running route, with magnificent views of the Rhine and vineyards. In addition to the race, there is a pasta party on the eve of the event and a varied program for runners and spectators. The event takes place on 15 August 2026 at the Rhine-Nahe Corner in Bingen and combines sporting ambition with social commitment.
course_highlights: Running route with views of the Rhine and vineyards
Four distances: 5 km, 10 km, 26 km and 52 km
Six to nine refreshment stations, depending on the distance
additional: Race bib collection and late registration are available from 7:30 a.m. on race day or on 14 August at the pasta party. There are six to nine refreshment stations, depending on the distance. Parking nearby is free during the school holidays. The event features an accompanying program and prizes for the top three finishers, as well as trophies for the winners (women and men) of each distance. All participants receive a race bag with goodies. The event includes refreshment stations, a program with music and children’s activities, and a pasta party on 14 August. Registration is available online, with payment options on site including PayPal and card payment. Prizes are awarded to the best runners, and there are sponsors.

name: Altenlotheimer Dorflauf
description: The Altenlotheim Village Run is a great opportunity to get active together. With courses for children and longer distances, there is something for the whole family. The event takes place on 15 August 2026 in Altenlotheim and invites runners of all ages to experience the local running community.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 1 km to 21 km
Family-friendly running event with courses for children
Starts in Altenlotheim amid beautiful surroundings
additional: The weather in August is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C and 60 mm of precipitation. The event welcomes all age groups and offers a range of distances. In addition to the main races, there are children’s and Bambini races, relay races, and Nordic walking. The event is well organized and offers a great opportunity for community and exercise.

name: Hüttenfelder Volksbankkerwelauf
description: The Hüttenfelder Volksbank Kerwe Run is a long-standing running event with a history spanning more than 30 years. It offers runners of all abilities an appealing opportunity to test their endurance and have fun together. There are three races: a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km race, and a 2 km children’s race. The course runs mostly through shady woodland and provides a very flat, pleasant running environment, with historic ammunition bunkers as a special highlight. The start and finish are at the Hüttenfeld allotment gardens, and the award ceremony takes place after the races at the Kerweplatz by the Bürgerhaus.
course_highlights: A very flat course, mostly through woodland
Start and finish at the Hüttenfeld allotment gardens
Historic decommissioned ammunition bunkers along the course
additional: Water and isotonic drink stations in the woodland and at the start/finish. On-site late registration is not possible. Award ceremony at 18:30 at the Kerweplatz by the Bürgerhaus. The 2 km children’s race follows paved farm tracks and the shady edge of the forest. The course passes through woodland and historic bunker complexes, with water and drink stations. Open to participants aged 7 and over. On-site registration from 13:00; start times vary by age group.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
price_range: Waldlauf (20 km und 20 km Plus): 20€, 7,8 km Lauf: 5€
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The route follows paved forest paths through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The start is in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths in the Sauerland
A challenging and scenic route
Variable ultramarathon distance of up to 50 km over multiple laps
additional: The time limit for all events is 6 hours. The start is in Waldemei, Menden, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke (new). Parking areas are clearly marked; please do not park in residential areas or on Gisbert-Kranz Straße. The course consists of 3 laps for 20 km, 4 or more laps (up to a maximum of 8) for the 20 km Plus and ultramarathon, and a 7.8 km fun run. Participants can register online; late registration is available in cash on the event day. The route follows paved forest paths, starting in Waldemei and finishing at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. This is the 42nd edition of the event.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
location: Festgelände Am Pflegerspitz, Kelheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kelheim Volksfest Run is a traditional running event held every August at the festival grounds at Am Pflegerspitz in Kelheim. It offers different distances for various age groups, including 2 km for students, 5 km for young people, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular fixture in the City of Kelheim’s calendar and is organised by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race packets are available from 12:00 on the day of the event in the beer tent, and the awards ceremony takes place there after the races.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the festival grounds at Am Pflegerspitz
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km depending on age group
Part of the Kelheim District Running Cup
additional: Race packet distribution in the beer tent from 12:00 until 30 minutes before the start. Awards ceremony at approximately 16:30 in the Volksfest beer tent. Timing is provided by Race Result. Online registration is available until 14.08.2026; after that, late registration is only possible on the day of the event. Participation as part of the 2026 District Running Cup; results and registration are available online.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The Städtedreieckslauf is a traditional race through the three towns of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz and Maxhütte-Haidhof. The 16th edition of this event takes place on 15 August 2026, bringing together numerous runners across five competition categories for a good cause. The course is flat and runs along farm tracks and public roads; traffic regulations must be observed. The race is a great opportunity to experience the region through sport and cross the finish line together.
course_highlights: Flat running routes
Farm tracks and public roads
Route through three towns: Burglengenfeld, Teublitz and Maxhütte-Haidhof
additional: The course is flat and runs along farm tracks and public roads. Traffic regulations must be observed. Charity event; registration opens on 1 June; donations go to non-profit clubs; celebrate together after the race at the Bürgerfest.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Plauen–Hof City Run is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The route connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and the cross-border partnership between the cities. Every year, numerous participants take part in ideal running weather and enjoy the scenic route.
course_highlights: A traditional race route in the Saxon-Bavarian border region
Connects Plauen and Hof
A popular route for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Various distances, Nordic walking available, scenic route, shared finish in Hof

name: WoKiMen
location: Parc de Tarbes, Altenkirchen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly day of running in Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a range of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay with three 1 km legs. Alongside the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxed Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Family-friendly event with races for children and adults
A range of race distances from 0.5 km to a half marathon (21 km)
Additional program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course in the park
additional: The 5 km course is especially open to walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners with dogs. The TeamChallenge consists of three 1 km relay legs. The event takes place in Parc de Tarbes and offers a family atmosphere, ending with a Chill & Grill. It is open to everyone, with activities for children and adults, team relays, dog runs, and a varied supporting program. It is aimed at families, recreational runners, and community groups.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: HuBuT - 8. Hunsbuckel-Trail
description: The HuBuT - Hunsbuckel Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the Hunsrück with three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The routes pass through varied low mountain landscapes featuring green meadows, deep forests, singletracks, ravines and award-winning hiking trails. A special highlight is crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge, Germany’s most beautiful and highest suspension bridge. The start and finish are in the idyllic village of Laubach, offering participants an unforgettable experience in nature.
course_highlights: Varied low mountain landscape, with elevation profiles ranging from river valleys to ridges
Crossing the 360 m long and 100 m high Geierlay suspension bridge
Running on rugged terrain, singletracks and award-winning hiking trails, and through deep ravines
additional: The start and finish are in Laubach. There are three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The UltraTrail route crosses the Geierlay suspension bridge. The trail features singletracks, forest trails, ravines and historic sights such as the ruins of Balduinseck Castle. There is a Winter Edition with a 6-hour run in February. This trail-running event in Laubach in the Hunsrück offers several distances, including the UltraTrail, HalfTrail and ShortTrail, as well as the Winter Edition 6-hour run; typical weather in August is warm.

name: Ortskernlauf
description: The Roßdorf Town Center Festival is a long-standing tradition, held annually on the third weekend in August, and celebrates its 42nd anniversary in 2026. It brings together Roßdorf’s diverse community and offers a varied program featuring live acts on three stages, a children’s and family area, and numerous clubs and local organizations. The town center is the social hub where visitors from near and far come together to celebrate. The Town Center Run on Sunday is a sporting highlight, starting and finishing in the town center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the town center of Roßdorf
Warm-up from 11:00 a.m.; the Town Center Run starts from 12:00 p.m. on Sunday
A diverse community and festive atmosphere in the town center
additional: The Town Center Run takes place on Sunday, with a warm-up from 11:00 a.m. and the start from 12:00 p.m. at the Town Center Run start/finish area. The children’s program and children’s band run from 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. The festival features live acts on three stages, a kids’ and family area, and numerous local clubs. Sporting run; registration opens in summer 2026 on the website of Skifreunde Roßdorf.

name: SV02 Kerwelauf - Der SV02 lässts LAUFen
description: The 8th SV02 Kerwelauf in Schönau is a lively running event taking place on August 16, 2026. It offers two distances: a 400-meter run and a 10-kilometer run, for runners looking for a short but sporty challenge. The race takes place in typical August weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Schönau and promises an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 400 m and 10 km
Location: Schönau
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event features a measured course approved by the DLV, live timing, children's races, and a festive atmosphere with refreshments in the festival tent.

name: Waldlauf / 37. Volkslauf
description: The 47th Waldlauf / 37th Volkslauf is a Sunday morning running event in Oberzent-Hetzbach in the Odenwald. The adult program includes hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Start times are staggered, with the 10 km race starting shortly before the 5 km race, giving the event the character of several local races run under a shared organization. There is also a 750 m race for children and teenagers, and all races finish at the same finish line.
course_highlights: Hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Shared finish line for all distances
Separate races for children and teenagers
additional: Start times are staggered, with the 10 km race starting shortly before the 5 km race. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Typical August weather: approximately 25 °C, mostly sunny, with average precipitation of 60 mm. Hilly terrain, several race distances, including walking and Nordic walking options; weather-dependent conditions in August, with temperatures around 25 °C and approximately 60 mm of precipitation.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start- incl. Chip­ - Gebühren 6 Km Lauf: 9€

description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place on 23 August 2026 in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organised by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a single-use chip, trophies and non-cash prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing is provided using a single-use chip from GO timing. Race packs can be collected at the sports hall on 22.08.2026 from 12:00 to 15:30 and on race day from 07:00. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with non-cash and cash prizes for the winners. All finishers in the main distances receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
location: Stadion im Jugendzentrum Ronneburg, Ronneburg, Hessen, Germany
description: The Ronneburg Hourly Pair Relay, organised by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V., is a unique running competition in which teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400 m synthetic track at the stadium at the Ronneburg Youth Centre. The event takes place on 16 August 2026 and offers three competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes. The laps completed are added together and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m synthetic track at the stadium at the Ronneburg Youth Centre
Runners switch after each lap
Competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes
additional: Late registration is possible on site until one hour before the start of the competition. Participants can register individually or as a pair; individual registrants will be matched into pairs by the organiser. Payment is by direct debit upon registration, or in cash at the race-number distribution desk for late registration. The event is expected to end at 15:00. Course lengths of 900 m and 3.6 km, medals, certificates, supporting programme and on-site refreshments.

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: Run’n Roll for Help is a long-standing city race in Giessen that has delighted runners for more than 28 years. Every year, the city-centre streets become a sporting highlight where, alongside the competition, supporting a good cause is also a priority. With more than 1,200 participants in 2025 and over €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is an important charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly invites everyone who loves running to join in August 2026.
course_highlights: Course through Giessen city centre
Traditional city race with a large number of participants
Charity race in support of Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe
additional: Registration for the race opens soon. More than 1,200 runners took part in 2025. The event raises donations for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe. Photos and videos from the event are available in the photo gallery on the website. Official hashtags for social media are #MiteinanderMehrBewegen and #RunandRollforHelp. Charity race, registration opening soon, donations for social causes, support for HIV prevention and youth work

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through the Wohldenberger Forest. For more than two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true cross-country running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails with changing surfaces
Hilly sections in the Wohldenberger Forest
A range of routes for all ability levels, from 0 km to 21.1 km
additional: Six starts for everyone: Shorty Run (free, 11:30), Schoolchildren’s Run (1.5 km, 11:15), 4 km walking (09:10), 4 km run (09:00), 10 km run (09:10), half marathon (08:50). Registration is available for individuals or groups. The event takes place at the Waldsportanlage of SV Rot-Weiss Wohldenberg in Holle. Four routes; on-site registration available; forest cross-country run on trails with changing surfaces.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
price_range: Startgebühren der Kinderstaffeln werden vom Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. übernommen, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Wolfsburg Relay, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, where teams from schools, clubs, and businesses can experience sporting team spirit together. The route passes through the green Stadtforst, with the start and finish at the VW-Bad, where music will also create a lively atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially appealing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the VW-Bad
Route through Wolfsburg’s green Stadtforst
Music by DJ Tomoritzland in the start/finish area
additional: Children’s relay teams consist of 5 participants, including at least one female and one male participant. The entry fees for children’s relay teams are covered by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. Race bibs will be collected after the race and reused for future events. Race packets can be collected on 14.08.2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 at the VfL office, or on event day from 8:00. Dogs are not allowed at the VW-Bad. Medical services will be on site. Participants may use the swimming pools at the VW-Bad free of charge. Relay race, teams from different groups, course maps, impressions, registration via my.race|result

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a popular running event set in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany. The course passes through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic old towns, with an enthusiastic atmosphere along the route. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, there’s a personal highlight here for everyone. The dedicated organizing team puts a great deal of heart and precision into creating an unforgettable running experience.
course_highlights: Run through picturesque vineyards and historic old towns
Flat finish on Ludwigsburger Straße in Steinheim
A variety of distances from 5 km to an ultramarathon
additional: Monthly training runs with various pace groups and guides to help you prepare. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays: a 10 km long run, free of charge and with no registration required. The Year-End Run is a traditional event featuring a 10 km run followed by punch and mulled wine. The 5 km run starts at Rosenplatz in Großbottwar, follows a historic route, and has a flat finish. Time limit for the 5 km run: 2 hours. No specific details are available about the terrain, registration, or other notes.

name: Abendstraßenlauf
location: Dorfzentrum, Herxheim, Südliche Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
