description: The Evening Road Race in Herxheim is a long-running event held annually since 1987. In 2026, it will take place with a new concept and a new course in the village center, starting and finishing at the festival grounds behind the festival hall. Races are offered for the whole family, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, beginner, and 10 km main races. The main race consists of two laps, and the beginner race has been extended to 5 km. The event combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly supporting program.
course_highlights: New two-lap 10 km course in the village center
Beginner race extended to 5 km
Start and finish at the festival grounds behind the festival hall
additional: Start times: Bambini races from 18:00, schoolchildren’s races from 18:20, and the beginner and 10 km main races from 19:00. Bambini races are not timed; all finishers receive medals. Age-group rankings include certificates and gifts. The three fastest men and women overall in the 10 km race receive gift vouchers. Organizer: TV Herxheim 1892 e.V., Athletics Department. New course, family and children’s races, online registration, event in the village center

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren, taking place on 21 August 2026. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, schoolchildren’s and corporate races, on paved routes with minimal elevation changes through the scenic Aftetal valley. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift-Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal valley
Fully paved course with minimal elevation changes
800 m schoolchildren’s and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren’s challenge trophy for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the largest team (corporate runners only). Certificates can be printed via the “race result” software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be provided. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with minimal elevation changes. The registration deadline is the day of the event. Registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: Schleswiger Treppenlauf
description: The Schleswig Stair Run takes place for the 13th time in 2026 and features a new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Polierteich. Participants complete 10 laps with a total of approximately 940 steps, mostly on firm sand. The event offers both individual and duo competitions, with ample parking available at Stadtfeld. It is a sporting challenge in Schleswig, organised by the Spiridon Schleswig running club.
course_highlights: 10 laps with approximately 940 steps
Mostly firm sand underfoot
Start and finish at the Polierteich
additional: Start and finish at the Polierteich; ample parking at Stadtfeld; event runs from 18:30 to 21:00; individual and duo competitions available; mostly firm sand underfoot. Registration is open; parking at Stadtfeld; running time from 18:30 to 21:00.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
location: Kaiserstadt Tangermünde, Elbufer, Bleichenberg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Tangermünde Lichterlauf is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. On August 21, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in several race distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise and team spirit front and center.
course_highlights: Run along Tangermünde’s Elbe promenade below the castle
Loop course of approximately 1 km, with 5 or 10 laps for the main races
Children’s run of approximately 500 m; parents may accompany children
additional: Timing is provided using a chip that must be returned after the race. Medical support is available along the course. All participants receive a certificate, which is available online. The team relay is awarded a trophy. Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest. Refreshments are provided before, during and after the race. The event takes place at Bleichenberg on the banks of the Elbe and includes various distances, children’s and youth races, and an after-run party. It is part of the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fristgerechte Anmeldung bis zwei Tage vor dem Lauf (Mittwoch)

description: The 19th Barßel Harbour Festival Run takes place on 21 August 2026 near Barßel Harbour. The event offers races for different age groups, including Bambini runs, children’s races, a 5-kilometre run, Nordic walking and a 10-kilometre main race. The course runs on paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organised by Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supporting activities and refreshments.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Barßel Harbour and the swimming and sports centre
Bambini runs of approximately 400 metres on the main road, in two groups with different bib colours
10-kilometre race on a 5 km loop course on paved roads
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 15:30 at the Schützenhaus Barßelermoor, and the evening before from 17:00 to 19:00. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Bag drop is in the sports hall; use your race bib for identification. A sweep bicycle accompanies the races, with cut-off times of 19:15 (5 km) and 21:00 (10 km). Parking is available at several locations in Barßel; diversions due to the harbour festival are signposted. Registration is open until 19 August 2026. Late entries are possible for a fee. Parking is available nearby. Race bibs can be collected at the Schützenhaus. The event is hosted by an announcer, and timing is provided by Laufmanager.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf in Lübeck-Buntekuh is a traditional race taking place for the 18th time on August 21, 2026. The event offers various races for all ages and ability levels, from short runs on the sports grounds to longer distances on pedestrian paths. The races take place on pedestrian paths closed to traffic and on the sports grounds, creating a safe and pleasant atmosphere for all participants. The SC Buntekuh e.V. organizes the race with the aim of making exercise fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes on the sports grounds (750 m and 1.5 km)
Longer distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km) on pedestrian paths; roads are not closed to traffic
The 5 km route is completed multiple times for the 10 km (2 laps) and 15 km (3 laps) races
additional: Race packets will be distributed on August 20, 2026, from 6 to 8 p.m. and on the event day from 3 p.m. Late registration is possible until August 16, 2026, at 8:00 p.m.; after that, it may be available on the event day but is not guaranteed. Bib numbers are not personalized, but certificates will include the usual details. Changes to registrations are free until a certain time; after that, a fee of 10 euros will be charged. Several race categories are available, including a fun run, walking, and longer distances; online registration is possible. The start and finish are on Koggenweg in Lübeck-Buntekuh.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a family-friendly and popular running event in Taaken, taking place on 21 August 2026. The event offers various races for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the schoolchildren’s and jogger runs to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain, with fun and community at the heart of the event. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain
Start and finish on the green behind the sports hall
A 10 km relay with an original baton, for teams of 2 to 4 runners
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race for an additional €2. Changing rooms and showers are available in the Taaken sports hall. Parking is located behind the sports hall. Water, fruit and pastries are provided, and there are also snack and drink stands. All runners in the main, relay and jogger races can enter a raffle held after the main race awards ceremony. Various race categories, team relay, children’s and youth races, refreshments on site.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held every year on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The accurately measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km long, equivalent to one Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. Alongside the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburg Donations Parliament and commemorates Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein memorial stone.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 7.5 km out-and-back course (one Prussian land mile)
Start and finish on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee
Romantic lighting for an evening race
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Late registration fee: €1 organizational fee. Relaxed get-together afterwards, weather permitting. The organizer accepts no liability. By registering, participants grant permission for their personal data and photographs to be published. Course: 7.5 km; night race; participant limit: 300; registration probably online; start from 7 p.m.; donations support the Hamburg Donations Parliament.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 11,00 Euro für Erwachsene und wird per Bankeinzug nach der Anmeldung gezahlt.

description: The Detmold Residenzlauf is a long-standing running event taking place on 15 August 2026 in Detmold. The event offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the Market Square in Detmold, providing a central and lively setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and a range of categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Market Square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race bib collection on the event day from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race bib. Medals for all participating children and young people. Awards ceremony on the Market Square: school races from around 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Challenge Trophy for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, also features children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on 22 August 2026 at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. There are also relay events, walking and Nordic walking courses, and a children’s run. The event takes place in a scenic setting and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish for all events are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice, with up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). 4 x 10.5 km relay for teams. Walking/Nordic walking: 10.5 km and 21 km. Children’s run: 1.6 km, from age 6. Team and company rankings with awards. Courses are marked and staffed by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and is family-friendly.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarktlauf is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim, held annually in August. The 30th edition of the Michelsmarktlauf takes place on 22 August 2026, featuring a 10 km main race, a 1.4 km school race and a 400 m Bambini race. The event is organised by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
1.4 km school race
400 m Bambini race
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular with families, school groups and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is available.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more. The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.

description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain run in the North Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers various routes with gradients of up to 30%, passing through historic mining scenery and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Routes range from a short run for children to a marathon and trail run with up to 1,110 metres of elevation gain. The event is for runners, walkers and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.
course_highlights: Gradients of up to 30% on challenging sections
Start and finish at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site, amid historic mining scenery
Trail sections with an alpine character and up to 620 metres of elevation gain (BergmannTRAIL)
additional: Late registration is possible on 21.08. from 15:00 to 18:00 and on 22.08. from 08:00 on site, with a €3 late registration fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a yellow wristband for free access to the mining site (excluding guided tours). The BergmannTRAIL starts 200 m underground and includes a 250 m tunnel section where helmets are compulsory. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Dogs are not permitted on the site. Routes with up to 1,630 m of elevation gain, challenging sections with gradients of up to 30%, mining scenery, late registration available on site

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
organizer: Norbert Dulle, Heinz Hagen, Maik Mittmann, Holger Schulze, Florian Siebelmann, Frank Wilke
price_range: 49 Euro für Einzelstartende, 145 Euro für Staffeln
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place on 22 August 2026 at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and is open to all runners who want to cover as many kilometres as possible within six hours. Whether you are an ambitious runner, training for a marathon, or simply interested in running, walking or hiking together in the beautiful landscape around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and focuses on community and a good cause.
course_highlights: Circuit around Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück
Run, walk or hike in beautiful natural surroundings
Six-hour event with a freely chosen distance
additional: Briefing at 09:45, with attendance required for all runners. Relay teams: minimum 3, maximum 6 participants. The legendary “Every Grandma Counts” running shirt can be ordered for 25 euros when registering (sizes S/M/L; other sizes available on request). No refunds for failure to attend. The event supports the charitable organisation HelpAge Deutschland e.V. The route is a 3,130 m paved circuit around Rubbenbruchsee; the run is inclusive; refreshments and race materials are available on site; charity run supporting HelpAge Deutschland.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
location: Sieber, Herzberg am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
price_range: 44,00 € für das Original, 34,00 € für die Panorama-Runde, 19,00 € für das Natur-Erlebnis, Kinder 6,00 €; Frühbucherpreise bis 31.03.2026 ab 38,00 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Altersklasse: ab 16 Jahren Das Original , 27,5 km 44,00 €

description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns on August 22, 2026, after a 14-year break, offering three challenging routes in the Harz with up to 900 meters of elevation gain. The event is handmade and welcoming, and challenges runners of all ability levels. From the family-friendly 4.5 km Nature Experience route and the 12.5 km Panorama Loop to the queen stage of 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation gain, there is something for everyone. The runs take you through stunning natural scenery with panoramic views and offer an authentic Harz experience. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a pasta buffet and a community village festival to round off the event.
course_highlights: Nature Experience: 4.5 km with 130 meters of elevation gain, family-friendly and ideal for beginners
Panorama Loop: 12.5 km with 500 meters of elevation gain to Großer Knollen, with impressive views
The Original: 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation gain via Großer Knollen and Hanskühnenburg, challenging and legendary
additional: Race bib collection on August 21, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00, and on August 22, 2026, from 07:00 at the Haus des Gastes in Sieber. Pasta buffet on Friday evening (available to book separately for €7.00). Participation in “The Original” and “Panorama Loop” is also possible outside the age categories with written consent from a parent or guardian. Children’s race for ages 6–12 on August 22, 2026, at 11:00. Awards ceremony and village festival afterward on the Großen Wiesen. Three routes: Nature Experience (4.5 km), Panorama Loop (12.5 km), The Original (27.5 km); up to 900 meters of elevation gain; family-friendly; advance booking with pasta buffet; communal carbo-loading; participation outside the age categories possible with parental or guardian consent.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on August 22, 2026, on Oker Island in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines an athletic challenge with social commitment. The run supports the “Boxen gegen Parkinson” project and stands for exercise, community, and social responsibility. The event starts at 10:00 a.m., with entry from 8:30 a.m., and provides participants with still water and fresh fruit, as well as an exclusive finisher medal. Participants are asked to bring their own food and drink to ensure they are properly fueled.
course_highlights: Event on Oker Island in Braunschweig
Backyard Ultra format with loop running
Supporting the “Boxen gegen Parkinson” project
additional: Arrival is possible from 8:30 a.m. Basic provisions of still water and fresh fruit are included. An exclusive finisher medal is provided for all participants. Participants should bring their own food and drink. Event held in the Backyard Ultra format, starting at 10:00 a.m.; refreshments available on site; donations for “Boxen gegen Parkinson”; a sense of community in an ultramarathon format.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstadt Bach Ultra is a 60-kilometer ultramarathon taking place on August 22, 2026, in Arnstadt. It was created in response to runners’ wish to run the 60 km relay leg as a standalone ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in cooperation with the Arnstadt city administration and offers a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting initiative that will hopefully attract strong support and become part of Arnstadt’s diverse running tradition.
course_highlights: 60 km ultramarathon distance
Course runs around Arnstadt
Developed from the relay race into a standalone ultramarathon
additional: Electronic timing is provided by Sportident. Registration is via www.timing.sportident.com. The race is part of Arnstadt’s diverse running calendar, which includes several events throughout the year. Ultramarathon, 60 km, challenging course, in the Arnstadt region

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
location: Barumer Waldstadion, Barum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 25 € und beinhaltet eine Medaille und die Teilnehmerverpflegung im Zielbereich

description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race taking place on August 22, 2026, at Barumer Waldstadion and in the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburg Heath. The course follows sandy, muddy, and partly overgrown trails, with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural setting and is suitable for individuals and groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly landscape on the edge of the Lüneburg Heath
Sandy, muddy, and overgrown trails with water obstacles
4 km laps, run 1 to 3 times depending on the distance
additional: Individual start times between 2 and 4 p.m. will be sent to participants by email by August 21, 2026. The start and finish are at Barumer Waldstadion. Groups of 10 or more starters can take advantage of a discount promotion in which every fifth starter runs for free. Race packets are distributed at the race office 30 minutes before each start time. There is a wash area on site, and drinks and snacks are available in the finish area. The race takes place at Barumer Waldstadion and is suitable for all ability levels. Training plans and a family-friendly atmosphere also put the fun of obstacle racing first.

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
location: Stadion an der Breslauer Straße, Wittmund, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmund Citizens’ Run is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund. It starts at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The route runs through the town center, past the market square and Schlossplatz, and offers a challenging and varied course. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, which are free to enter. The event is well organized with support from the police, fire brigade and German Red Cross (DRK), and is popular with runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium on Breslauer Straße
Route through the town center, past the market square and Schlossplatz
Challenging course with a varied route
additional: Parking is available at the stadium and at the Schützenplatz on Auricher Straße. The event is medically supported by the police, fire brigade and DRK. Children’s and youth races are free to enter, while the main races have an entry fee. The event is hosted by an announcer and supported by local sports clubs. The race includes 5 km, 10 km and 1,200 m distances, with a supporting program, on-site registration and parking at the stadium and Schützenplatz. The event is very popular with participants and offers a festive atmosphere.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang-Loop is an inclusive diversity run in Emden, taking place for the third time on August 22, 2026. The run is for all age groups and people with and without disabilities, bringing everyone together to enjoy running. A range of events and distances—from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10 km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners—offers something for everyone. The run is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series and promotes community, exercise and inclusion.
course_highlights: A range of distances for children, young people and adults with and without disabilities
An inclusive run focused on running together and overcoming barriers
Part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series, with 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The middenmang-Loop features a range of events and distances for all age groups and abilities. The event places particular emphasis on inclusion and community. The 5 km and 10 km runs are part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series. Registration is online via the website. Contact person: Inga Weerts. An inclusive run with various distances for all age groups and abilities, and part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series.

name: Ring of Feier - 2.Hermeskeiler City Lauf
organizer: Kulturbeirat der Stadt Hermeskeil, Hermeskeiler Turnverein
description: The Ring of Feier – 2nd Hermeskeiler City Run takes place on August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. It is a short running event with distances of 150 m and 5 km. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. Participants should check the organizer’s details before registering.
course_highlights: Short distances: 150 m and 5 km
City run in Hermeskeil
Typical summer weather with mostly sunny days

description: The 15th Flörsheim Lebenslauf on 29 August 2026 is a traditional race commemorating the town’s deliverance from the plague in 1666. The approximately 10 km course covers two laps, starting along the banks of the Main and passing through Eddersheim, the town park and the old town before finishing at the historic Gallusplatz. The motto “Remember – Run – Give Thanks” reflects the event’s religious and community spirit. Proceeds benefit the support associations of Riedschule and Paul-Maar-Schule. Alongside the main race, there are children’s and youth races with no entry fee.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km in two laps
From the banks of the Main towards Eddersheim, through the town park and old town
Finish at historic Gallusplatz, the heart of Flörsheim
additional: Late entries are accepted at the race-number distribution desk in the Galluszentrum until 30 minutes before the respective race, with no late-entry fee. There is a Bambini race (approximately 800 m) for children born in 2017 or later, with no entry fee, as well as a beginners’ and youth race of approximately 2.6 km for participants born in 2018 or earlier, with no age-group divisions. Children receive certificates and medals. Course: approximately 10 km; several race categories; online registration until 27.08.2026; on-site late entries available.

name: Maare Mosel Lauf
description: The Maare-Mosel-Lauf is a scenic trail race in the Eifel, taking place on 29 August 2026 in Gillenfeld. The course passes mysterious maars, rugged rocks and gently rolling hills, offering runners a unique nature experience with wonderful views. There are three main distances for beginners and experienced runners, as well as age-appropriate children’s races. Alongside the sporting event, participants can enjoy an attractive programme of live music and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Course passing the deep-blue Pulvermaar
Loop around the Schalkenmehrener Maar with 240 metres of elevation gain
Scenic nature reserves of Mürmes and Sangweiher
additional: Late registration is available on site for an additional fee of €5. Race packs will be mailed to participants who register at least 7 days before the event; otherwise, they can be collected from 15:00 on race day at the school in Gillenfeld. There will be a varied programme of live music and award ceremonies from 19:30. The races take place on the grounds around the Gillenfeld primary and secondary school. Three distances to choose from, including a 5 km route at the Pulvermaar; a scenic race with elevation gain; online registration available.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is SV 1860 Minden’s largest running event, with more than 1,000 participants every year. The 50th anniversary run takes place on 29 August 2026, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. At the same time, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: A course featuring new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium, with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration opening in May 2026. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional cross-country races in the Rhenish lignite-mining region near Niederzier. The 25 km Monte Sophia Run, with 380 metres of elevation gain, takes runners across the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied trails, distinctive natural and cultural landmarks, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter 10 km alternative, while the 5.3 km Broisterd Loop is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children’s races and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for cross-country runners and marathon trainees.
course_highlights: 25 km route with 380 metres of elevation gain across the Sophienhöhe
Distinctive landmarks including the Stone Compass, Celtic Tree Circle, Golden Meadow and Roman Tower
Varied gradients, from gentle to steep, on firm gravel paths and asphalt
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the gymnasium. Aid stations with water, tea, fruit and cola are located along the course and at the finish. Children receive medals and certificates; the top three in each age group receive prizes. Runners entering two races receive a separate bib for each race. Bicycle escorts, jogging strollers, dogs and headphones are prohibited. A challenging cross-country event in the Rhenish lignite-mining region, with a range of race distances, including children’s races and walking.

name: Mußbacher Eselshautlauf
location: Vereinsgelände des TV 1860 Mußbach e.V., Mußbach, Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 3rd Mußbacher Eselshautlauf is a community race with four different distances, welcoming participants of all fitness levels. The routes follow farm tracks and pass through the Ordenswald forest, starting and finishing at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds. A special highlight is the after-run party with a DJ, with food provided by a food truck and the club’s catering committee. The event is covered by the German Red Cross and offers restroom facilities as well as a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along farm tracks and through the Ordenswald forest
Start and finish at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds
After-run party with a DJ and food from a food truck
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:30 in the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. gym. Restroom facilities (toilets and showers) are available at the club grounds. Late registration is possible on race day until 16:30. The city champion of Neustadt an der Weinstraße will be determined in the 10-kilometer race. All finishers receive a medal; the top three finishers in each age group also receive a prize and a certificate. Routes along farm tracks and through the forest, online registration, late registration possible on race day, parking available, DLV-approved, participant limit of 300, medals for all finishers, music and refreshments after the race

name: Panoramalauf rund um die Burg Are
distance_verbose: Ultramarathon, 50 km, 50 km, 35 km, 33 km, 19 km, 16 km
price_range: 10,00 bis 24,00 Euro je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Panoramalauf around Are Castle is a scenic popular race in the middle Ahr Valley, organised by Selbstläufer Altenahr e.V. and approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV). With distances of 19 km, 35 km and 57 km, it offers a varied challenge featuring panoramic paths, single-track trails and some demanding climbs. The start and finish are at Martinshütte above Altenahr, where refreshments are also available. The event takes place annually on the last Saturday in August and welcomes runners from near and far to enjoy the nature and scenery of the Ahr Valley.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes with extended uphill and downhill sections
Uses the Red Wine Hiking Trail, the Ahr Hiking Trail and single-track trails
Routes pass over Schwedenkopf, Saffenburg and Steinerberg (the highest point of the Ahr Mountains)
additional: Course refreshments include water, tea, cola, fruit, biscuits, chocolate, energy bars, sandwiches and potatoes (3 stations for K19, 5 for K35, 7 for K57). Drinking cups are provided; bringing your own cup is recommended to reduce waste. There is no official course supervision at road crossings, so please cross carefully. Time limit for K35 and K57: 10.5 hours. A scenic race with uphill and downhill sections, using hiking trails and single-track trails, with refreshments at several stations. The event encourages environmentally conscious use of drinking cups; there is no official course supervision on roads open to traffic.

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultrarunning Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 in Batenbrock Park in Bottrop, offering an unforgettable running experience for ultrarunning fans. Alongside the established 6- and 24-hour races, the Halden Backyard is once again a special highlight. The festival stands out for its great community, compelling challenges and unique festival atmosphere, shaped by hourly restarts and parallel competitions.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour races in Batenbrock Park
Halden Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel competitions
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition and a walking event taking place at the same time, creating a unique festival atmosphere. Running event with 6-hour, 24-hour, relay and Backyard events; in Batenbrock Park; online registration; event in August 2026

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
location: Schloss Stolberg, Stolberg im Harz, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Stolberger Schloss-Lauf 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at the historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers various races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs and children’s races. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest paths and over the hills of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable character.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stolberg Castle, with its historic setting
Varied routes through the old town, along forest paths and over the hills of the southern Harz
A special finish-line experience at the castle
additional: Alongside the main races, the event includes walking, fun runs, and children’s races. Participation supports regional projects in and around Stolberg. Accommodation is offered by Ritter von Kempski Private Hotels & Resorts directly in and around Stolberg. Some sections of the routes follow unpaved, natural forest paths and carry a corresponding risk of accidents. Multiple distances, children’s races, relay race, support for regional projects, accommodation nearby

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an extraordinary relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the Wadden Sea National Park UNESCO World Heritage Site and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic towns, and marshland with a sea breeze. The event lasts more than 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete the course together. Start times are assigned according to the average pace submitted, and digital maps are provided before the race.
course_highlights: Around 250 km through the Wadden Sea National Park UNESCO World Heritage Site
Start in Hamburg St. Pauli, finish on the beach in St. Peter-Ording
Diverse nature reserves, marshland, and a sea breeze
additional: Participants must be born in 2010 or earlier (Ultra teams: 2008 or earlier). Team sizes: 10-person teams (3 legs per runner) or Ultra 5-person teams (6 legs per runner). 5 Pack teams are paired with a similar 5 Pack team. Team categories are assigned automatically when members are entered (men, women, diverse, mixed). 10-person teams must arrange 2 vans as team vehicles; 5-person teams must arrange 1 van. Start times are assigned according to the average pace submitted. The event lasts more than 24 hours. Digital maps are provided before the event. Team relay race with various categories, participation for those born in 2008 or earlier, detailed information on registration, costs, and the event schedule, including navigation using maps.

name: Birklauf
description: The Birklauf hosted by MTV Gelting 08 is a traditional running event taking place on 29 August 2026 from 15:45 at Birkhalle Gelting. The event celebrates sport, fun and nature, and gives runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Timing is provided on all distances except the 750-metre Sprottenlauf, and all finishers receive a medal. Results are ranked by age group, and honorary prizes are awarded to the top three runners.
course_highlights: Timing on all distances except the 750 m Sprottenlauf
Results ranked by age group
Medal for all finishers
additional: Entries are accepted until 22 August 2026. The event is hosted by MTV Gelting 1908 e.V. All finishers receive a medal, and honorary prizes are awarded to the first three places. The 750 m Sprottenlauf is untimed. Courses through the Geltinger Birk nature reserve and Nordschauwald; registration until 22 August 2026; race materials available from 15:00; refreshments include fruit and drinks.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The Elstertal Run, organized by 1. SV Gera, is a long-standing running event with a range of distances for runners of all ages. On August 29, 2026, individual races over 10 km and 15 km, as well as relay races for companies and school students, will take place. There are also children’s races and a challenging stair run with about 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series and offers a varied route through the region.
course_highlights: 15 km individual race for men, women and youth
Company and school relays over 5 x 3 km, with a flexible number of runners
2,500 m stair run with approx. 1,300 steps
additional: Children’s races as part of the Osterland Cross (600 m, 800 m, 1,000 m / 3 km). Relay teams may have 2 to 5 runners; with 4 runners, one runner covers 6 km. The individual races are part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series. Several race formats, including a stair run; training plans and detailed information available.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a traditional race organized by the Pretzsch running team. Held annually in autumn near Leipzig, it features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and uses this event to foster community and sporting ambition. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the chance to take on a varied course.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country course at the canoe center near Leipzig
A variety of challenges for runners of all ages
Traditional event with strong ties to the club
additional: The event is organized by SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V., which also organizes other running events and challenges. The pages reviewed do not provide explicit details about start times, pricing tiers, or registration procedures. The race takes place on 29 August 2026 and is known for its challenging course and friendly atmosphere. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on 29 August 2026. Organised by Müritzer LSV, the course loops around the picturesque Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Loop around Tiefwarensee
Start and finish at the sports field at Tiefwarensee, Güstrower Straße
Scenic route in Waren (Müritz)
additional: Registration address: Peter Hoffmann, Am Pappelgrund 10; Event number: 26V08000010060000; Category: event away from a stadium (6.5.1). Registration closes on 27 August 2026. The event is part of a regional running and nature experience programme highlighting the beauty of Tiefwarensee and the surrounding nature.

name: LimLauf 2026
description: The Limlauf takes place for the 31st time in 2026 in Limbach, Kirkel, and is one of the largest running events in the Saarpfalz district. The event includes a traditional half marathon and a 2 km student race for young runners. The course is officially measured, flat and fast, making it possible to achieve fast times. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies, refreshments and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with kilometre markers
Flat and fast course
4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for the student race
additional: Online pre-registration is closed. Late registration is available on the day of the event from 14:00 to 16:30 in the village hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for women in the village hall and for men in the school gym. Medical assistance is available in the finish area and on course via mobile units. Results are shown live on a large screen in the village hall. Parking is available at several locations, with exits that do not cross the course. Award ceremonies take place in the village hall immediately after the races. Registration on the day of the event is available from 14:00 in the village hall. Prizes are awarded to winners and in team competitions. Parking is available at the school gym, swimming pool, dog shelter, and cemetery/Palatia. Medical assistance is available on site.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
location: Wabachstadion, Bad Laasphe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race held as part of the SummerCityGames and organised by TV Laasphe. The course starts at Wabachstadion and follows paved paths and forest trails to its highest point, with a challenging climb and a second half that is mostly downhill and offers a lovely view. There is a 6 km youth/everyone’s race and a 12 km main race, which covers the course twice and is a real challenge. Changing rooms and showers are also available directly at the sports ground.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wabachstadion Bad Laasphe
Paved paths and forest trails, with a tough climb to the highest point
The second half of the course is mostly downhill and offers a lovely view
additional: Late entries are possible 60 minutes before the start of the competition, subject to a €3 late-entry fee. Race numbers can be collected at the clubhouse on the sports ground. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports ground. Course description: 6 km and 12 km races, uphill and downhill, on paved paths and forest trails; registration until 28.08.2025; late entry 60 minutes before the start for a fee; start/finish at the Bad Laasphe sports ground; changing rooms/showers available

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a popular road race in the beautiful municipality of Salzbergen, taking place on August 29, 2026. Various distances are offered for all age groups, including a children’s fun run, a school mile, a 5 km community race, and a 10 km main race. The event is part of the EL-CUP and, alongside exciting competitions, offers a varied program for runners and spectators. The races start at Oberschule Salzbergen and encourage both individual and team competition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberschule Salzbergen
Distances: 600 m children’s fun run, 1,700 m school mile, 5 km and 10 km community races
Team competition in the main races
additional: Start times: 14:30 first race; 14:45 school mile; 15:15 5 km community race; 16:15 10 km main race; 16:20 5 km walking/Nordic walking (no timing). Team competition for timed races; teams consist of 3 participants. Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the respective race, with a €1.00 late registration fee. Race materials are available from approximately 13:15 at the on-site race office. Races with team competition, online registration, supporting program, trophies and medals.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertal Run offers various race distances, including the 10 km main race, a 10 km relay, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and toddlers. The flat out-and-back course, with approximately 33 metres of elevation gain, is ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early on Saturday evening, with the start and finish at the market square, and follows the cycle path to Schweigern. The awards ceremony takes place in the festival tent and rounds off the sporting event.
course_highlights: Flat out-and-back course with approximately 33 metres of elevation gain
Route follows the cycle path to Schweigern
Views of vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: Start and finish at the market square; event takes place early on Saturday evening; awards ceremony in the festival tent; Nordic walking is possible on the 5 km route; various race categories at the fire brigade run in Löffelstelzen; weather in August: approximately 25°C and sunny; start at the market square in Unterschüpf; open to all age groups

name: Wixhäuser Kerblauf
description: The Wixhäuser Kerblauf is a traditional fun run held on the last Saturday in August in Wixhausen near Darmstadt. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is mostly paved and flat, running through residential areas and open fields. In addition to individual rankings, there are team rankings for the 4 km and 6 km races. The event is organized by TSG Wixhausen and is popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course with no inclines
The 4 km race consists of two laps; the 6 km race consists of three laps
The course runs approximately one-third through a residential area and two-thirds across open fields
additional: Medals for the top three finishers in each age group in races 1–4; trophies for the overall winners of races 5 and 6. All participants receive a certificate. T-shirts awarded as prizes for races 1–4 for registrations received by 30.07.2026; adults can order a finisher shirt for an additional fee. Team rankings for the 4 km and 6 km races, with at least 3 participants per team. Team names can be submitted up to 30 minutes before the start of the competition. Registration until 30 July 2026; finisher shirts available for an additional fee; team rankings; results at Race Result

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused popular race in the Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied courses wind through the breathtaking natural landscape around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for both experienced runners and beginners. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit takes centre stage, supported by an attractive programme at the sports ground. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organised by SG Birkungen 07.
course_highlights: Nature-focused courses around the Dünkreuz
A variety of events for all ages (400 m to 10 km)
Part of the renowned Eichsfeld Cup
additional: There are 4 courses and 5 events: Bambini-Run (400 m), Youngster-Run (1.5 km), 6-K-Run (6 km run/Nordic walking) and 10-K-Run (10 km run). The event fosters community spirit and offers a programme at the sports ground. Results from previous years are available at my.raceresult.com. Forest trails, fields, elevation gain, Nordic walking, course signage, medical support, transponder timing, community programme

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Bib pickup takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to an ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Bib pickup is on 29.08.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Rauschenberg sports hall. Late registration is available on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund gives runners the opportunity to run their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course. Depending on the distance, runners complete 2 or 4 laps. The course is eligible for ranking lists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to a finisher medal, refreshments, and an awards ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner in the finish area invites participants to take photos, and results are available digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km race: 4 laps; 5 km race: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a keepsake photo spot
additional: The race office opens at 07:30. Awards for men and women, places 1–3, take place on the event area after the finish. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Results and certificates can be accessed via the QR code on the race bib. A €5 late registration fee applies to registrations after the registration deadline. Races take place on a measured 2.5 km loop course. Registration is open until 16.08.2026. Shirt options, timing, an awards ceremony, and photos are included.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon on August 30, 2026, offers runners a choice of four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km. Everyone starts together at 10 a.m. at the NetCologne Stadium at Sportpark Müngersdorf. The route goes through Cologne and is designed as a dress rehearsal for other races. Water, bananas, energy bars, and non-alcoholic drinks will be available along the route and at the finish. The event is organized by Leichtathletik-Team Deutsche Sporthochschule Köln e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the NetCologne Stadium at Sportpark Müngersdorf
Four distance options: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km
Refreshments along the route and at the finish, including water, bananas, and Maxi Nutrition bars
additional: Late registrations are possible in person at race-pack pickup until August 30, 2026, subject to availability. For safety reasons, baby joggers, dogs, walkers, and music devices are not permitted. Custom bib numbers can be selected for a €3 fee. Changes to registrations are only possible at race-pack pickup and cost €15. Route, start/finish in Cologne, late registration on site, refreshments, race-pack pickup, parking, showers, changing rooms

name: Lahnparklauf
price_range: 14,00 € für 21,1 km und 30 km, 9,00 € für 5 km und 10 km
description: The Lahnparklauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in the heart of Hesse. It is an established running event for runners of all ability levels. The proven course concept, known as the LOOP, will be retained this year. The organizing team at team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and also offers training in a range of sports.
course_highlights: Proven LOOP course route
Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all ability levels
additional: Registration is expected to open in early June 2026. In addition to the race, training is also offered in running, trail running, triathlon, fitness, dance, Zumba, and yoga. Course map and elevation profile online; online registration; parking at the REWE car park; no bag storage provided by the organizer; medical services provided by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Panoramalauf
description: The Münstertal Panoramic Run is a varied 10 km cross-country race with a trail section and 229 metres of elevation gain. There are also student races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km. The event takes place in the picturesque Münstertal Staufen region and offers runners an appealing route through nature. Advance registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race with a trail section
229 metres of elevation gain
Student races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km
additional: Advance registration is via RaceResult. The event is organised by Zweckverband Schwarzwaldsüden. Advance registration via RaceResult; the event includes a 10 km race with trail sections, as well as other distances, including fun runs and trail runs.
