description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a traditional race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon covering 42.195 km. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, providing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic old town and along the Elbe dike
Marathon over four laps, combining varied city and countryside scenery
Half-marathon and other distances by the water and on paved paths
additional: The Bambini run is limited to 300 children from daycare centers in the Samtgemeinde Land Hadeln and is non-competitive. There are various age groups and classifications for schoolchildren. The event offers free parking, bag storage, and one hour of free use of the Otterndorf saltwater thermal baths (excluding the sauna) upon presentation of a race bib. There is a Cuxland classification with cash prizes for runners from the district of Cuxhaven. Award ceremonies are held in stages by distance and classification at the Historic Town Hall. The event takes place on the Elbe dike and in Otterndorf’s historic old town, with special categories such as handbikers and walkers. It is a family-friendly event with a strong sense of community.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
price_range: 34 € bis 58 € je nach Lauf und Nachmeldung
description: The Tübinger Erbe-Lauf is a varied running event in Tübingen’s historic old town, taking place on 20 September 2026. The main race covers 10 kilometres, divided into four laps through the old town and the Umbrisch-Provencalischer Markt. Other events include the 5K, Team Challenge, Junior Run and BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers individual timing, an exclusive finisher’s medal and a unique atmosphere in this picturesque city. Breathable organic cotton running socks are included in the entry fee for all participants.
course_highlights: 4 laps through Tübingen’s old town
Course passes through the Umbrisch-Provencalischer Markt
Closed, record-eligible course with timing
additional: Free organic cotton running socks included in the entry fee (order by 28 June 2026; collect at race-pack collection). Free public transport on event day within the Neckar-Alb-Donau Transport Association area. Baggage storage, refreshments during and after the race, free post-race massage, downloadable certificate. Exclusive finisher’s medal. Late entries online are possible until 2 hours before the start, subject to a €5 late-entry fee and availability of places. Race numbers, medals, refreshments, massage and public transport included; registration closes on 6 September 2026.

name: Uplengener RVB Herbstmarktlauf
location: Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13, Uplengen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Uplengener RVB Autumn Market Run takes place on September 20, 2026, in Uplengen, Germany. This long-standing race was first held in 2002 and offers races for children and schoolchildren. The start is at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13. The event is ideal for runners of all ages who want to enjoy an autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km
Start at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13
Typical September weather: around 19 °C and mostly cloudy
additional: Please check the event details with the organiser before registering. Typical September weather: around 19 °C, cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation; ideal for an outdoor autumn run.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including around the lake, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organisation and the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course through the village, around the lake and through the surrounding countryside
A variety of distances from 900 m to 10 km
Scenic and varied running routes
additional: The race includes several age and distance categories, including a Bambini run for children aged 3–4 and up. Photos from the race can be requested by email by providing your bib number. The event is supported by many volunteers and takes place annually. It offers various distances, including Bambini and junior races, with results by age group. Photos and further information are available on request.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilscher FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually since 2005 at the Wilsche sports ground in Gifhorn. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing 10 km race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is a fixture in the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organisations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross (DRK).
course_highlights: 10 km race as part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup
Start and finish at the Wilsche sports ground
Fire brigade and DRK participation for safety
additional: The FunRun is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup, which has a total of 9 races. The event is supported by the Wilsche and Neubokel fire brigades and a DRK emergency response vehicle. A children’s race and the Wilscher Marathon have been offered as part of Gifhorn Running Day since 2015. The registration link for 2026 will be published later. Start at 10 a.m.; registration is via the organiser’s website, and participation is open to all running enthusiasts.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program including face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and emphasizes a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (half marathon)
Start on Ihmer Straße, with different start times for each distance
Family-friendly atmosphere with a runners’ breakfast and food on offer
additional: The 500 m Möhrchenlauf (start: 9:10 a.m.) and 1.4 km Schülerlauf (start: 9:15 a.m.) are free for children up to age 6 and ages 7–12, respectively. The runners’ breakfast after finishing is free for all participants. Food includes a cake buffet, waffle stand and grilled food at reasonable prices. Team scoring is available, and clubs and teams can register together. Various distances, children’s and youth races, walking; registration is required for some races.

name: Trail Marathon Heidelberg
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Trail Marathon Heidelberg is one of Germany’s most extraordinary trail-running events and takes place on September 20, 2026. Under the motto “HERRLICH.HÖHER.HÄRTER” (“GLORIOUS.HIGHER.HARDER”), the race offers challenging and varied courses with plenty of trails, steep climbs and impressive views. The event includes three distances: the Base Trail (20 km), the Half Trail (30 km) and the Heart Core Trail (45 km), with more than 2,000 metres of elevation gain. The route passes, among other places, the Thingstätte, the Philosophenweg, the Heiligenberg and the Königstuhl, offering a unique atmosphere for trail runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 45 km Heart Core Trail with approx. 2,019 metres of elevation gain and challenging trail sections
Course sections along the Philosophenweg and through the Thingstätte and Heiligenberg
Michelsbrunnen Nature Park and the Felsenmeer, with an approx. 8 km loop
additional: The Heart Core Trail crosses the Alte Brücke and passes through the Hirschgasse to the Philosophenweg. The course includes 178 steps at the Thingstätte and a challenging section along the Himmelsleiter, with natural steps, rocky ledges and loose stones. The upper station of the Heidelberg funicular, at an elevation of 567 metres, is a notable point shortly before the steep and dangerous descent to the finish at Karlsplatz. The event offers distances of 20 km, 30 km and 45 km, including a 20 km Base Trail, and is known for its scenic beauty and sporting challenge.

name: Tien van 't Aogje

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn € 9,50 per afstand bij de voorinschrijving

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn € 9,50 per afstand bij de voorinschrijving

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor de Familieloop bedragen 3 euro

description: De Tien van 't Aogje is een hardloopevenement in Princenhage, Breda, dat plaatsvindt op 20 september 2026. De wedstrijd biedt prestatielopen over 5 en 10 kilometer, met een gezellige familieloop als extra onderdeel. De startnummers worden vooraf per mail verstuurd en er is een prijsuitreiking direct na afloop van elke loop op de Haagsemarkt. Het evenement trekt veel deelnemers en heeft een maximale capaciteit per afstand.
course_highlights: 5 km en 10 km prestatielopen door Princenhage
Prijsuitreiking direct na afloop op de Haagsemarkt
Gezellige familieloop als extra onderdeel
additional: Startnummers worden per mail verstuurd met aanvullende informatie. Er zijn twee ophaalmomenten voor startnummers. Prijsuitreiking vindt direct na afloop van elke loop plaats op de Haagsemarkt. Er is een maximaal aantal deelnemers per afstand. Inschrijving voor 2025 is gesloten; voorinschrijving voor 2026 is mogelijk tot 13 september 2026. Het evenement vindt plaats in Princenhage, Breda, en omvat meerdere loopafstanden met prijsuitreikingen na elke race.

name: AOK Firmenlauf in Haslach im Kinzigtal
location: Haslach im Kinzigtal, Ortenaukreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
price_range: 20,00 Euro pro Person (Hauptlauf), 14,00 Euro (Lauf für Alle), zusätzliche Gebühr 4 Euro nach Meldeschluss

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Lauf für Alle

description: The AOK Haslach im Kinzigtal Company Run is a team event taking place on 22 September 2026 and is part of the BW-Running series. The event promotes exercise, team spirit and shared experiences in everyday working life. The main race is approximately 5 km long, and there is also a 2 km “Run for Everyone”. After the race, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish, and special meeting points are available for teams to experience race day together.
course_highlights: Main race: approximately 5 km
Run for Everyone: approximately 2 km
Nordic walking poles are permitted; participants using them should start at the very back
additional: The main race starts at 18:00, while the Run for Everyone starts at 17:30. Registration is via company registration with a team captain. Late registration is possible until the registration deadline; after that, only changes of participant are permitted. Participants must be at least 16 years old. Accompaniment by cyclists, skaters, dogs or fans is not permitted. Nordic walking poles are allowed, and starting at the very back is recommended. Complimentary finish refreshments are available at all BW-Running series venues. Registration details can be changed up to 30 minutes before the start. Minimum age: 16. Registration via company registration; team and individual registrations are possible. Start times: 17:30 and 18:00.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Balingen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 801 bis 2.000 Anmeldungen bzw. bis zum Meldeschluss am 14. September 2026 (18:00 Uhr)

description: The AOK Balingen Company Run is a popular team event taking place on 24 September 2026 at the marketplace in Balingen. The course is approximately 5.9 kilometres long and is run over two laps of about 2.9 km each. The event promotes exercise for everyone and inclusion, enabling people with and without disabilities to take part together. After the run, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish and a lively awards ceremony with music. It’s a great opportunity to experience team spirit and add some physical activity to the working day.
course_highlights: Course approx. 5.9 km, two laps of approx. 2.9 km each
Start and finish at the marketplace in Balingen
Inclusive run for all participants
additional: From 17:00, a DJ will set the mood on stage. There will be a group warm-up before the start. After the finish, awards ceremonies and musical entertainment will take place. Finish-line refreshments include alcohol-free Erdinger in three varieties, fruit, vegetables and water. Changes to registrations are free of charge until the registration deadline and subject to a fee thereafter. Minimum age: 16. A run for EVERYONE, a team event, inclusive training and refreshments.

name: Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is een unieke 180 kilometer lange ultraloop van Amsterdam naar Groningen, waarbij deelnemers een constante snelheid van 7,5 km/u moeten aanhouden om binnen 24 uur te finishen. Deelnemers dragen alles zelf mee en lopen zonder crew, terwijl ze worden achtervolgd door een 'zombie-horde' die hen elimineert als ze langzamer gaan dan het tempo. Het is geen wedstrijd tegen andere lopers, maar een persoonlijke uitdaging om de finish te halen en de zombies voor te blijven.
course_highlights: 180 kilometer van Amsterdam naar Groningen
Constante snelheid van 7,5 km/u vereist
Rolling cutoff: wie door de zombie-horde wordt ingehaald, moet stoppen
additional: Deelnemers moeten alles zelf dragen, er is geen crew toegestaan. De race heeft een rolling cutoff waarbij wie ingehaald wordt door de zombie-horde (bewegend met 7,5 km/u) moet stoppen. Terugreis wordt zelf geregeld, maar er is een zombie-mobiel die kan helpen bij het bereiken van een OV-punt. route in Nederland, in donker en licht, met publieke watertappunten, geen aid stations of vrijwilligers ter plaatse

name: Martini Marathon
price_range: 4,22 euro voor sololopers, 21,10 euro voor estafetteteams
description: De Martini Marathon in Groningen is een unieke marathon op de atletiekbaan, georganiseerd door Groningen Atletiek. De race vindt plaats op vrijdagavond 25 september 2026 en biedt zowel een solo-marathon van 42,195 meter als een estafette voor teams van 3 tot 5 lopers. De estafette bestaat uit afstanden van 2.195 meter en vier keer 10.000 meter, wat een uitdagende en snelle loopervaring garandeert. De sfeer is gezellig met catering onderweg en na afloop, en alle deelnemers ontvangen een medaille. De winnaars ontvangen de prestigieuze Martini Bokaal.
course_highlights: Marathon op de atletiekbaan Stadspark Groningen
Estafette met afstanden van 2.195 m en 4×10.000 m
Maximaal 60 deelnemers op de baan tegelijk
additional: Maximaal 60 lopers tegelijk op de baan, met een reservelijst voor extra inschrijvingen. De maximale tijd om de marathon te voltooien is 5 uur en 15 minuten. Er is catering onderweg en na afloop. Start en finish zijn bij de atletiekbaan Stadspark Groningen, waar ook kleed- en bagagebewaring beschikbaar is. De organisatie is in handen van Alex Jager namens Groningen Atletiek. Track race met solo- en estafette-varianten, inschrijving opent op 01-01-2026, maximale deelnemersaantallen en tijdslimieten gelden

name: Nedmag Moonlightwalk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnemers betalen € 12,50 inschrijfgeld. Van dit bedrag gaat €10,- naar het goede doel.

description: De Nedmag Moonlightwalk in Veendam is een sfeervolle avondwandeling van circa 6 kilometer die plaatsvindt bij maanlicht. Het evenement is geen wedstrijd, maar een ontspannen wandeling waarbij deelnemers kunnen genieten van diverse optredens en bijzondere belevenissen langs de route. De route is toegankelijk voor bijna iedereen, inclusief rolstoelgebruikers, en biedt een unieke manier om Veendam te beleven. De opbrengst van de wandeling gaat naar het goede doel, dit jaar het Margarethe Hardenberg Cultuurcentrum.
course_highlights: Circa 6 km lange wandeltocht
Diverse optredens en leuke acts onderweg
Toegankelijk voor rolstoelgebruikers
additional: Startlocatie is Museumplein Veendam. Aanmelden kan vanaf 19:00 tot 19:30 uur, starten kan tussen 19:30 en 20:30 uur. Inschrijven is ook mogelijk op de avond zelf met contant of PIN betalen. De tocht eindigt ook op het Museumplein. Honden zijn toegestaan mits aangelijnd en eigen materiaal voor opruimen wordt meegenomen. Er is geen officiële toiletvoorziening onderweg, maar soms kan gebruik worden gemaakt van toiletten bij bedrijven/kantines. Route verrassend anders, geen wedstrijd, voor bijna iedereen geschikt, entertainment en goede doel ondersteuning

name: ENTEGA Nightrun
location: Radgelände des Darmstädter Velodroms, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany
description: The ENTEGA Nightrun on September 25, 2026, is a unique running event on the cycling grounds of the Velodrom in Darmstadt. The course is fully illuminated and offers a varied mix of grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed surfaces. With distances of 1.6 km (students’ run), 2.5 km, 5 km, and 7.5 km, there is something for runners of all ages and ability levels. The special atmosphere at dusk and the energetic presence of fellow runners make this an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated circuit around the cycling track grounds
Varied surfaces: grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed ground
Atmospheric run at dusk with dazzling lights
additional: Race-number collection on the day of the event from 17:30 in the hall. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Shoes with spikes are not allowed. Water and regional products from Alnatura will be provided. Medical services will be available on the course and at the finish. Parking is available on the tennis grounds next to the event site. Valuables can be handed in at the hall for a fee of €1. No showers are provided. Course on grass, asphalt, and gravel; shoes with spikes not allowed; parking at the TGB tennis grounds; no showers; medical services available.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
location: Wymeer, Landkreis Cloppenburg, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Teilnahmegebühr von 3 € je Teilnehmer*in, mit der Anmeldung in der Schule abzugeben

description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Student Race is a traditional annual running competition that brings together students from several schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate classifications for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers. Registration is through the schools, and late registration is available on the day of the event. The race takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and promotes youth sport in the region.
course_highlights: Each course is marked with a different colour
Separate classifications for girls and boys
Preparation runs before the main event
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 15:00 to 15:30 in the gymnastics room at the TUS clubhouse. Registration is through the schools. Students under 16 need the signatures of both legal guardians to register late. Courses are marked by colour; there are separate classifications for girls and boys; all participants receive certificates and medals; prizes go to the first three finishers; late registration is available on the day of the event.

name: 42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: De 42e editie van de Halve van Katwijk vindt plaats op 26 september 2026 en is een populair hardloop- en wandelfeest langs de kust. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn sportieve en sfeervolle karakter, met een prachtig parcours dat start en finisht bij het Duinplein voor de vuurtoren aan de Katwijkse Boulevard. De Halve van Katwijk biedt diverse afstanden voor hardlopers, wandelaars en kinderen, en trekt jaarlijks veel deelnemers die genieten van de unieke omgeving en de gezellige sfeer. De organisatie zet zich continu in om het evenement te verbeteren en iedereen een onvergetelijke dag te bezorgen.
course_highlights: Start en finish bij het Duinplein, direct voor de vuurtoren aan de Katwijkse Boulevard
Verversingsposten op Vriezenwei, Panbos en Wassenaarse Slag
Diverse parcoursen met GPX-bestanden beschikbaar, waaronder speciale Kidsrun-routes
additional: Start- en Finishdorp op het Duinplein met kleedruimte, toiletten, activiteiten en massage. Geen na-inschrijving mogelijk. Parkeergarage aan de Boulevard en alternatieve parkeergarages in de buurt. Bewaakte fietsenstalling is niet aanwezig. Businessrun met eigen startvak, groepsfoto, aandenken en netwerkborrel na afloop. GPX-bestanden van alle routes beschikbaar. Event omvat ook een Kidsrun en Business Run; inschrijving is populair en sluit vaak vroeg vanwege de grote belangstelling.

name: Thaisner DörpsRun
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: De 5 van Bavel

price_tiers.distance: Hofkens HIG 10km Trimloop en Chiropractie La Flamme 5km wedstrijd

description: De 5 van Bavel is een jaarlijks hardloopevenement in ’t Klooster, Bavel, dat in 2026 haar 10e jubileumeditie viert. Het evenement biedt een gezellige en sportieve dag voor jong en oud met verschillende afstanden, waaronder een 5 km wedstrijd, een 10 km trimloop en een kidsrun. De start en finish zijn centraal gelegen in de Kloosterstraat bij Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. De 5 van Bavel zet zich ook in voor een goed doel, namelijk onderzoek naar neuro-endocriene tumoren (NET).
course_highlights: 5 km wedstrijd en 10 km trimloop met meerdere rondes door het dorp
Kidsrun van circa 500 meter met start en finish in de Kloosterstraat
Start en finish bij Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel in de Kloosterstraat
additional: Na-inschrijving en ophalen startnummers vanaf 13:00 uur op de wedstrijddag bij ’t Klooster. De Berenboot kidsrun start om 16:00 uur, gevolgd door de 5 km wedstrijd om 16:15 uur en de 10 km trimloop om 17:00 uur. Prijsuitreiking voor de nummers 1, 2 en 3 van elke run vindt aansluitend plaats. Hardloopwedstrijd met verschillende onderdelen, inclusief vrijwilligers en verkeersregelaars; onderdeel van Bavelse kermis; inschrijving via website en ter plaatse.

name: Run for Hope
location: Dordrecht Biesbosch, Dordrecht, South Holland, Netherlands
description: Run for Hope is een inspirerende hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op 26 september 2026 in de Dordtse Biesbosch. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 5, 10 of 21,1 kilometer en lopen om geld in te zamelen voor cliënten van De Hoop, die ondersteuning krijgen bij het opbouwen van een nieuw leven. De run staat in het teken van hoop en saamhorigheid, waarbij lopers worden aangemoedigd door supporters en samen een bijdrage leveren aan een maatschappelijk doel. Het evenement combineert sportiviteit met een betekenisvolle inzet voor anderen.
course_highlights: Lopen door de natuurrijke omgeving van de Dordtse Biesbosch
Keuze uit drie afstanden: 5, 10 en 21,1 kilometer
Een run met een maatschappelijk doel en veel support langs het parcours
additional: De opbrengst van de run wordt gebruikt om cliënten van De Hoop te ondersteunen bij het terugkeren in de maatschappij. Het doel is om samen 75.000 euro in te zamelen. De organisatie benadrukt het belang van saamhorigheid en het ervaren van voldoening tijdens de run. Distances of 5, 10, and 21.1 km; charity fundraising; scenic run through Dordrecht Biesbosch.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
location: s-Graveland, Gooise Meren, North Holland, Netherlands
description: De Spanderswoud Trailrun is een ontspannen trailrun door het prachtige Spanderswoud en omliggende natuurgebieden in het Gooi. De routes van 10, 20 en 30 km voeren je over kronkelende bospaden, singletracks en open heidevelden, zonder wedstrijdelement of tijdsdruk. De start en finish zijn bij het bezoekerscentrum van Natuurmonumenten op Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. Er zijn verzorgingsposten onderweg en na afloop kun je genieten van een hapje en drankje bij Café-Restaurant Brambergen.
course_highlights: Volledig uitgepijlde routes van 10 en 20 km, 30 km deels via GPX
Afwisselend terrein met singletracks, bospaden en heidevelden
Start en finish bij het bezoekerscentrum van Natuurmonumenten op Landgoed Boekesteyn
additional: Startmomenten voor 10 en 20 km zijn tussen 09:00 en 11:30 in vijf tijdsblokken, deelnemers kiezen zelf hun startmoment. Er zijn twee verzorgingsposten (ongeveer op 5 km en bij finish; lange afstanden hebben een extra post). Er is EHBO aanwezig bij start/finish. De 30 km route vereist ervaring met GPX-navigatie. Er is geen tijdregistratie en geen bekers bij verzorgingsposten; deelnemers wordt aangeraden een eigen beker mee te nemen of een EpicTrails softcup te bestellen. Parkeren is mogelijk, carpoolen wordt aanbevolen. Een deel van het inschrijfgeld gaat naar natuurorganisaties. Trailroutes volgen bospaden, zandstroken en smalle trails; geen wedstrijdelement; startmomenten tijdens inschrijving; GPX-gegevens voor lange afstand; finisher medaille; geen bekers, eigen beker of softcup aanbevolen.

name: Crob Run
description: De Crob Run is een hardloopevenement in Haaften dat plaatsvindt op 26 september 2026. Het biedt een prachtige loop over de dijken rondom Haaften en de natuur langs de Waal, geschikt voor jong en oud. Er zijn verschillende afstanden, waaronder kidsruns voor kinderen van 5 tot 12 jaar, en 5 km en 10 km voor volwassenen. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn gezellige sfeer met muziek, eetgelegenheden en een bar, en een deel van de opbrengst gaat naar een goed doel.
course_highlights: Loop over de dijken rondom Haaften
Prachtige natuur langs de Waal
Gezellige sfeer met DJ, eetgelegenheid en terras
additional: Kidsruns starten tussen 14:00 en 14:30 uur, 5 km en 10 km starten gezamenlijk om 15:30 uur. Er is een verzorgingspost met water op de 5 en 10 km route en fruit en extra water bij de finish. Er zijn kleedruimtes voor heren en dames. Het evenementterrein is open tot 18:00 uur met een DJ, eetgelegenheid, bar en terras. Er is EHBO aanwezig in het gebouw van de Burcht van Haeften. Er is geen uiterlijke inschrijfdatum, maar vol=vol. Er is een tijdslimiet van 1 uur en 30 minuten voor de 5 en 10 km. Parkeren is gratis rondom de Burcht van Haeften, fietsen en carpoolen worden aanbevolen. Deelnemers kunnen genieten van een feestelijke ambiance met muziek, foodtrucks en een medaille die verwijst naar de molen en de blauwe reiger in Haaften. Het evenement ondersteunt goede doelen zoals ROPA run en is rolstoeltoegankelijk met aangepast sanitair.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
location: Landgoed Gulbergen, Nuenen, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Hill Repeat Madness is een uitdagende 4-uurs trailrunchallenge die plaatsvindt op Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. Deze trailrun daagt lopers uit om hun uithoudingsvermogen en snelheid te testen op een gevarieerd parcours in een natuurlijke omgeving. De organisatie wordt verzorgd door Trailrunners Brabant, die bekend staan om hun passie voor trailrunning en het creëren van een sportieve en gezellige sfeer. De race is ideaal voor trailrunners die houden van een intensieve en dynamische loopervaring.
course_highlights: Trailrun op Landgoed Gulbergen met natuurlijke omgeving
4-uurs challenge met focus op uithoudingsvermogen en snelheid
Gevarieerd parcours geschikt voor trailrunning
additional: Deelnemers kunnen zich registreren via WeTicket. Het evenement vindt plaats op 't Dak van Brabant in Nuenen, met een route van ongeveer 2,5 km per ronde, inclusief hoogteverschillen. Er zijn geen faciliteiten voor douchen of omkleden, en vrijwilligers kunnen zich aanmelden voor ondersteuning.

name: BEAT Running Festival
description: Het BEAT Running Festival op 26 september 2026 in het Amsterdamse Bos is een uniek knock-out hardloopevenement waarbij deelnemers steeds 1 km ronden lopen met een oplopend tempo. De race draait om het bijhouden van een officiële pacer; wie achterblijft valt af, totdat er één man en één vrouw overblijven. Naast de spannende race is er een festival met food, drinks, challenges en een community zone, waardoor het evenement meer is dan alleen een hardloopwedstrijd. De winnaars ontvangen een sportreis ter waarde van €2.000.
course_highlights: 1 km ronden met oplopend tempo per ronde
Tempo wordt bepaald door een officiële pacer
Knock-out format tot één man en één vrouw overblijven
additional: De race start met een tempo van 6:30 min/km en versnelt elke ronde met 15 seconden per km tot een minimumtempo van 3:30 min/km. Na elke ronde is er een korte rustzone waar lopers wachten tot de pacer opnieuw vertrekt. Deelnemers die uitgeschakeld zijn blijven onderdeel van het festival als supporters. Er is een Challenge Zone en Community Zone met activiteiten, merchandise en activaties. Knock-out race met 1 km rondes, stijgend tempo, festivalbeleving, food & drinks, challenge en community zones, locatie in Amsterdamse Bos

name: Mission Run
description: De MissionRun 2026 vindt plaats op zaterdag 26 september in Scherpenzeel en biedt hardloop- en wandelroutes van 5, 10 en 20 km, inclusief een halve marathon voor deelnemers van 18 jaar en ouder. Het parcours voert door het natuurrijke buitengebied van Scherpenzeel, over bospaden en rustige landweggetjes, en is geschikt voor zowel ervaren hardlopers als recreanten en wandelaars. De opbrengst van het evenement gaat volledig naar International Justice Mission, ter ondersteuning van de Muskathlon van Anne & Dianne. De start en finish zijn bij Oud Willaer 74, met tijdregistratie via MyLaps voor de hardloopafstanden.
course_highlights: Natuurrijk buitengebied van Scherpenzeel met bospaden en landweggetjes
Afwisselend parcours op de grens van de Gelderse Vallei en de Veluwe
Routes van 5 km (1 ronde), 10 km (2 rondes) en halve marathon (4 rondes)
additional: Tijdregistratie bij het hardlopen via MyLaps. Startnummers ophalen vanaf 09:30. Wandelen kan op de dag zelf nog worden aangemeld. De 10 km route bestaat uit 2 rondes, de halve marathon uit 4 rondes van hetzelfde parcours. De halve marathon is alleen toegankelijk voor deelnemers van 18 jaar en ouder. Parkeren kan op De Breelaan 6, 3925 HX Scherpenzeel. Terrain: stadsparcours, registratie via MyLaps, inschrijving tot 24 september voor hardlopen, op de dag zelf voor wandelen.

name: Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijving geopend tot en met zaterdag 12 september

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijving geopend tot en met zaterdag 12 september

description: De Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning vindt plaats in de bosrijke en heuvelachtige omgeving rondom Nijmegen. De trail biedt uitdagende routes met steile beklimmingen, lastige afdalingen en onverharde paden door natuurgebieden zoals de Nijmeegse heuvelrug en Landgoed van Jurgens. Het NK Trailrunning bestaat uit een korte trail van 28 kilometer en een lange trail van 56 kilometer, waarbij atleten met een Atletiekunie licentie strijden om de Nederlandse titel. De organisatie zorgt voor een sfeervol evenement met verzorgingsposten en een professionele aanpak.
course_highlights: Heuvelachtige bossen rondom Nijmegen met steile beklimmingen en lastige afdalingen
Onverharde, smalle paadjes door natuurgebieden zoals de Nijmeegse stuwwal en Landgoed van Jurgens
Routes variërend van 7 tot 56 kilometer met tot meer dan 1000 hoogtemeters op de langste afstand
additional: Start NK Lange Trail 56 km om 09:00 uur, start NK Korte Trail 28 km om 12:30 uur. Drankvoorziening onderweg zonder beperkingen, met water, Maurten sportdrank en voeding. Startwaves met gefaseerde start, startvak opent 5 minuten voor start, startnummer met wave-indicatie. Mogelijkheid tot startnummeroverdracht tot 25 september 18:00 uur. Verzorgingsposten met diverse snacks en Maurten gels/repen op langere afstanden. Inschrijving tot 12 september 2026; deelname vereist een licentie of daglicentie van de Atletiekunie of hardlopen.nl.

name: BergermeerRun 2026
description: De BergermeerRun 2026 is een sportief en gezellig evenement in de wijk Alkmaar, geschikt voor jong en oud. Of je nu snel wilt lopen of gewoon mee wilt doen, iedereen is welkom om samen met vrienden en familie de finish te bereiken. Langs het parcours zorgen supporters, muziek en vrijwilligers voor een energieke sfeer. Het evenement ondersteunt dit jaar Stichting Leergeld Alkmaar en biedt een veilige loopervaring met goed bewaakte routes en EHBO-posten.
course_highlights: Veilig parcours met duidelijke route-aanduidingen
Ondersteuning door supporters, muziek en vrijwilligers langs het parcours
Maximaal 500 deelnemers voor een intieme en gezellige sfeer
additional: Tickets zijn ook te koop op het veld voor aanvang van het event met een toeslag van €2,50 per ticket. Er is plek voor maximaal 500 deelnemers. Het evenement vindt plaats op Burendag en stimuleert buurtactiviteiten en saamhorigheid. Race in Alkmaar met categorieën voor kids en volwassenen, inschrijving sluit op 25 september 2026, ter plaatse registratie mogelijk.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: De Roldertorenrun is een hardloopevenement in en rond Rolde met drie afstanden: halve marathon, 10 km en 5 km. De halve marathon voert je door het prachtige Drentse landschap met heidevelden, grafheuvels, beekjes en oude karrensporen, en eindigt bij de Jacobuskerk. De 10 km is geschikt voor geoefende lopers en loopt deels over het Balloërveld en het Wandelspoor. De 5 km is een snelle, volledig verharde route met uitzicht op het Balloërveld en een single track terug naar de finish bij de toren. De start en finish zijn bij de Roldertoren.
course_highlights: Route over het Balloërveld met paarse heidevelden en grafheuvels
Afwisselend verhard en onverhard terrein met single tracks en oude karrensporen
Uitzicht op de Roldertoren en finish bij de Jacobuskerk
additional: Startnummer wordt opgestuurd. Deelname is op eigen risico. Start en finish bij de Roldertoren. Annulering mogelijk met restitutie minus administratiekosten tot 1 maand voor het evenement. Geen huisdieren of buggy's toegestaan tijdens de wedstrijd. De inschrijving voor de race is gesloten; deelnemers ontvangen hun startnummer per post. Het evenement benadrukt de beleving en natuurlijke schoonheid van de omgeving.

name: Schoklandloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 7,50, dit is inclusief een aandenken aan de Schoklandloop, tijdsregistratie en een consumptie bij Restaurant Schokland

description: De Schoklandloop is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door AV NOP in samenwerking met Het Flevo-landschap en Museum Schokland. De loop vindt plaats op het prachtige Werelderfgoed Schokland en combineert natuur, cultuur en sport op een uitdagend parcours. De 10 km route voert over het hele eiland Schokland, terwijl de 5 km route over het Zuidereiland gaat. Start en finish zijn op Middelbuurt 2 te Schokland. Deelnemers ontvangen een aandenken, tijdsregistratie en een consumptie bij Restaurant Schokland.
course_highlights: 10 km route over het hele eiland Schokland
5 km route over het Zuidereiland via de beheerschuur van Het Flevo-landschap
Start en finish op Middelbuurt 2 te Schokland
additional: Inschrijfgeld is inclusief een aandenken, tijdsregistratie en consumptie bij Restaurant Schokland. De 10 km route is een nieuwe grote ronde over het hele eiland. De start en finish zijn op Middelbuurt 2 te Schokland. De 10 km route gaat over het hele eiland Schokland; de 5 km route voert via het Zuidereiland; start en finish bevinden zich op Middelbuurt 2.

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
location: Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken, Ooij, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: De Gelderse Poort Ultra is een uitdagende trail van 50 kilometer die de Dutch Ultra Series waardig afsluit. De route voert door de prachtige uiterwaarden rond Nijmegen, de bossen richting Berg en Dal en de karakteristieke landerijen ertussen. Met tussen de 700 en 1000 hoogtemeters, technische paden en een afwisselend landschap van klompenpaden, heide en bossen, biedt deze ultra een bijzondere natuurbelevenis. De start is bij Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, waar deelnemers na afloop kunnen genieten van een smaakvol diner en eventueel kunnen overnachten.
course_highlights: Route door uiterwaarden rond Nijmegen en bossen richting Berg en Dal
Tussen 700 en 1000 hoogtemeters met veel heuvels
Technische paden, klompenpaden, heide en boslandschap
additional: Startlocatie is Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, waar na afloop een à la carte restaurant en overnachtingsmogelijkheden zijn. Deelnemers navigeren met een GPX-bestand via eigen horloge of telefoon. Er zijn 3 à 4 verzorgingsposten op de route, maar er zijn geen bekers beschikbaar, dus eigen racecup of flasks meenemen. Tijdslimiet is 8 uur, finish voor 17:00 uur. Startnummer ophalen kan vanaf 08:30 bij het wedstrijdsecretariaat. Startlocatie bij Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, met opties voor overnachting en diner. Route met 700-1000 hoogtemeters, technische paden, en een tijdslimiet van 8 uur voor de 50 km afstand.

name: Groot Boeschoten Trail
distance_verbose: 35 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km
description: De Groot Boeschoten Trail vindt plaats op zaterdag 26 september 2026 in Voorthuizen, met start en finish bij Camping De Zanderij. De routes zijn volledig vernieuwd en bieden een afwisselend parcours over de Veluwe met bos, heide, zandwegen en historische landgoederen. Het parcours voert langs open heidevelden, akkers en bossen richting Speuld, Huinen en Garderen, met historische schaapskooien als herkenningspunt en verzorgingspost. De routes zijn circa 99% offroad en worden duidelijk gemarkeerd, met luxe verzorgingsposten onderweg. Voor de kinderen is er een speciale Kids Trail met medaille en toegang tot het zwembad.
course_highlights: Volledig vernieuwde routes met afwisseling tussen bos, heide, zandwegen en landgoederen
Parcours langs historische schaapskooien van Groot- en Klein Boeschoten
Circa 99% offroad met duidelijke markering en luxe verzorgingsposten
additional: Luxe verzorgingsposten met water, sportdrank, snacks en vers fruit. Kids Trail deelnemers krijgen medaille, versnapering en toegang tot zwembad Camping De Zanderij. Prijzen voor snelste mannen en vrouwen op 13, 23 en 35 km; geen prijzen op 6 km en Walks. Wijziging naar kortere afstand mogelijk tot 1 juli, kosteloos overdragen startnummer tot 30 juni, annuleren niet mogelijk. Kids Trail met medaille en zwembadtoegang, mogelijkheid tot wijziging van afstand tot 1 juli, gratis overname van startnummer tot 30 juni, geen annuleringen mogelijk

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place on 19 September 2026 at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and making a statement for integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, children’s activities and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on fun and community. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children’s activities, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering distances for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural scenery. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, eligible for rankings
Water stations every 2.5 km
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race packets can be collected at the sports center from 13:00 on race day. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races will receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races will receive a medal. Nordic walking is untimed, with no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-bib collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. The courses are officially measured. Online registration is open until 24.09.2026; late registration is available on site for a fee. Race packets can be collected from 13:00 on race day. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim Volkslauf is a long-standing running event taking place on September 26, 2026, at Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. It is organized by Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to enjoy sport and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking events
Venue at Sportpark Hofheim with a flat course
additional: Registration is by submitting a form downloaded as a Word document. Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon are the contacts for questions; their telephone numbers and email addresses are provided. The website has a contact form for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children’s and youth events. Start times are 15:15 and 15:30. Further details, registration, and the race information are available on the website.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural paths. The course passes numerous sights, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person relay categories, making it ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reformschule gym, and a bag transport service to the finish is provided.
course_highlights: The course runs almost entirely on paved natural paths through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
Passes well-known sights such as Löwenburg, Steinhöfer Waterfall and the Hercules Monument
Relay race with three legs and handovers at notable points
additional: Bag transport to the finish is available from 10 a.m. in the start area. Participants make their own way back to the start on foot or by bus route 22. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym. Relay results are based on the combined times of the three individual legs; there are no age-group categories for relays. The course runs on paved natural paths and asphalt. Registration is online via RaceResult. The start and finish are in Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel. Wooden medals are awarded; T-shirts can be ordered. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf

late_fee.price: Nachmeldung möglich am Veranstaltungstag bis 30 Minuten vor Start

description: The Rodheim Fun Run is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the main playing field, creating an appealing stadium atmosphere for sports enthusiasts. The event offers a range of competitions, from a children’s race to a half marathon and 10 km race, suitable for children, fitness enthusiasts, and ambitious runners alike. The awards ceremony is lively, and the event attracts a good turnout.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the main playing field, with a stadium atmosphere
A variety of distances, from the 0.15 km children’s race to the half marathon and 10 km race
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup, with scoring races for various age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start. The event includes scoring races in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open at specific times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Scenic run, family event, inclusive options, various race distances, on-site registration

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze relay race has been held in Weeze in mid-September each year since 1985 and has become a popular relay event, with up to 250 teams taking part. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school, and regular relays, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail
Relay event with Bambini, school, and regular relay categories
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: The 40th Weeze relay race will take place on 26 September 2026. The race announcement and registration will follow at the end of July. The event has attracted up to 250 relay teams. The 38th Weeze relay race in 2024 had 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 regular relay teams cross the finish line. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly Backyard Ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course restarts on the hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or want to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course is mostly on forest and farm tracks, with no significant climbs, and results are recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop on forest and farm tracks
Starts on the hour; run for as long as you can or want to
Results recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km
additional: The race is a private invitation-only event with no public registration and a maximum of 70 participants. Water, sports drink, cola, fruit, and cake are available in the start/finish area, and participants are asked to contribute items themselves. No mandatory equipment is required, but a headlamp and phone are recommended. Parking, toilets, and showers are available at the SV Pechau sports ground. The race includes several categories, including 50 km, 100 km, and 100 miles, with the fastest person in each category winning. It is not a public event, but a private invitation event with modified Backyard Ultra rules.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. The event offers courses for all ability levels, from a children’s run for the youngest participants to a half marathon that passes through the impressive 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal bests. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup, and also hosts the Thuringian State Road Running Championships.
course_highlights: Half marathon through the 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel
Flat, low-turnaround courses with only 2 to 50 meters of elevation gain
Courses measured to DLV/IAAF standards
additional: Start and finish on the fully paved Kanonenbahn cycle path near Bahnhofsallee in Dingelstädt. Changing rooms, registration and the awards ceremony are in the primary school sports hall. Bib pickup from 8:00 a.m. Age-group awards according to DLV standards. The 1 km race is limited to 50 starters, with a referee-led start lineup. Net timing; placings determined by gun time. The courses are flat and fast, including tunnel sections; registration in the primary school sports hall; start and finish on the Kanonenbahn cycle path; refreshments along the course and at the finish; age-group awards; part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the Thuringian State Championships.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ilshofen. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied course through the town. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the town, making the event interesting for both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.
course_highlights: Varied course through the town of Ilshofen
Well-marked course
Attractive sections for runners and spectators
additional: The event offers GPS-based course measurement. The start and finish are at the Roland-Wurmthaler-Halle, where registration also takes place. The event is held annually and has been established for more than thirty years.

description: The 49th Ötigheim Autumn Run on September 26, 2026, warmly welcomes running enthusiasts of all ability levels. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, the emphasis is on enjoying exercise. Events include children’s and schoolchildren’s races, as well as main races over 5 km and 10 km, which are officially measured. The 10 km course covers two laps through Ötigheim Forest and promises a beautiful autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
The 10 km course runs through Ötigheim Forest
Two laps on the 10 km course
additional: There are no entry fees for any of the races; these are covered by Reinhard Hofmann, a former TGÖ track and field athlete from Baden-Baden. Register online by 06.09.2026 to receive a personalized race number. The 5 km and 10 km races both start at 14:45. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races, 5 km and 10 km main races, no entry fees, personalized race number for online registration by 06.09.2026, laps through Ötigheim Forest, weather in September usually cloudy

description: The Benin Charity Run is a scenic running event in Hirzweiler, taking place for the 19th time on September 26, 2026. The course offers panoramic views across the Ill Valley and runs mostly along paved farm roads. The event supports aid projects in Benin, with the proceeds and entry fees going to AG Benin. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a generous cake buffet, grilled sausages and drinks at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler, followed by the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Panoramic views across the entire Ill Valley
Mostly paved farm road
Start and finish at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler
additional: On-site late registration is available with no late-registration fee. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, alongside the Illinger City Run and the Friendship Run. There are no age-group categories in the children's races, and races not included in the rankings are not timed. The awards ceremony takes place at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. Grilled sausages, a cake buffet and drinks are available. The race usually takes place in October, with refreshments at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. Some races have no age-group categories, and no times were recorded at the first events. The event is a community initiative that combines a sporting challenge with social support.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on various courses of up to 24 km with up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and yourself, starting on the Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.2 km with 550 meters of elevation gain on the Brockenstraße
Longer course: 24 km with 900 meters of elevation gain to the Brocken plateau
A range of disciplines: road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking
additional: Race packs can be collected on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00. Electronic timing, medical support, drinks, and refreshments at the finish are included. The event offers views from the Brocken plateau across to several distant cities and landmarks. After the race, there is a recovery walk to cheer on the participants starting later. Participants under 15 require parental permission to take part, and parental supervision is required. Mountain individual time trial, running, roller skiing, Nordic walking, e-bikes permitted for road races, various course distances, age categories, online registration

name: Böckstiegellauf
price_range: 18,00 EUR bis 29,00 EUR (je nach Strecke und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, starting at Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld and finishing in Werther town centre. Routes of 18 km and 10 km are offered, along with a 2.5 km student race. Part of the course follows the Hermannslauf route and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organised, with a bus shuttle from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the centre of Werther.
course_highlights: A route through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills
The course passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum
Starts at Peter auf’m Berge and finishes in the centre of Werther
additional: The start is at Peter auf’m Berge and the finish is at Venghauss-Platz in Werther. Buses to the start leave from Werther bus station from 12:00. Late entries are possible at Venghauss-Platz on the event day from 11:00 to 13:00, subject to remaining places. Most of the course is in good condition; the section at the 18/10 km route split at kilometre 3.7 is very gravelly. The routes pass through nature and the town. Registration is already open, with bus transport to the start. There is no parking at the start, and late entries are subject to availability.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend of September. The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and supervised by the NLV Cloppenburg district association.
course_highlights: The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square
The course runs along Eschstraße and finishes at Rathausplatz
The relay features laps of approximately 1,000 metres, completed four times
additional: Relay teams receive a 50% discount on the entry fee if all four runners also take part in the main race. All events except the main race start and finish at Rathausplatz. The event is supported by local sponsors and takes place as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival. Events for various age groups, start times, course distances, registration not yet open

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
location: Mettingen, Tecklenburger Land, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on 26 September 2026 and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The main 14.1 km race features challenging, undulating terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly invited to take part in an 800 m junior race and a 400 m Bambini race, with fun taking priority for the youngest participants. The event is family-friendly and offers one-time-chip timing, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal
14.1 km main race over undulating terrain, with views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg
8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes
additional: Timing is provided by a Runtiming one-time chip, integrated into the race number and included in the entry fee. The finish closes at 16:30; participants finishing after that time will not be recorded. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall at Ludgeri-Schule. The three fastest women and men in the main and 2-Täler-Lauf races, as well as the three fastest boys and girls in the junior race, receive awards. Personal race certificates showing finishing times can be downloaded free of charge from the Runtiming website. Results are linked online at www.tvmettingen.de. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The route passes through the valleys of the Tecklenburger Land and has challenging terrain. Children’s races and parking are available; online registration is possible.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlach Turmberg Run is a flat, fast 10-kilometer race through the historic old town of Durlach, along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back. The race has become a regular fixture for running enthusiasts from the region and offers an attractive course for ambitious runners. A children’s race also takes place in the Durlach Palace Gardens. The event combines sporting competition with social engagement by collecting donations for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10-kilometer race through Durlach’s old town
Course along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back
Children’s race in the Durlach Palace Gardens
additional: Annual fundraising as part of the race in support of social projects. Opportunity to join the Africa Runners team and run for a good cause in the team shirt. Race on September 26, 2026, sponsors from the region, fundraising activities for charitable causes, terms and conditions and registration on the official website

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a long-standing running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on 26 September 2026. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an appealing route through the region’s scenic landscape. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and combines a sporting challenge with scenic highlights. It is organised by Stadtmarketing Bad Friedrichshall, which is also known for other tourism services in the region.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque landscape of Bad Friedrichshall
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup, with varied terrain
Combines a nature experience with a sporting challenge
additional: Distances: 400 m, 10 km; registration and results via my.race|result; listed in the laufen.de running calendar.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied courses for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town centre, while the main race follows the picturesque Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from mini races to a relay, means there is something for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Niederstetten Town Hall
Main race along the Vorbach Valley
Views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: Mini races C and B are untimed. Awards are given for the school and youth races, fun run, relay and main race. The Autumn Festival Run is part of the Laufgemeinschaft Tauberfranken, which organizes several regional running events with scoring for the Tauberfranken Cup. The event includes main, mini, school and youth races, as well as relays, on routes through the beautiful region around Niederstetten. It promotes running in the region and offers attractive prizes for participants.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event held annually since 2002 on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied supporting programme featuring games, a food area and entertainment. It promotes community spirit and enjoyment of physical activity, and welcomes individual participants, school classes, teams and companies.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km
Bambini runs of approximately 500 m for preschool and first-grade children
Refreshments along the 10 km course and fruit in the finish area
additional: Registration is available directly at the event venue from 11:30 a.m. on race day. Late registration for children and teenagers costs €8.00 and is available until 45 minutes before the race starts. Awards ceremonies for places 1–3 overall and in the age categories take place at 2:15 p.m., 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. On the Friday before the race, the programme celebrating the potato begins with the coronation festivities for the Pellkartoffelkönigin and an after-show party with free admission. Various distances, Bambini runs, supporting programme, awards ceremonies, prize draws, after-show party, registration from 11:30 a.m. on race day

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht gelistet)
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course runs across the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. The event features an exciting start show, a unique atmosphere and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Montgolfiadengelände
Course runs across the ski slope and through the quarry
Spectacular obstacles featuring mud, water slides and foam
additional: Participants start in several waves (Überflieger, Senkrechtstarter, Dauerbrenner, Spätzünder) for different ability levels. Discounted group rates are available for groups of 6 or more, with discounts of up to 20%. Optional extras include a finisher shirt, timing, a bandana and a photo package. Participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Terrain includes a ski slope, quarry, water and foam elements; registration with group discounts; various distances and a Family Edition; entertainment with bands and DJs.

description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a varied running event with routes for all age groups and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which passes through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and para-athlete routes, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event is known for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, and is supported by the city of Gera.
course_highlights: 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain
Routes through Gera’s city forest and Hofwiesenpark
Refreshment stations at 6, 11 and 17 km, as well as at the finish
additional: Late registration is available on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of EUR 5. The award ceremonies begin at 12:15, with trophies for the winners of the 22 km, 12 km and 5 km races. The parent-child run is a fun event, with medals and certificates for all children. Live music and a song composed especially for the Höhlerfest create a special atmosphere. Various running routes, including an obstacle run and a parent-child run; live music; an obstacle run for participants with disabilities; running routes through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Waldlauf (Kreis Ludwigsburg)
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Kreis Ludwigsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race in the beautiful Hochdorf Forest, taking place for the sixth time in 2026. The event offers exciting courses and an unforgettable sporting experience for runners of all ages. The SGV Hochdorf organising team is also preparing fresh forest-run shirts and informative flyers to support participants. The race takes place on 26 September 2026 and warmly welcomes everyone who loves sport.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest
New, exciting courses
Family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Weekly training sessions take place on Fridays at 18:30 in front of the forest entrance to prepare for the race. Forest-run shirts are available. The registration portal opens in mid-May. Forest run in the Hochdorf Forest; registration and further information on the website. Categories for children, juniors, adults and masters.
