description: De Broekstaclerun is een uitdagend en gezellig obstacle run evenement in Broekland, met een unieke mix van hardlopen, modder en hindernissen. De run heeft een kneuterig karakter met een afwisselend parcours door de natuur, waarbij afzien en plezier hand in hand gaan. Het evenement is laagdrempelig en duurzaam georganiseerd, geschikt voor deelnemers van verschillende leeftijden en niveaus. De sfeer is altijd feestelijk en de run wordt ondersteund door enthousiaste vrijwilligers en lokale grondeigenaren.
course_highlights: Natuurobstakels en modderige hindernissen
Afwisselend parcours door de Broeklandse bossen
Drie afstanden: 3,5 km (voor kinderen), 5 km en 10 km
additional: Kinderen t/m 7 jaar moeten begeleid worden door een volwassene die zich ook inschrijft. Samen lopen kan met een groepsnaam om in dezelfde startgroep te starten. Shirts kunnen bij inschrijving besteld worden tot 6 september. Overdracht van inschrijving is mogelijk tot 1 week voor het evenement. Race omvat modder, obstakels en een parcours door Broekland; inschrijving open voor meerdere afstanden

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: 7-MEILEN-TRAIL
description: The 7-Mile Trail in Kaiserslautern offers two challenging courses: a short 4-mile course for running and Nordic walking, and a long 7-mile course for runners only. The routes pass through varied terrain with a high proportion of singletrack and are completely unpaved. The start and finish are opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. The event is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a scenic, challenging route.
course_highlights: 4-mile course: approx. 6.4 km with 130 m of elevation gain
7-mile course: approx. 11.3 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Courses are 40–60% singletrack and completely unpaved
additional: Start and finish opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. Aid stations: 4-mile course, once in the finish area; 7-mile course, twice (after 6 km at the TSG fountain and in the finish area). The long course is for runners only; the short course is also open to Nordic walkers. Trail running, event date: 2026-09-27, location: Kaiserslautern, course distance approx. 11 km, elevation gain approx. 340 m

name: Altkönig-Lauf
price_range: 10 km 16,00 Euro, Halbmarathon 18,00 Euro, Schülerläufe 5,00 Euro, Walking 14,00 Euro
description: The Altkönig Run, organized by MTV Kronberg, is a traditional public race approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), taking place on September 27, 2026. Events include a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km races, children’s races, a toddlers’ race, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic Taunus landscape, with around 350 metres of elevation gain in the half marathon. The race is part of the Taunus Running Challenge and offers every finisher a medal, as well as trophies and cash prizes for the top runners. The start and finish are at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg
Part of the Taunus Running Challenge, which has three scoring races
additional: Every finisher receives a medal. The 10 km walking and Nordic walking events start at 9:40 a.m. and are not timed. Children’s races start from 12:00 p.m., with distances of 350 m and 1,000 m. There is a refreshment station on the course. Participants are asked to bring reusable cups or their own mugs to help protect the environment. The awards ceremony is planned for around 1:00 p.m., with finisher trophies for all participants who are present and cash prizes for the top runners. The courses run along forest paths through the Taunus. Elevation gain: 150 m for 10 km and 350 m for the half marathon. Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg. Registration is available online and on race day. Environmentally conscious behaviour is encouraged at the refreshment station.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a traditional race on September 27, 2026, offering runners of all ability levels varied routes through the scenic Kraichgau countryside. From the short 5 km course and the popular 10 km race to the challenging half marathon and demanding 42.2 km hill marathon, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through natural surroundings and offer stunning views, including of the landmark Steinsberg Castle. The event is ideal for anyone looking to combine endurance, nature, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hill marathon with varied elevation profiles and stunning views
10 km course featuring paved roads, surfaced farm tracks, and idyllic woodland sections
5 km course with panoramic views of Kraichgaublick and Steinsberg Castle
additional: Race-bib distribution until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers at Kreuzgrundhalle and at the sports grounds. Parking available around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage in the start/finish area (Rohrbach Primary School). Refreshments including drinks, fruit, and snacks at several stations, depending on the course. Medal for all finishers. Timing with a disposable timing chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability. Limited to 1000 participants. Various distances; registration opens April 15, 2026; focus on nature and experience.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Serie
description: The 39th edition of the Cochem Zeller Cross-Country Series takes place on 27 September 2026 in Ulmen, Germany. The event offers two distances, 400 metres and 8 kilometres, on courses that are often suitable for record times. As part of the solidarity system in sport and running culture, Laufen.de members benefit from reduced entry fees. The race is known for its varied cross-country courses in the Eifel region.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses suitable for record times
Distances: 400 m and 8 km
Scenic surroundings in Ulmen, Eifel
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, 45 mm average precipitation, mostly cloudy. September weather around 19°C, cloudy; several venues in the region; certificates and trophies for winners

name: GVG Citylauf Erftstadt
description: The GVG Citylauf Erftstadt is the region’s largest running event and takes place every September. It offers a special atmosphere for everyone who loves running, from children and recreational runners to elite athletes. The 10 km main race takes runners four times through the medieval old town and Lechenich Castle Park, with numerous spectators lining the route. Shorter races for schoolchildren, families, and companies are also available; they start and finish at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with four laps through the medieval old town and the castle park
Loop course starting and finishing at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich
Officially measured, fast course with few turns
additional: The 10 km main race is also available as a relay. All finishers in the 5 km, 10 km, or relay races are entered into a draw to win a hot-air balloon ride for two. The course is designed so that runners pass the market square several times and can be cheered on by spectators. The youngest runners have a 750 m loop; schoolchildren run 2.5 km, and the family and company race is 5 km (2 laps). The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and follows its guidelines. Running event in the medieval old town and castle park, open to all ages and ability levels, including Laufcup 2026

name: 23. Vinnhorster Volkslauf
description: The 23rd Vinnhorster Volkslauf in Hannover offers flat routes along the canal and through the forest, ideal for personal bests. The race is open to everyone, including walkers and people with mobility impairments. Families can enjoy a baby-jogger run and a varied program of activities, including a bouncy castle, face painting, and a photo booth. A special tradition is honoring the 19th and 56th finishers, commemorating the founding of TuS Vinnhorst in 1956. The Volkslauf is an event for all ages and running levels.
course_highlights: Flat route along the canal
Forest sections
Family-friendly activities, including a bouncy castle and face painting
additional: The race includes distances of 1.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. Walkers and people with mobility impairments are welcome. There is a baby-jogger run for families. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of 10 °C; it is usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Flat course, family-friendly activities, special prizes for certain finishers

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on September 27, 2026, in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive route through nature along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from a half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as introductory runs for children. The route is notable for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburger Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical support.
course_highlights: Natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster
A few small climbs and stairs along the route
Out-and-back courses for the 10 km, 4 km and introductory runs, with the start and finish in the same place
additional: First-aid vehicle and German Red Cross (DRK) support service on the route. Showers and changing rooms in the sports hall on the school grounds. Supervised baggage drop in the gymnasium. Finish-line refreshments include drinks and fruit. Photos and certificates available online. Late entries possible until 27.09. for an additional fee. The event takes place at the grounds of Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Sportplatz Struckholt, Wellingsbütteler Landstr. 43 a, 22337 Hamburg. Run in the Alstertal, registration possible by email, results on DAVENGO, part of Laufcup Hamburg.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahmegebühr für den BMW BERLIN-MARATHON 2025 beträgt 205€.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrierung für den GENERALI 5K ist vom 27. November 2025 bis 25. September 2026 geöffnet.

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most prestigious marathon events and part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and a variety of ways to participate through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.
course_highlights: The flattest course in the Abbott World Marathon Majors, with minimal elevation gain
Route past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks
15 aid stations with water and energy boosters
additional: On event day, all finishers receive a free, warm, reusable poncho. Alternatively, a bag drop with a transparent bag can be booked for a fee of 5 €. Race materials can only be collected in person at the Marathon Expo with a race card and ID. Public transport is free to use with the race card in fare zones ABC from September 24 to 27, 2026. Personal refreshments can be handed in at designated aid stations (no glass containers). Options include charity entries, travel packages, inline skating, training camps, and special race bibs for charity runners. The event is part of the World Marathon Majors series.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a traditional running event held in the town of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the town. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and features various race distances through the town.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Münsterplatz in Northeim
Urban running routes through Northeim
Event organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V.
additional: The start and finish are at Münsterplatz, Northeim. The race office is located in the Bürgersaal at Münsterplatz. Online registration for 2026 is not yet available. Results from the previous year are available online. The event offers a mix of road and trail races in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Registration is not yet available, but interested runners can look forward to September 27, 2026.

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr für ein bis zwei Runden (25 oder 50 km) beträgt 30 €.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr für ein bis vier Runden (25, 50, 75 oder 100 km) beträgt 50 €.

description: The Aindling Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march in which participants can cover up to 100 kilometres over four 25-kilometre loops. The route is unmarked and there are no road closures, requiring strong willpower and a good sense of direction. It passes through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including woodland and open countryside as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.
course_highlights: Four 25 km loops, each with a different character and elevation profile
Unmarked route with no road closures—determination is essential
Scenic, varied trails through woodland, open countryside, the Lech floodplains and small villages
additional: A relay march is available only for the 100 km distance, with four participants; there is no individual ranking. A functional T-shirt printed with the Cloverleaf March logo can be ordered optionally for €25. Online registration is open until 25 September 2026. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Event on 27 September 2026; registration deadline: 29 August 2026. Social projects are supported.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
location: Energie Erlebnis Zentrum, Aurich, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a non-profit running event supporting various charitable organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Centre in Aurich and offer events for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the main 5 km and 10 km races. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.
course_highlights: The Bambini, disability and youth runs follow the walking trail around the Energy Experience Centre East Frisia
The 5 km and 10 km main races pass through an industrial and residential area, starting and finishing at the Energy Experience Centre
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Late entries are possible on site up to 30 minutes before each event begins. The award ceremonies for the Bambini and senior races take place at 12:30, and those for the main races at 15:30. Certificates for the first three places are presented soon after each race; other certificates are available online. Races for children, young people and people with disabilities; online registration; charitable purpose; courses around the Energy Experience Centre; race times and age groups in accordance with the DLV; course map available

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a long-standing running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V., held annually on the last Sunday in September. It offers a range of events for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners, and all participants receive a certificate.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Oehrenstock
Various distances from 800 m to 16 km
Events for all age groups, including Nordic walking
additional: Late registrations are possible until 9:00 a.m. on the event day for a fee of €3.00. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners by time, and all participants receive a certificate. The event has several start times for different races, e.g. Nordic walking at 9:30 a.m., the kindergarten mile at 9:35 a.m., and various running distances from 10:00 a.m. Start times are between 9:30 and 10:10 a.m. Registration is open until 9:00 a.m. with a late registration fee; certificates and trophies are awarded to participants.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four 25-mile cloverleaf loops, run consecutively. The event prioritizes professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four separate 25-mile course sections (cloverleaf loops)
Start and finish area in Schwarme, with the sports hall serving as the event center
additional: Check-in on 25.09.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 26.09.2026 from 07:00 to 08:30. Race briefing on 26.09.2026 at 08:30. Course closes on 27.09.2026 at 15:00. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participant limit: 30 solo runners and 5 two-person relay teams. Includes timing, live tracking, a pasta party, and a substantial breakfast. Relay teams may start provided they follow the order of the cloverleaf loops (South, West, North, East). The course cannot be shortened. Course length: 162 km. Registration required. Cutoff times. Sponsors welcome. Volunteers wanted. GPX data available.

name: Kurparklauf 2026
location: Kurpark, Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Hesse, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf in Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe takes place annually and turns the Kurpark into an attractive running course. The event offers two distances: a 10 km public race for experienced runners and a 5 km fun run for anyone who prefers a shorter, more accessible course. Both races start and finish at Brunnenallee and follow a 2.5 km loop through the green Kurpark, past meadows, trees and garden paths, without crossing any heavily trafficked roads. The race is an established event and celebrates its 30th edition in 2026.
course_highlights: Run through the green Kurpark in Bad Homburg
Shared 2.5 km loop for the 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Avoids heavily trafficked roads; a nature-filled course
additional: Participants can download their certificates after the race. Registration usually opens in early August. The 2026 event is the 30th edition of the Kurparklauf. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; registration opens in early August; certificates available after the race

name: Lions - Dietzenbacher Stadtlauf 2026
description: The Lions - Dietzenbach City Run is an established running event in Hessentagspark Dietzenbach, combining physical activity with social commitment. Every year, numerous runners of all ages take part, accompanied by families and spectators. The event offers a 4 km fun run, a competition for businesses and clubs, and a 10 km main race. The city run stands for community, exercise, and responsibility for the city of Dietzenbach.
course_highlights: Run in Hessentagspark Dietzenbach
4 km fun run and 10 km main race
Competition for the trophy for businesses and clubs
additional: The city run is a charity event supporting social causes in Dietzenbach. There is a trophy competition for businesses and clubs. The event is supported by numerous volunteers and is a regular fixture in the city's events calendar. It promotes social cohesion, with team competitions for local clubs and businesses; net proceeds go to youth education and youth sports in Dietzenbach.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marne Cabbage Day Run is a traditional race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarschen Corporate Cup. The event offers various distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The routes are closed to traffic, well signposted, and marked at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, and times are professionally recorded using a chip attached to the race bib. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.
course_highlights: Routes closed to traffic and well signposted, with kilometre markers
Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
Chip timing using the race bib, with no rental fee
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the start, with a €5 late entry fee. Data changes and transfers are possible for an administrative fee of €5. The event takes place in almost any weather. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used at the Marne swimming pool. Various race distances, registration until August 2026, well-signposted routes, refreshments and changing facilities on site

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional countryside race for running and Nordic walking enthusiasts, taking place on 26 and 27 September 2026 in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The route follows forest, meadow and field paths, passing numerous carp ponds, and includes approximately 150 metres of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic walking and various youth and school races. The event offers a varied, nature-rich setting for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Countryside race along forest, meadow and field paths
Route passes many carp ponds
Approximately 150 metres of elevation gain over 21.1 km
additional: Registration until 23 September 2026. Start times from 14:30 on 26 September and until 13:00 on 27 September. Various categories, from school races (1 km to 4 km) to Nordic walking (7 km) and the half marathon (21.1 km). Minimum ages and participant limits apply to each category. Countryside race along forest, meadow and field paths, with various distances, children's races and fun runs.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Organisationsbeitrag: Kinder und Jugendliche (bis 19 Jahre) 3,- € pro Person

description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Kleinmachnow, taking place on 27 September 2026 at Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule. The event offers various races for toddlers, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults on circuits around the school and Kleinmachnow Lake. All participants receive drinks and refreshments in the finish area, as well as medals after finishing. The event is organised by the Friends’ Association of Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule and is under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.
course_highlights: Circuit around Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule in Kleinmachnow (800 m toddlers’ race)
Circuit around Kleinmachnow Lake, Karl-Marx-Straße, A.-Grimme-Ring and Schopfheimer Allee
Distances of 3.2 km, 6.4 km and 9.7 km
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until 09:30, with a late-entry fee of €2. Age-group categories are determined according to the DLV competition rules. The use of music devices during the run is prohibited. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners of the main race (9.7 km), and certificates to the top three in all age groups. A perpetual trophy is awarded to the loudest school in the TKS region. A run for children, teenagers and adults, with various distances and refreshments in the finish area. Registration closes on 23.09.2026.

name: Rheinhöhenlauf - RUN50
description: The Rheinhöhenlauf RUN50 is a three-day running event featuring three varied stages over a total of 50 kilometres and around 1,000 metres of elevation gain. The event combines a sporting challenge with a friendly, personal atmosphere, making it ideal for running enthusiasts who want to pair their sport with a short getaway. It is organised by a dedicated team from TV Linz, BBC Linz and VfB Linz. Alongside the course, the event offers an attractive programme including refreshments, luggage transport, a finisher’s medal, a technical shirt, a finger-food buffet and a ride on a historic railbus. Proceeds go to the organising clubs and the support association of Franziskus Hospital Linz.
course_highlights: 50 kilometres in total, spread across three stages
Around 1,000 metres of elevation gain in the border region of the Westerwald and Siebengebirge
Includes on-course refreshments, luggage transport and a ride on a historic railbus
additional: The entry fee includes not only the sporting challenge but also a high-quality technical shirt, a finisher’s medal, a finger-food buffet called “That’s a great start” and a ride on the historic railbus. The event is organised in a personal, friendly way, with a motivated team of volunteers and a well-rounded programme. On-course refreshments, luggage transport, finisher’s medal, technical shirt, finger-food buffet, ride on a historic railbus

name: Rund um den Kellerskopf
description: Rund um den Kellerskopf is a road-running event in Wiesbaden-Rambach, Hesse, where TuS Rambach has organized running events since 1960. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 21.1 km half marathon, as well as children’s and youth races on the same morning. The course is hilly rather than a flat city route, making it an appealing challenge for both serious runners and families. The start and finish are at the sports field on Trompeterstraße. The event combines the charm of a local club race with a variety of participation options.
course_highlights: Hilly course profile, not a flat city route
Start and finish at the sports field on Trompeterstraße
Children’s and youth races from 400 m to 2,600 m
additional: Children’s and youth races on the event morning: 400 m Bambini race, 800 m or 1,300 m for younger pupils, and 2,600 m for older pupils. The half marathon is open to juniors, men, women, age-group runners, and teams. Typical September weather in Wiesbaden: approx. 19 °C high, 10 °C low, mostly cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event is part of the regional running scene in Wiesbaden, with results and photos available online. It takes place in September and is very popular with runners of all ability levels.

name: Saaraltarmlauf
description: The Saaraltarm Run is a long-standing running event in Saarlouis, attracting runners from the region and beyond each year. The event offers a well-organized competitive atmosphere, with the start and finish in Saarlouis. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of the Saaraltarm and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive and recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization by LSG Saarlouis.
course_highlights: Run along the Saaraltarm, including sections close to nature
Start and finish in the city of Saarlouis
An appealing course for recreational and competitive runners
additional: Registration and late registration are available from 08:30. Registration is via Meisterchip. The official race announcement is available at ladv.de. The Saaraltarm Run takes place on September 27, 2026. Registration is online; the entry fee is payable when collecting the race number.

name: Sechs Stunden Urwaldlauf
description: The Six-Hour Forest Run in Saarbrücken is a unique running event where participants can run as many laps as possible within six hours on a 1.85 km loop through the forest on the outskirts of the city. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great importance on mutual respect among runners and environmental protection, supported by a sustainable refreshment plan and compensation for CO2 emissions. The start is flexible from 10:00, and the finish is at 16:00, allowing everyone to set their own pace and take breaks as they wish.
course_highlights: 1.85 km loop through the forest with 46 metres of elevation gain per lap
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
Electronic lap and placing display at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus
additional: Race bib collection from 9:00 on site. Flexible start time from 10:00; the finish closes at 16:00. Bringing your own drinking cup is recommended to reduce waste. Refreshments are available at the central station at Urwaldscheune Neuhaus, with water, isotonic drinks and runners’ food. Disposable cups are not allowed on the course. Participant numbers are limited to 350. Team scoring requires the team name to be written consistently. The organisers and helpers work on a voluntary basis. CO2 emissions are compensated. The run includes refreshments, showers, medical care and an environmentally friendly system using participants’ own drinking cups. The event emphasises sustainability and respectful treatment of nature and fellow runners.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf takes place on 27 September 2026 in Lippertshofen. The race is recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV), allowing results to be officially included in athletics best lists. Two distances are offered: a short 400-metre race and a longer 13.8-kilometre race. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete in an officially recognised event.
course_highlights: Two distances: 400 m and 13.8 km
Officially recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Starting point in Lippertshofen
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C high, 10 °C low, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and mostly cloudy. September weather: approx. 19°C, cloudy; race on woodland and forest roads; registration required; various distances; children’s and adult categories

name: Theodor-Heuss-Lauf
description: The Theodor Heuss Run is a traditional city run in Brackenheim, held annually at Wiesental Stadium and in the surrounding picturesque countryside. It offers various race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and kindergarten runs to school races and the main 5 km and 10 km races. The route runs along the cycle path on Austraße, through the “am Blasenberg” development and the villages of Meimsheim and Dürrenzimmern, before returning to the stadium. Alongside sporting ambition, fun and community are also central, with local partners providing attractive prizes and gifts for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiesental Stadium
Route along the cycle path on Austraße and through picturesque countryside
Circuit with 3 km, 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: Race number and transponder chip collection is available on the Friday before the race and on event day. Late entries are possible for a fee of €3.00, both on Friday and on event day until one hour before the respective race start. Separate start times: 11:15 for the Zabergäu Cup, fun run and main race; 14:00 for the Bambini, kindergarten and school races. Refreshments, showers, changing rooms and parking are available on site. The race takes place in September, with start times and various categories including Bambini, kindergarten, school and main races. The event is organized by the City of Brackenheim and supported by local partners.

name: Topiblütenlauf Staffort
location: Sportanlage des SV Staffort, Staffort, Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Topiblütenlauf Staffort is a running event held as part of the Stutensee CUP in the beautiful surroundings of Staffort. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with the 10 km race counting as the third race in the Stutensee CUP. Both races start at the SV Staffort sports grounds, and the event is open to runners of various age groups. Bib pickup begins at 8:30 a.m. The 10 km race starts at 10:00 a.m. and the 5 km race at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SV Staffort sports grounds
5 km race with no age-group rankings
10 km race counting as the third race in the Stutensee CUP
additional: Bib pickup from 8:30 a.m.; 5 km race with no age-group rankings; age groups for the 10 km race range from U16 students to the main age group and seniors in 5-year increments; event held as part of the Stutensee CUP. Course map, registration via Racepedia, start times 10:00 a.m. and 10:15 a.m., registration deadline September 21, 2024.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, offering runners and walkers a choice of distances in the countryside around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces, with small to moderate hills providing varied running conditions. Race numbers and timing chips must be collected 30 minutes before the relevant start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest runners.
course_highlights: Routes through the countryside, neighboring woodland, and open spaces
Small to moderate hills on the running and walking routes
Various distances from 600 m to 17.4 km for running and walking
additional: Race numbers and timing chips must be collected 30 minutes before the start. Start times are staggered: 10:00 a.m. Bambini run, 600 m; 10:15 a.m. walking, 6.0 km and 10.4 km; 10:30 a.m. running, 17.4 km; 10:45 a.m. running, 6.0 km and 10.4 km. Running and walking routes through nature, with small to moderate hills and various distances.

name: Bondorflauf
description: The Bondorflauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bondorf. It gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and fitness in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the varied sports programme of SV Bondorf and is open to runners of all abilities. The race takes place on 27 September 2026 and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bondorf
A range of distances for different ability levels
Part of SV Bondorf’s sports programme, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The Bondorflauf is part of SV Bondorf’s running group, which trains year-round in different groups over distances of 8 to approx. 14 km. The event is listed in the club’s calendar and is supported by experienced runners and coaches. It takes place as part of a cycling and recreational sports programme; the website provides no specific details about the terrain or registration.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
price_range: siehe Text (6-30 € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The event includes a Bambini run, student races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walk, and the 10 km main race. The routes lead through Lübeck city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including people who are not members of a club, and offers team scoring as well as a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city center of Lübeck
5 km and 10 km races with outer loops along Mengstraße
Separate age-appropriate routes for Bambini runners, students, and unicyclists
additional: Late registration is possible until 26.09.2026; on event day, registration is available only for the 10 km race, from 9:00 to 10:30. Protective gear is mandatory for unicyclists (helmet, wrist guards, and knee pads). Team scoring is available in the student and 5 km races. Bib numbers must not be altered. T-shirts for late registrants are available while supplies last. Terrain: city run, not officially measured; registration online, by mail, or on-site; bib numbers required; team and individual scoring; various age groups.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Crosslauf Friedrichsruh with County Championships is a cross-country running event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers distances ranging from 0.5 km for the youngest participants to 25 km. Alongside the county championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is distinguished by its friendly club atmosphere and focus on local running.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg
Distances from 0.5 km (Mini Cross) to 25 km
Cuxhaven County Championships included
additional: The youngest U8 runners take part in the accompanied 500 m Mini Cross. Special KM Cuxhaven cross-country races are held for school and youth age groups. The event typically takes place in mild September weather, with temperatures around 19 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Cross-country running, county championships, registration via LADV, various age groups, including races for children and young people

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several running distances from 400 m to 8.6 km are offered, as well as a Nordic Walking competition, for which proper pole technique is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors, and all participants receive a printable certificate; medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 places. Late registration is possible through the day of the event.
course_highlights: Several running distances from 400 m to 8.6 km for different age groups
Nordic Walking competition with proper pole technique required
Venue: sports field at Summter Straße 26 in Birkenwerder
additional: Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability for accidents or damage. Late registration runs from September 24 through the day of the event and is available online. A total of 500 places are available. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Proper pole technique is mandatory for Nordic Walking. Distances: cross-country run from 400 m to 8.6 km. Online registration; water and changing facilities available on site; medals for certain races; bib number distribution from 09:30.

name: Diezer Stadtlauf mit 10 km (Regionsmeisterschaft)
description: The Diezer City Run is a 10 km road race that starts at the Market Square in Diez, Germany, and takes place in late September. This edition also serves as the regional championships, adding extra competitive significance to the race. In addition to the 10 km race, there are shorter distances, including a 400 m race for children and 5 km races for various age groups. The event is organized by SV Diez-Freiendiez and offers competitions for children, youth, open-category runners, and masters, with separate rankings for men and women through the older age groups.
course_highlights: Starts at the Market Square in Diez
10 km road race through the town
Includes a 400 m children's race and 5 km races for various age groups
additional: The event includes various age and gender categories, including children, youth, open category, and masters. September weather is typically mild, with temperatures of around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Run 10 km in Diez as part of the regional championships. The venue is the Market Square in Diez. September weather: around 19°C. Includes junior races and shorter distances.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and takes place on September 27, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the classic marathon, half marathon, relay races, and other running and walking formats. The course runs through the city of Ulm, starting at the exhibition grounds and finishing at Münsterplatz. More than 15,000 runners are expected for the 22nd edition, which will feature a diverse program and a special Einstein collection.
course_highlights: Start at the Ulm exhibition grounds, finish at Münsterplatz
A variety of events: marathon, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, inline half marathon
Course through the historic city of Ulm, with an urban atmosphere
additional: Late registration is available online from 11.09. to 22.09.2026, until 12:00, and in person on event day until 1 hour before the start, with a €5 late registration fee. Entries can be transferred digitally until the registration deadline and in person only after that. Changes to another discipline can be made online until the registration deadline and in person only after that, for a €5 fee. Race packets can be collected on 26.09.2026 from 10:00 - 17:00 and on 27.09.2026 at various times and locations. Travel by public transport is free on event day with a race number or registration confirmation. Strollers, bicycles, dogs, and other aids are not permitted. Registration is open until 07.09.2026. Collect race packets in Ulm. No cancellations. Free travel by public transport. Parking is available.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a long-standing running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly on paved roads through the city centre. Alongside the main 5 km and 10 km races, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere, with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km loop through the city centre
Paved course with a flat profile
Children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km
additional: The 10 km race starts at 9:30 a.m.; the 5 km races start between 11:15 and 11:20 a.m.; the children’s races start between 11:20 a.m. and 12:45 p.m. Late entries are also possible on the day of the event. The event is a fundraising event for the renovation of the Nikolaikirche church tower. Refreshments including sausage, cake and drinks are available at Rathausplatz. A temporary no-parking restriction applies at the railway underpass on race day. The race routes run on paved roads through the city centre; training sessions are offered before the event; registration is available until shortly before the event; medals are awarded to children.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a traditional, family-friendly race around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognized as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible run-off elections, the race takes place on Saturday in some years.
course_highlights: Loop course around the town festival
Family-friendly course
Low entry fee and affordable refreshments
additional: The Michaelislauf is a DLV race and takes place around the town festival. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere, low entry fees, and affordable refreshments. Due to possible run-off elections, the race may take place on Saturday. The race is held as part of the town festival in Epe, with refreshments and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Esslinger Schurwaldlauf
location: Georgii-Waldstadion, Esslingen am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Esslingen Schurwaldlauf is a long-standing running event taking place on September 27, 2026, in Esslingen, on the Schurwald ridge. The start and finish are at Georgii-Waldstadion, which is scenically located between the Neckar and Rems valleys. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to compete in various races, including the Esslingen city championships over 10 km. The course runs through the beautiful Schurwald countryside and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Georgii-Waldstadion on the Schurwald ridge
Scenic course between the Neckar and Rems valleys
Course of approximately 10 km with varied terrain
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 8:00 to 9:30 a.m., with a €5 late-registration fee in addition to the entry fee. Changing rooms and showers are available at the stadium. Parking is available nearby at Jägerhaus, the riding stable, or the gliding airfield. The awards ceremony begins at approximately 12:15 p.m. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross. Courses on forest trails in the Schurwald; online registration; start at 10:00 a.m.; late registration available on the day of the event; team classification; prizes and certificates.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorfer Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organised by DJK Herdorf and included in the official German race calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 metres and 10 kilometres, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-oriented event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.
course_highlights: Two distances: 500 m and 10 km
Local race in Herdorf associated with DJK Herdorf
Part of the official German race calendar (laufen.de)
additional: Typical September weather: around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, approximately 45 mm of precipitation, and mostly cloudy. The start location is Herdorf; detailed directions are available. Open to all age groups. No detailed course information is available. The event is part of the Ausdauer-Cup 2024.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herner St. Martini City Run takes place on September 27, 2026, on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances of approximately 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with official supervision
A range of distances from approximately 400 m to 5 km for all age groups
Start and finish on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until 1 hour before the respective race, for an additional fee of €3. Race packs can be collected in advance on September 24 and 25, 2026, at the Sports Department in Herne. Timing is electronic via easychip provided by davengo, Berlin. Results lists can be purchased at the race office for €3. Changing rooms are available in schools. The event includes children's races, school competitions, and running distances for all ability levels. Registration is via an Excel form, and the event emphasizes community and sporting challenge.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Wymeer on September 27, 2026, invites everyone who enjoys running and hiking to discover the varied landscape around Wymeer. Runs of 6 km, 12 km and 21 km are offered, suitable for everyone from beginners to half-marathon enthusiasts. There are also opportunities for hiking, Nordic walking and cycle touring on well-marked routes with refreshment points and friendly volunteers. After the sporting activities, participants can enjoy a varied selection of food and drinks and round off the day in good company. The Volkswandertag promotes community, outdoor exercise and showcases the region’s most beautiful spots.
course_highlights: Runs of 6 km, 12 km and 21 km for everyone from beginners to half-marathon enthusiasts
Hiking, Nordic walking and cycle touring through a varied landscape
Well-marked routes with refreshment points and friendly volunteers
additional: Registration is available online or in person on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Hearty food and cake will be available after the sporting activities. The event is open to individuals, families, friends and clubs. It’s an opportunity for the whole family to get active and enjoy the nature around Wymeer.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a unique running experience set amid the picturesque landscapes of southern Germany. The course winds through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic old towns, with an exhilarating atmosphere along the way. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, there’s a personal highlight for everyone. The marathon starts and finishes at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr and follows a varied loop through the Bottwartal, with a flat finish for a strong final sprint.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, passing historic old towns
Paved rural roads and a flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
Atmospheric run along the Bottwar and through picturesque towns such as Murr, Gronau, Beilstein and Großbottwar
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups to help you prepare. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening at 19:00 during the summer holidays. The Year-End Run is a traditional event featuring a 10 km run followed by punch and mulled wine. Runners line up at 9:00, with the start at 9:30 at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim. The event takes place at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr and is a popular training opportunity for runners preparing for the Bottwartal Marathon. Registration is open until June 28, 2026.

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: De 100 Bruggenloop in Leiden is een unieke wandel- en hardloopwedstrijd waarbij deelnemers over 100 bruggen lopen, variërend van eeuwenoude stenen boogbruggen tot moderne bruggen in het Singelpark. De route voert langs rivieren, grachten, trekvaarten en singels en passeert de mooiste plekken van de historische binnenstad, waaronder de oudste universiteit van Nederland, de Hortus Botanicus en diverse monumenten. De wandeltocht vindt plaats op zaterdag 26 september 2026 en de hardloopwedstrijd op zondag 27 september 2026. Er zijn verschillende afstanden beschikbaar, zodat zowel recreatieve wandelaars als hardlopers kunnen deelnemen.
course_highlights: 100 bruggen over rivieren, grachten, trekvaarten en singels
Langs historische plekken zoals de oudste universiteit en Hortus Botanicus
Route door het Singelpark, havens, stadspoorten en bijzondere architectuur
additional: Wandelaars starten zaterdag tussen 08:00 en 11:00 uur vanuit Van der Werfpark. Hardlopers starten zondag vanaf 08:00 uur vanaf het Stadhuisplein/Vismarkt. Er is een tijdslimiet voor wandelen tot 16:15 uur en voor hardlopen tot 11:15 uur. Er is verzorging onderweg, stempelposten, EHBO, en een herinneringsmedaille. Honden zijn toegestaan mits aangelijnd, behalve in de Hortus Botanicus. Kinderen tot 12 jaar mogen alleen onder begeleiding deelnemen. De stad wordt niet afgesloten; de route gaat over stoepen en voetgangersgebieden. Na-inschrijving is mogelijk op de dag zelf met een toeslag van €2,00. Het evenement biedt praktische informatie over inschrijving, tijden en faciliteiten. De route bevat diverse ondergronden zoals grind, schelpen, baksteen, kinderkopjes, hout, beton en asfalt, en is toegankelijk voor minder validen.

description: De Ehrmann Posbankloop is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd door de prachtige natuur van de Veluwezoom, met uitdagende hoogtemeters en een adembenemend mooi parcours. De 30e editie vindt plaats op zondag 27 september 2026 in Velp en biedt diverse afstanden, waaronder een 15 km hoofdafstand, een 6 km loop en een wandeltocht. De route voert langs iconische plekken zoals de Posbank en de Emmapiramide, met de uitdagende 'Muur van Aalbers' als speciale klassement-in-het-klassement. De Posbankloop is geschikt voor zowel recreatieve als fanatieke lopers en staat bekend om zijn sfeervolle finish met veel toeschouwers.
course_highlights: Prachtige natuur van de Veluwezoom met veel hoogtemeters
Beklimming van de Posbank en de 'Muur van Aalbers' (Emmapiramide)
Start en finish in het centrum van Velp nabij station
additional: Startnummers moeten ruim voor de start worden afgehaald bij Gezondheidscentrum Velp op de Rozendaalselaan 34. Er is een tijdslimiet van 55 minuten voor de 6 km loop en 120 minuten voor de 15 km loop. De 'Muur van Aalbers' is een speciale segment met horloges als prijs voor de eerste man en vrouw die boven zijn. Bij inschrijving voor 17 september wordt de naam op het startnummer gedrukt. Er is water en fruit bij de finish en een kortingsbon voor hardloopschoenen bij Run2Day Arnhem/Nijmegen. De start/finish ligt vlak bij station Velp, goed bereikbaar met trein en fiets. Jubileumeditie met wandeltocht en kinderclinics, locatie in Velp, evenement op 27 september 2026

name: 7-loop Zevenhoven
location: SV Zevenhoven, Zevenhoven, Nieuwkoop, South Holland, Netherlands
description: De 7-Loop is een hardloopevenement met een rijke traditie van meer dan 35 jaar in de Gemeente Nieuwkoop. Het vindt plaats in Zevenhoven en staat bekend als een echte herfstklassieker met mooie parcours door de polders van het Groene Hart. De 7-Loop is onderdeel van het Nieuwkoops Circuit en sluit het circuit af met een spannend eindklassement. Er zijn diverse afstanden voor zowel jeugd als volwassenen, waarbij de jeugd gratis kan deelnemen en een glimmende medaille ontvangt.
course_highlights: Mooie parcours door de polders van het Groene Hart
Kinderafstanden van 400m en 800m rond de voetbalvelden
De 7-Loop is de afsluiter van het Nieuwkoops Circuit
additional: Start- en finishterrein is aan Stationsweg 23, Zevenhoven. Er is gratis parkeergelegenheid, kleedruimte, douchegelegenheid en horecafaciliteiten. De jeugdafstanden starten tussen 11:30 en 12:00 uur, de volwassen afstanden starten tussen 12:30 en 13:00 uur. De jeugdafstanden zijn gratis en lopen rond het finishterrein en voetbalvelden. De 7-Loop is een verplichte wedstrijd binnen het Nieuwkoops Circuit en deelnemers moeten zich vooraf online inschrijven om in het circuit te kunnen scoren. Terrain door de polders van het Groene Hart, inclusief kids' races en verschillende afstanden, gratis deelname voor kinderen, inschrijving t/m 24 september 2026.

description: De CityRun Nijverdal is een gezellig hardloopfeest voor jong en oud, dat plaatsvindt op zondag 27 september 2026. De wedstrijd biedt vier afstanden: KidsRun, 2,5 km, 5 km en 10 km, plus een G-Run voor mindervalide deelnemers. Het snelle parcours is KNAU-gecertificeerd en loopt dwars door het centrum van Nijverdal, met veel muziek en aanmoedigingen van toeschouwers. De organisatie zet zich in om er een sportief en verbindend evenement van te maken voor deelnemers en publiek.
course_highlights: KNAU-gecertificeerd snel parcours door het centrum van Nijverdal
Exact opgemeten 5 km en 10 km routes met meerdere rondes
Muziek en aanmoedigingen langs het parcours
additional: Starttijden per afstand: G-Run 12:45, KidsRun vanaf 13:00 in leeftijdsgroepen, 10 km start 14:30, 5 km start 16:00. Startnummers met transponder voor tijdregistratie. Na finish verzorging met water, sportdrank en fruit. Rode Kruis aanwezig met 6 medewerkers en 2 fietsers. Geen douches, wel omkleedruimte zonder toezicht. Speciaal runningshirt te bestellen voor €12,95. Gratis ijs voor de school met meeste deelnemers. Parcours is snel en KNAU-gecertificeerd, starttijd 16:00 uur, inschrijving tot 13 september 2026 met korting, medaille en startnummer inclusief, speciale runningshirt te bestellen, parkeermogelijkheden op het marktplein en bij Albert Heijn, treinverbindingen vanuit Zwolle en Almelo, verzorging met drank en fruit, geen douches, tijdregistratie via transponders.

name: Texel Halve Marathon
price_range: 45 euro (bootstart halve en kwart marathon), 42,50 euro (eilandstart halve en kwart marathon), 20 euro (achtste marathon)
