name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
location: Biberach an der Riß, Biberach, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Biberach Autumn Forest Run is a small autumn forest run in Biberach an der Riß, starting at the Burrenwald parking lot. The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners a choice of 5 km or 10 km. It is a relaxed running event with no advance registration required; registration is available in person on race day. The route runs through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a nature-focused running experience. The entry fee is very affordable at 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish as well as a certificate, which can be collected later or sent by email.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Burrenwald area
Start and finish at the Burrenwald parking lot
Nature-focused route with no stadium sections
additional: No advance registration required; registration is available in person on race day. Entry fee: 4 euros, including refreshments at the finish and a certificate. The event has been held since at least 2011, with a cancellation in 2020. A local field of participants includes many returning runners. The run takes place in the Burrenwald; finish-line refreshments are included and a certificate is available. Autumn weather in October. A small, family-friendly event.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
price_range: 10,00 € Nachmeldegebühr für Erwachsene/Jugend U18 bis U20
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running, not long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults as well as different age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around the Bergfried in Saalfeld
Distances from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of hill running and cross-country running
additional: The race includes categories for youth, open class, masters, and local runners from Saalfeld-Rudolstadt. Around 200 children and young people took part in a previous edition. Typical October weather is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies. The race takes place outside the stadium and includes children’s and adults’ categories, off-road and hill running. Registration deadline: September 29, 2026.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hanover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Every participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is available in both digital and traditional formats. The event is aimed at recreational runners and promotes active movement in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Altwarmbüchen
Scenic route in the Hanover Region
Part of a large running series with a wide range of events
additional: Participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, also available digitally via the Laufpass app. The app offers an event calendar, a digital running diary and further information. The Volkslauf is part of a series of 43 running events in the Hanover Region. Running event in Altwarmbüchen; on-site registration possible; race on 01.03.2026; part of the Laufpass series; various distances, including 1.6 km, 3.6 km, 7.2 km and 10.8 km.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen Run organized by TV 1884 Zeil is a traditional running event taking place for the 30th time on October 10, 2026. Several distances are offered, including an 11 km main race, junior races over 1600 m and 800 m, and a Bambini race. The event provides a well-organized course with timing, race-number pickup, showers and changing rooms, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The race is open to runners of all ages and promotes a sense of sporting community in Zeil am Main.
course_highlights: 11 km main race
Junior races over 1600 m and 800 m
Bambini race for the youngest runners
additional: The event offers team scoring, race-number pickup, timing, showers and changing rooms, toilets, an awards ceremony, food and drink, medical support, and a secured course. The course is hilly; races are available for adults, children, and young people; team scoring; family- and team-friendly; results published

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
location: Sportplatz Brakelsiek, Schieder-Schwalenberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brakelsieker Volkslauf “Am Fuße des Mörths” is a traditional local running, walking and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. It offers a range of distances for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports ground, and the course runs around the village sports ground, with a gently rolling, rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn scenery in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Brakelsiek sports ground
Loop around the village sports ground; not a point-to-point course
Gently rolling course with a rural profile at the foot of the Mörth
additional: Running, walking and Nordic walking distances are offered for adults and young people. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The course is not considered a tough mountain route, but has moderate elevation gain. Running and walking events; start and finish at the Brakelsiek sports ground; gently rolling course; rural profile.

name: Herberts Bremserlauf mit dem TSV Zornheim
description: The Herberts Bremserlauf with TSV Zornheim is a local road race in Zornheim, taking place on October 10, 2026. With 2 km and 10 km distances, it offers a club and community race format that differs from stadium events. It is part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region and is open to children, school-age runners, youth, adults, masters, and recreational runners. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Hans-Steib-Halle. On-site late registration is possible, but incurs a small surcharge.
course_highlights: Road race in a club and community race format
Part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region
Start and meeting point at Herberts Kulturscheune
additional: On-site late registration is possible but incurs a small surcharge. Changing facilities and showers are located at the Hans-Steib-Halle on Zum Neuen Sportplatz. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with lows of 6 °C, mostly cloudy skies, and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. On-site late registration is available, and facilities such as changing rooms and showers are available at the Hans-Steib-Halle.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The 2026 Autumn Run takes place on October 10 at the Waldstadion Schutterwald. The course covers 10 kilometers of flat forest and field paths, measured and marked in accordance with DLV standards. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers an appealing opportunity to run in natural surroundings. Registration is online via my.raceresult.com, and the organizer is happy to answer questions by email.
course_highlights: 10 km of flat forest and field paths
Course measured in accordance with DLV standards
Every kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at the Waldstadion. Register online via my.raceresult.com. Entry fees include €0.50 in federation fees. Online registration, every kilometer is marked, an event with a strong community spirit

name: IKK Südwest Freundschaftslauf
description: The IKK Südwest Friendship Run is a traditional timed-hour run in Marpingen, offering various running distances as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is not a competition; its focus is on community and the enjoyment of running. Routes range from 5.5 km to 11 km, with untimed hiking routes also available. The run is organized by the Saarland Athletics Federation and takes place on 10 October 2026.
course_highlights: Timed-hour run with routes from 7 to 11 km
Walking and Nordic walking routes between 5.5 and 6.5 km
Untimed hiking
additional: The Friendship Run is explicitly not a competition. No times are recorded. The event includes various running and walking distances as well as hiking routes. It is organized by the Saarland Athletics Federation. There is no official timed competition, no prizes, and no competitive rankings; it is ideal for community and the enjoyment of running.

name: Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf
description: The Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf is a special race that runs into the night. Since 2009, it has replaced the well-known Zigeunerberglauf. Illuminated sections of the course create a unique atmosphere. As the sixth and final race in the Schönbuch-Cup series, it traditionally takes place on the second Saturday in October. The event is firmly rooted in the region and appeals to runners who appreciate a special atmosphere while running.
course_highlights: A race that runs into the night
Illuminated sections of the course create a special atmosphere
The final race in the Schönbuch-Cup series
additional: Registration and results are available centrally via the Schönbuch-Cup website. The event takes place on 10 October 2026, with the start and finish at the Kuppingen community hall. A festive running atmosphere for the whole family is on offer.

name: Lichterlauf in Steckenborn
description: The Steckenborn Lichterlauf is a popular race in the Eifel region, known for its unique atmosphere. The course is 10 kilometers long and consists of a 2-kilometer loop run five times. As darkness falls, the course is atmospherically lit with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches, making the race a special experience. The organizer, SC Komet Steckenborn e.V., looks forward to welcoming many participants to enjoy this special event.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a 2 km loop run five times
Atmospheric lighting with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches after dark
Race with a unique atmosphere in the Eifel region
additional: 10 km night race on a lit course, team competition for young people, registration on the website

name: Loßburger Waldlauf
description: The Loßburg Forest Run is a traditional autumn forest run in Loßburg, Germany, organized by Skiclub Loßburg. The event is being held for the 30th time and offers runners a varied route on roads and forest paths, with no laps on a track. There are several distances, including a 400 m run for children and young people and a challenging 10 km run for adults with a hilly profile. The races start in the evening, with the 10 km run beginning at 19:00.
course_highlights: Forest and road run in October
Hilly profile for the 10 km run
Children’s and youth events over a 400 m distance
additional: The 10 km run starts at 19:00; the shorter run (6.7 km) starts earlier in the evening. The event takes place at the school center in Loßburg. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Registration is open until October 9, 2026. The event also includes children’s and youth races at various distances, including a 400 m run for the youngest participants.

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition on October 10, 2026. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers a range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event takes place as part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured distances of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Varied routes featuring paved roads and gravel forest paths
Run held as part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the relevant start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Forum multipurpose hall, 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available at the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle at the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause delays. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late registration available on race day; race bibs distributed at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Zille-Straße, Stahnsdorf, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners from the region the chance to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, winding through woodland and natural terrain with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the race, the organizer provides refreshments, and football matches often take place at the sports ground, making for an enjoyable day of sport for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Course through the Parforceheide, with woodland and natural sections
Varied surfaces: sand, asphalt, and cobblestones
Small climbs add challenge and variety
additional: Races are available for various age groups and distances: Bambini race (1 km), schoolchildren’s race (3 km), and 5 km and 10 km races for young people and adults. Refreshments are provided at the sports ground after the race. The event is part of the Mittelmark Cup and is supported by many volunteers. Football matches are often played on the artificial turf afterward, rounding out the day for families and spectators. Terrain with climbs, sandy sections, asphalt, cobblestones. Registration at www.ziel-zeit.de

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztal Run is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-lap course that does not require repeated laps. The program includes 5 km races for adults and young people, a 10 km race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking for adults. Children’s and youth races round out the program, making this a local, club-oriented running event. The finish is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 15:00.
course_highlights: Flat, single-lap course with no repeated laps
Finish at the tennis facility in Vorra
A varied program with races for children, young people, and adults
additional: The event takes place in the afternoon, with a 15:00 start. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with lows of 6 °C; it is mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is more of a local club race than a road race exclusively for adults. It is a local club run with a family-friendly atmosphere, welcoming runners of all ages.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthal Wine Mountain Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ramsthal. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini to schoolchildren, teenagers and adults. The routes pass through Ramsthal’s picturesque vineyards and offer varied scenery. In addition to the running competitions, there is also a walking route that lets participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Running routes through the picturesque vineyards of Ramsthal
A variety of competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults
An 8 km walking route through beautiful scenery
additional: Competitions for various age groups and distances: Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults (6.4 km and 10.4 km), as well as walking (8 km). Running, Nordic walking, family-friendly activities, picturesque vineyard scenery

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The start is at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. The race is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, so it is not a simple, flat city course. It is aimed mainly at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km course combining cross-country and road running
Start at Krumbholzallee 8 in Bernburg
Local race with a manageable field of 100–300 runners
additional: Registration is available online, in person in advance or on site on race day. Chip timing by race result, online results and start lists, photos and reports, printed and online certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy with 40 mm of precipitation. This is not a major event, but a local race that typically attracts 100 to 300 participants. In addition to the race, it offers a friendly atmosphere with refreshments, showers and parking.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place on 10 October 2026 in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km Walking & Nordic Walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumn woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and young people; further information is available in the organiser’s official race announcement. All events share the same start and finish, but the exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age category, with categories assigned according to year of birth. There are several events with different distances, age categories and start times; young people aged 14 and over may participate. Results will be published on the website.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with walking around the AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Flat route around Altwarmbüchener See
Lap of approximately 3.66 km
Running and Nordic walking options
additional: The races start in the afternoon in the following order: first the 3.6 km run, then the walkers, followed by the 7.2 km run for adults. The event is more of a community running day for the town than a single main race. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.6 km to 10.8 km; flat terrain; running and walking events; races for children and young people; date: 10 October 2026.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
price_range: 25,00 € bis 70,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10 km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The route passes through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometre race, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups, offering a large running festival for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start in front of Charlottenburg Palace
The route passes through Berlin Zoo
Running festival on the forecourt of Charlottenburg Palace
additional: Chip timing with a transponder attached to your shoe, refreshment stations and toilets along the route, pacemakers for the 10 km and short course, online certificate with your personal result, BVG tickets for relay runners, bag transport from the start to the finish, medal engraving and event shirts available as add-ons, HD finish-line video available to purchase, children’s and Bambini races for those born between 2014 and 2021. Distances: 10 km, 4.2 km, children’s and Bambini races, relay events; registration until 20.10.2024; start in front of Berlin Zoo, finish at Charlottenburg Palace; event extras such as medal engraving, photos and videos available.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Roland Run is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarck Tower, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. In 2026, the event in Burg was canceled because the necessary permit was not granted; a replacement event will instead take place in Tangerhütte Town Park.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town of Burg along the Ihle
A forest section with views of the Bismarck Tower
Finish in the courtyard of Rolandgymnasium
additional: The traditional course in Burg was not approved for 2026. A replacement event will instead take place in Tangerhütte Town Park. Entry fees already paid can be refunded. After the race, there will be a supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. Cancellation in 2026, replacement event in Tangerhütte, course through Burg, activities for children, bouncy castle, refreshments

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timing, starting at the market square and climbing to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometres long with 100 metres of elevation gain. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A small snack is served afterwards, making the run a sociable event.
course_highlights: Route about 3 km long
About 100 m of elevation gain
Group run uphill to Wernigerode Castle
additional: The run is free of charge, takes place as a group and is not timed. A small snack is served afterwards. Group run, no timing, snack afterwards.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Half Marathon Hannover is a new event on the national running calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green stretches. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots across the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a unique running experience in a lively urban setting. Be there for the prologue as Hannover opens a new chapter in running history.
course_highlights: The route combines urban flair with green stretches
Start and finish in the heart of Hannover
The route passes notable hotspots in the state capital
additional: Check-in takes place on October 10, 2026, and the starting gun goes off on October 11, 2026. The event is an autumn highlight with urban flair and modern music. There are attractive side events, and the route is secured by course marshals. Participation is at your own risk, and DLV and IAAF regulations apply. Course in 2026: the 10 km route is run twice, followed later by the full half-marathon distance; registration is open until race day; a run with a modern atmosphere and music

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside the competition, the event emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a fixture on the running calendar and attracts participants from across Germany.
course_highlights: 500 m Bambini Run around the market square and Germany’s oldest folk festival
A range of courses from 500 m to 10 km, starting and finishing at Linggplatz
Run through the historic old town of Bad Hersfeld
additional: Start times: 1.3 km school race at 09:35, 5 km individual race at 10:00, 5 km team race at 10:10, 5 km Nordic walking at 11:30, 10 km individual race at 11:45, 500 m Bambini Run at 11:15. Certificates available as digital downloads; drinks in the finish area. Teams of 5–7 people can enter the team race. Prizes in kind for the overall winners. Multiple race categories; on-site registration available. Scenic course in Bad Hersfeld.

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain run organized by the Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a long-standing event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The route climbs uphill and offers runners a challenging course in a scenic setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere. Registration is handled through MY RACE RESULT, with the deadline falling shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill route with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic surroundings in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the SVG ski hut, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is 12:00 noon on the Saturday before the race. The start and finish are at the SVG ski hut in Geislingen an der Steige (Weiler o. H. district). The event takes place on October 11, 2026; route and elevation profiles are available; registration is through Race Result; the venue is SVG Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the town center of Burscheid and offers an ideal setting for runners of all ability levels. There are several distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter run that serves as a qualification for the Sports Badge. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top finishers are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the town center
3-kilometer run for recreational athletes
800-meter youth run as a qualification for the Sports Badge
additional: Late entries are possible at the registration office on race day for an additional fee of €5.00, but late registrants will not receive Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be distributed from 10:30 a.m. at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the “Auf dem Schulberg” sports hall. Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish. Age-group rankings follow DLO regulations. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children’s races, race-packet distribution from 10:30 a.m., online results, age-group rankings, medals, and trophies. October weather is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE Citylauf Schwabach on 11 October 2026 offers a varied running programme for all age groups and ability levels. Events include a half marathon, relay, main race, fun run, walking and children’s races. The races start and finish at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organised event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The route leads through the city and offers a special running experience in Schwabach, the City of Gold Leaf.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approx. 21.1 km
Start and finish at Königsplatz next to the town hall
A variety of race distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are possible only on race weekend, subject to availability. Places are limited, and on-site late entries are not available for sold-out events. Participants in the main races must be at least 16 years old; the maximum time is 3 hours. Relay legs are approx. 7 km each. The start and finish are at Königsplatz next to the town hall and at Fürstenherberge, respectively. Registration is open until 4 October 2026. A variety of categories are available for different age groups and ability levels. Refreshments are provided at several points along the route.

name: Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht angegeben)
description: The Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen is an exciting obstacle race on 11 October 2026, with distances of 7 to 26 kilometres to suit all ability levels. The route runs through the picturesque spa town of Bad Hönningen on the Rhine, past vineyards and historic buildings, and features varied terrain with plenty of elevation gain. Alongside the sporting challenge, participants can expect spectacular obstacles, mud, water slides and a unique atmosphere with a spectacular opening show. The race is ideal for individuals, teams and families looking to enjoy fun and adventure together.
course_highlights: Along the legendary Rheinsteig trail, with spectacular views of the Rhine Valley
Narrow, steep sections and plenty of elevation gain
Past Arenfels Castle, two gravel pits and a disused concrete plant
additional: The start and finish are right in the centre of Bad Hönningen, directly on the Rhine. There is a mega opening show featuring bands and DJs before the mass start. Group discounts are available for groups of 6 or more. The Family Edition is for children aged 12 and over, accompanied by an adult, on a 7 km route. There are different start groups (Überflieger, Senkrechtstarter, Dauerbrenner, Spätzünder) for different ability levels. The event includes water and mud obstacles, group discounts when registering, music, costumes and various distances, including a family edition for children aged 12 and over accompanied by an adult.

name: Int. Schwarzwald-Marathon
description: The Black Forest Marathon in Bräunlingen is a long-established race that has been held annually since 1968 and is known as the world’s oldest nature and women’s marathon. The course runs mainly along well-maintained forest trails and offers a varied experience in nature, with a gentle climb up to kilometer 21 followed by a slight descent. In addition to the classic marathon, there is also a marathon relay, half marathon, 10 km races, Nordic walking and other races for different age groups. The event is ideal for runners who want to combine nature with a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: 80% well-maintained forest trails, 20% asphalt
Gentle climb up to approx. km 21, followed by a slight descent
Kilometer markers along the entire course
additional: Late registration is available at the town hall on 10.10.2026 from 12:00-18:00 and on 11.10.2026 from 07:00 until 60 minutes before the start. Bib numbers are color-coded to make the different events easier to distinguish. No transportation is provided by the organizer for the marathon relay. Various race disciplines; on-site registration available; bib numbers are color-coded; the schedule may be changed at short notice.

name: Klosterlauf Aurachtal

price_tiers.distance: Hauptlauf, Hobbylauf, Jugendlauf B, Nordic Walking

description: The Klosterlauf Aurachtal is a running event starting and finishing near the Münchaurach Abbey Church. All routes are marked by kilometre and run mainly on paved paths and gravel tracks. Various events are offered, including a 10 km main race, a fun run, youth races, Nordic walking, and children’s and Bambini races. The event is open to all healthy people with sufficient training; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Münchaurach Abbey Church
Routes mainly on paved paths and gravel tracks
Routes marked by kilometre
additional: Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start for an additional fee of 4,- €. Registration is valid only once payment has been received. Entry fees can be refunded up to 2 weeks before the event date. Prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in each age group (male/female). The event is managed by an external service provider. The main race route is 10 km (2 laps); the fun run, Youth Race B, and Nordic walking are 5 km (1 lap); the children’s race is approximately 1 km (out and back). Routes are mainly on paved paths. Online registration is available; late entries are subject to a fee. Participation is open from age 18 without club membership. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the age groups.

name: Kreuzberglauf mit Ufr. Meisterschaften
location: Schönau an der Brend, Rhön-Region, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kreuzberglauf in Schönau an der Brend is a traditional running event held annually by DJK Olympia Schönau. The event attracts runners of various ages and ability levels and offers a sporting challenge in the scenic Rhön region. The course passes through varied terrain and is part of the Lower Franconian Championships. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Rhön region
Part of the Lower Franconian Championships
Varied terrain with diverse sections of the course
additional: The race takes place on 11 October 2026. Further details about registration and participation are available on the website.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Main Riverside Run is an open running event held annually along the Main River in Offenbach. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 2 km schoolchildren’s run. The course follows the Main and offers an attractive riverside setting. In 2025, short-notice course changes were made due to construction work. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required. It has a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive riverside scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Separate 2 km schoolchildren’s run
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking is recommended at the Innenstadt car park on Berliner Straße (about 750 m away; fee of approximately €1 per hour). Due to construction work, Mainstraße is closed, resulting in short-notice course changes. This year’s course is not eligible for record purposes because official measurement was not possible. The half-marathon starts about 350 m from the previous start location. The 5 km and 10 km races start by the Main at the finish arch. The 2 km schoolchildren’s run starts by the Main as usual. Event photos are provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Course changes due to construction work; course not eligible for record purposes; registration opens on 1.8.2025; weather-dependent conditions; various race distances

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The 2026 Porta Fun Run is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica and has been a fixture on the regional running calendar for more than three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from competitive athletes to recreational runners. The route follows roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with beautiful panoramic views of Porta. The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The warm atmosphere and sense of community make it a special day.
course_highlights: Route along roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground
Sections through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve
Flat, varied sections with panoramic views of Porta
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie (8th race in 2026). Course maps for the short course (5.5 km), medium course (8.8 km) and long course (17 km) are available as PDFs. Registration will open shortly. The event takes place at the sports facility in Nammen (Poggenbeeke). The courses are flat and offer open views of nature. Registration and course maps will be available soon. Drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst are available in the start/finish area.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Lubmin, organized by the Triathlon and Running Group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The course passes through scenic areas and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
course_highlights: Running course through scenic areas in Lubmin
Good organization, with many volunteers along the course and in the finish area
Traditional run with high participation and a positive atmosphere
additional: The event is organized by the Triathlon and Running Group of HSG Uni Greifswald. Relay competitions are held over middle and short distances. The event is known for strong participation and positive feedback. A para-athlete was specially honored for an outstanding performance. The event also offers special short-distance races for young participants (U10, U12, U14) and fosters team spirit. October weather is usually mild, with temperatures around 14°C, and the event takes place at the Seebadzentrum near the Baltic Sea.

name: Sparkassen SAARathon
description: The Sparkassen SAARathon 2026 takes place on 11 October in Saarbrücken and offers suitable challenges for runners of all ability levels. The flat, fast courses run along the Saar and offer wonderful views of Saarbrücken city and the varied surrounding area. In addition to the traditional 10 km Westspangenlauf, there is a new World Heritage Marathon, held for the third time, which takes runners as far as the Völklinger Hütte. The running event combines a sporting challenge with scenic beauty and regional culture.
course_highlights: Flat, fast courses along the Saar
Wonderful views of Saarbrücken city and the surrounding area
World Heritage Marathon route to the Völklinger Hütte
additional: The event includes several distances: marathon (with state championships), half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and 1 km schoolchildren’s race. The event is aimed at experienced runners and beginners. The 10 km course, the Westspangenlauf, has a 38-year tradition. The organizers can be reached by phone at 0681-927200, Monday to Friday from 8:30 to 17:00. Courses for all ability levels, online registration, race number collection in Saarbrücken, discounts for groups and people with disabilities, pacemakers available

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a long-standing running event organised by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On 11 October 2026, runners of different age groups and ability levels can take part on various distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competition atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants are included in an official participant list.
course_highlights: Various distances from 1 km to 15.2 km
Running routes around Lake Storkow
Start and finish area with a modern race briefing
additional: Race numbers can be collected on event day from 08:00. There are several competition classes (WK1 to WK6) with different start times. Award ceremonies begin at around 11:00. Registration is only valid once payment has been received. Online registration is available; start times and distances vary. The event is suitable for runners of all ability levels.

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrum Road Race “Around Neustadtstraße” is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, centered on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the laufen.de race calendar, making participation in the German rankings possible. The race is held in accordance with the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A range of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, low of 6 °C, average precipitation of 40 mm, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km and 25 km, as well as special races for children and young people. The course runs along Neustadtstraße and through Sportpark Styrum, in cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and meets the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Trochtelfinger Nordic Walking Stöckles-Cup

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Für Gruppenanmeldungen von 10 Personen und mehr gilt der ermäßigte Tarif von 11,- €

description: The Trochtelfingen Stöckles Cup is a popular Nordic walking trail event on the Swabian Alb, held annually on the second weekend of October in Trochtelfingen. The event offers two route distances of approximately 9 km and 13 km, leading through the gentle hills of the Sonnenalb and marked with arrows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, a drinks station along the route, and a raffle with valuable prizes. The event is open to everyone, with or without poles, and encourages people of all ages to enjoy being active.
course_highlights: Two route distances: approximately 9 km short course and 13 km long course
The gentle hills of the Sonnenalb and an extensive network of trails
A drinks station along the route and marked courses
additional: Race pack distribution from 08:30 at Tommis Sportshop. Start window for the 13 km loop until 10:30. The finish closes at 13:00; no timing is available after that. Participants receive chip timing and an online certificate. There are no age-group or category rankings, only a finisher list for women and men. Trophies for the three largest groups. Raffle with high-quality prizes from 13:15. Refreshments include a standing snack bar, coffee, and cake from 10:00, provided by TSV Trochtelfingen. The event starts and finishes at Tommis Sportshop in Trochtelfingen. Children up to age 12 can participate for free. Groups of 10 or more receive a discount. The courses are marked and there is a drinks station. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: Wendlandmarathon
location: Kolborn bei Lüchow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and refreshment stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms, certificates and finisher medals for children.
course_highlights: Road race with a course measured to AIMS/IAAF standards
Kilometre markers and refreshment stations along the course
A variety of distances from 400 m to the marathon
additional: The marathon and marathon relay start in the morning, followed by the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races. Registration is available online in advance or in person on race weekend. Timing is handled by the organiser. Refreshments are available at the finish. Certificates are printed and made available online. Course distance up to 42.2 km, refreshments along the course, finisher medals, parking, showers, changing rooms, registration online or in person
